attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot subject to this disposition decision. Represents the quantity of wafers impacted by the disposition action.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition decision was approved. Represents the moment of final authorization.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a formal corrective action is required to prevent recurrence. Triggers Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition record was first created in the system. Audit field for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: customer_approval_received
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer approval has been received for ship-as-is or downgrade dispositions. Applicable when customer notification is required.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer notification is required for this disposition decision. True if Product Change Notification (PCN) or customer approval is needed.

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized defect classification code from the fab defect taxonomy. Links to the defect type reference table for detailed defect characteristics.

attributes.name: defect_die_count
attributes.description: Total number of defective or failing die across all wafers in the lot at the time of disposition. Used for yield loss analysis.

attributes.name: disposition_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, role, or system that authorized the disposition decision. Typically a quality engineer, production supervisor, or automated MES rule.

attributes.name: disposition_authority_role
attributes.description: Organizational role of the disposition authority. Defines the level of authorization for the disposition decision.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was made. Business event date for the disposition action.

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to the disposition decision. Captures additional context, special instructions, or engineering judgment.

attributes.name: disposition_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the disposition decision. Format: DISP-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX where YYYYMMDD is date and XXXXXX is sequence.

attributes.name: disposition_of_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Disposition decisions reference the lot being dispositioned. Required for lot closure and yield accounting.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disposition decision. Pending: awaiting approval. Approved: authorized for execution. Rejected: disposition denied. Executed: disposition action completed. Cancelled: disposition voided.

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the disposition decision was recorded in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Captures exact moment of disposition event.

attributes.name: disposition_type
attributes.description: Type of disposition decision applied to the lot. Accept: lot meets specifications and proceeds. Scrap: lot is discarded. Rework: lot requires reprocessing. Downgrade: lot is reassigned to lower grade. Hold: lot is quarantined pending review. Ship-as-is: lot ships with known deviations under waiver.

attributes.name: executed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that executed the disposition action. Captures who performed the physical disposition.

attributes.name: executed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition action was physically executed. Represents the moment when the lot was scrapped, moved to rework, or released.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the disposition decision in USD. Includes scrap cost, rework cost, or revenue loss from downgrade. Used for cost accounting and yield loss reporting.

attributes.name: good_die_count
attributes.description: Total number of Known Good Die (KGD) across all wafers in the lot at the time of disposition. Used for yield accounting and financial valuation.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for hold disposition. Links to the hold reason reference table for detailed hold classification and tracking.

attributes.name: lot_yield_percent
attributes.description: Calculated yield percentage for the lot at disposition time. Represents the ratio of good die to total die, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause that triggered the disposition decision. Used for Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and continuous improvement.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause analysis findings. Captures the specific failure mode, contributing factors, and technical details.

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for scrap disposition. Links to the scrap reason reference table for detailed scrap classification and reporting.

attributes.name: waiver_number
attributes.description: Engineering waiver authorization number if disposition type is ship-as-is. Format: WVR-YYYYMMDD-XXXX. Authorizes shipment of lot with known deviations.

products.name: fab_run_card
products.description: Master traveler document associated with a wafer lot defining the approved process flow, special instructions, engineering deviations, customer-specific requirements, and step-level notes for a given lot run. Captures run card version, approval status, deviation flags, and associated engineering change orders. Sourced from Camstar MES and Oracle Agile PLM.

attributes.name: fab_run_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabrication run card. Primary key for the fab run card entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this lot is being fabricated. Enables tracking of customer-specific requirements and instructions.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Run Card approval must be traceable to an employee for quality and compliance audits.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Run card execution costs are charged to a cost center for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Export Control compliance requires each fab run card to reference the export license authorizing production of the controlled technology, used in Export License Management reports.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility where this run card is executed. Supports multi-site manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved process flow that defines the sequence of fabrication steps (Front End of Line (FEOL), Middle of Line (MOL), Back End of Line (BEOL)) for this wafer lot.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.technology_node. Business justification: Run card includes technology node information; replace string column with FK to technology_node.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot that this run card governs. Links the run card to the specific lot being processed through the fabrication line.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being manufactured. Links the run card to the specific Integrated Circuit (IC), System on Chip (SoC), or Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) design.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IC design project or tapeout that this run card supports. Links to the Register Transfer Level (RTL), Graphic Data System II (GDSII), and Process Design Kit (PDK) used.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit center performance reporting includes fab run card production output and associated revenue.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Links Run Card to the purchase order of consumables, enabling run cost allocation and audit of material usage per lot.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this run card was formally approved for manufacturing execution. Marks the transition from draft to approved status.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer lot completed all process steps defined in this run card. Marks the end of the fabrication cycle. Null if lot is still in process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this run card record was first created in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: cycle_time_days
attributes.description: Actual or planned cycle time for this run card from start to completion, measured in days. Key metric for manufacturing efficiency and Time to Market (TTM).

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any engineering deviations, process exceptions, or non-standard procedures authorized for this run card. Null if no deviations exist.

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this run card contains any approved engineering deviations from the standard process flow. True indicates deviations are present.

attributes.name: ear_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) classification code for this run card, if applicable. Governs export control compliance for semiconductor technology.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Order (ECO) associated with this run card, if applicable. Links to formal change management documentation.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this run card is currently under a manufacturing hold. True indicates the lot cannot proceed until the hold is released.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the run card is on hold, if applicable. May reference quality issues, engineering review, or customer requests. Null if no hold exists.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this run card is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control restrictions. True indicates ITAR-controlled technology.
attributes.references: ITAR - International Traffic in Arms Regulations

attributes.name: lot_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition status of the wafer lot upon run card completion: pass (meets all specifications), fail (rejected), conditional (partial acceptance), quarantine (under review), or scrap (discarded).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this run card record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes to the run card throughout its lifecycle.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General notes, comments, or observations recorded during the execution of this run card. Captures operator feedback, process anomalies, or engineering observations.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Product Change Notification (PCN) number if this run card implements a customer-notified product change. Ensures traceability to customer communications.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Manufacturing priority assigned to this run card. Determines scheduling precedence on the fabrication line. Critical lots receive expedited processing.

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Quality and reliability grade for this run card: automotive (IATF 16949 compliant), industrial (extended temperature/reliability), commercial (standard), or consumer (cost-optimized).

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the process materials comply with Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) regulation requirements.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the process materials and chemicals used in this run card comply with Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) directive requirements.
attributes.references: RoHS Directive - EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances

attributes.name: run_card_follows_flow
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.process_flow.process_flow_id — Run cards define the approved process flow for a lot run.

attributes.name: run_card_for_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot.fabrication_wafer_lot_id — Run cards (travelers) are associated with specific lots as their manufacturing instructions.

attributes.name: run_card_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business identifier for this run card. Human-readable traveler document number used by operators and engineers to reference this specific run card.

attributes.name: run_card_specifies_flow
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.process_flow.process_flow_id — Run card defines the approved process flow for the lot. Required for routing compliance verification.

attributes.name: run_card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the run card: draft (being prepared), approved (ready for use), active (lot in process), on_hold (temporarily suspended), completed (lot finished), or cancelled (run card voided).

attributes.name: run_card_type
attributes.description: Classification of the run card based on its purpose: production (standard manufacturing), engineering (experimental or test lots), qualification (product validation), rework (reprocessing), pilot (pre-production), or development (process development).

attributes.name: run_card_version
attributes.description: Version number of the run card document. Tracks revisions and updates to the process flow or instructions for this lot.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing operator instructions, handling requirements, or process notes specific to this run card. May include customer-specific requirements or engineering guidance.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer lot began processing under this run card. Marks the beginning of the fabrication cycle for this lot.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or committed completion date for this run card. Used for scheduling, capacity planning, and customer delivery commitments.

attributes.name: wafer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot governed by this run card. Tracks lot size for capacity planning and yield calculations.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafers in this lot, measured in millimeters (e.g., 200mm, 300mm, 450mm). Determines compatible equipment and handling procedures.
attributes.references: SEMI M1 - Specifications for Polished Monocrystalline Silicon Wafers

products.name: equipment_run
products.description: Transactional record of a specific equipment tool run (chamber run, process run) executed on a wafer lot or wafer set. Captures tool ID, chamber ID, run start/end timestamps, recipe name and version, process type discriminator (CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, implant, etch, lithography, anneal, clean, wet clean), actual vs. target parameter deviations, run status, and wafers processed. Process-type-specific parameters stored as structured attributes: implant (species, dose, energy, tilt, twist, beam current), deposition (film material, thickness, rate, precursor flows, uniformity), CMP (slurry type, removal rate, WIWNU, endpoint detection), lithography (reticle ID, exposure dose, focus offset, overlay, CD measurement). Unified model aligned with SEMI E10/E142 equipment event patterns. SSOT for all FAB process execution records.
products.reference: SmartFactory MES Equipment Run / SEMI E10 / SEMI E30

attributes.name: equipment_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment run. Primary key for this transactional record of a specific tool chamber run executed on a wafer lot or wafer set.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: Equipment Run Usage Billing links each equipment run to the customer invoice that captures per‑run usage fees.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Equipment run cost accounting allocates depreciation and overhead to the cost center responsible for the run.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FAB operator who initiated or supervised this equipment run. Used for accountability and training tracking.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fabrication equipment tool that executed this run. Links to the equipment master record.

attributes.name: fabrication_photomask_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the photomask reticle used in lithography exposure. Links to the photomask asset inventory. Applicable only when process_type is lithography.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_recipe_id
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_process_recipe.fabrication_process_recipe_id — Equipment runs execute a specific recipe version. Links actual processing to recipe management.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the process step within the overall fabrication flow. Links this run to the routing and process flow definition.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the wafer lot processed in this equipment run. Links to the wafer lot master record for WIP tracking and genealogy.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Supports Equipment Run Material Consumption Log, associating chemicals/materials used in each run with their master record for SPC and safety compliance.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.recipe. Business justification: Equipment run must reference the exact process recipe applied; essential for audit, yield analysis, and SPC control.

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific process chamber within the equipment tool where this run was executed. Multi-chamber tools may have multiple concurrent runs.

attributes.name: abort_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if the run was aborted or failed. Used for root cause analysis and yield improvement.

attributes.name: actual_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Actual measured chamber pressure in Torr during the run. Used for process control and deviation analysis.

attributes.name: actual_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Actual measured process temperature in degrees Celsius during the run. Used for process control and deviation analysis.

attributes.name: alarm_count
attributes.description: Number of equipment alarms triggered during this run. Indicator of process stability and equipment health.

attributes.name: cmp_removal_rate_angstrom_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Removal Rate Angstrom Per Minute
attributes.description: Material removal rate during CMP in Angstroms per minute. Critical parameter for planarization control and endpoint detection.

attributes.name: cmp_slurry_type
attributes.description: Type of slurry used in CMP process (e.g., oxide slurry, tungsten slurry, copper slurry). Applicable only when process_type is CMP.

attributes.name: cmp_wiwnu_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Percent
attributes.description: Within-wafer non-uniformity percentage for CMP process. Measures variation in material removal across the wafer surface. Lower values indicate better planarization quality.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment run record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: deposition_film_material
attributes.description: Material deposited during CVD, PVD, or ALD runs (e.g., SiO2, Si3N4, TiN, Tungsten, Copper). Applicable for deposition process types.

attributes.name: deposition_rate_angstrom_per_min
attributes.description: Film deposition rate in Angstroms per minute. Used for process control and cycle time optimization.

attributes.name: deposition_thickness_angstrom
attributes.description: Target or measured film thickness in Angstroms deposited during the run. Critical parameter for film uniformity and device performance.

attributes.name: deposition_uniformity_percent
attributes.description: Film thickness uniformity across the wafer expressed as a percentage. Lower values indicate better uniformity. Critical quality metric for deposition processes.

attributes.name: implant_dose_atoms_per_cm2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Implant Dose Atoms Per Square Centimeter
attributes.description: Total ion dose implanted in atoms per square centimeter. Critical parameter for doping concentration control in ion implantation processes.

attributes.name: implant_energy_kev
attributes.description: Ion beam energy in kiloelectron volts (keV) for ion implantation. Determines the depth of ion penetration into the wafer substrate.

attributes.name: implant_species
attributes.description: Ion species implanted during ion implantation runs (e.g., Boron, Phosphorus, Arsenic, BF2). Applicable only when process_type is implant.

attributes.name: implant_tilt_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Wafer tilt angle in degrees during ion implantation. Used to control channeling effects and implant profile.

attributes.name: implant_twist_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Wafer twist (rotation) angle in degrees during ion implantation. Used in conjunction with tilt to control channeling effects.

attributes.name: lithography_cd_measurement_nm
attributes.description: Measured critical dimension (CD) in nanometers after lithography exposure and development. Key quality metric for pattern fidelity.

attributes.name: lithography_exposure_dose_mj_per_cm2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lithography Exposure Dose Millijoules Per Square Centimeter
attributes.description: Exposure energy dose in millijoules per square centimeter for lithography. Critical parameter for pattern transfer and critical dimension (CD) control.

attributes.name: lithography_focus_offset_nm
attributes.description: Focus offset in nanometers applied during lithography exposure. Used for depth-of-focus optimization and process window control.

attributes.name: lithography_overlay_x_nm
attributes.description: Measured overlay error in the X-axis direction in nanometers. Indicates alignment accuracy between successive lithography layers.

attributes.name: lithography_overlay_y_nm
attributes.description: Measured overlay error in the Y-axis direction in nanometers. Indicates alignment accuracy between successive lithography layers.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Transaction identifier from the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that recorded this equipment run. Provides traceability to the source system.

attributes.name: process_type
attributes.description: Discriminator identifying the category of fabrication process executed in this run. Determines which process-specific parameters are relevant. CVD=Chemical Vapor Deposition, PVD=Physical Vapor Deposition, ALD=Atomic Layer Deposition, CMP=Chemical Mechanical Planarization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CVD|PVD|ALD|CMP|implant|etch|lithography|anneal|clean|wet_clean|diffusion|oxidation|metrology — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: processes_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Equipment run must reference the lot/wafers being processed. Core traceability requirement for process parameter linkage to product.

attributes.name: run_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the equipment run in seconds, calculated from start to end timestamp. Used for cycle time analysis and equipment utilization metrics.

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the equipment run completed processing. Marks the end of the process execution cycle.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this equipment run, typically assigned by the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Used for operational tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: run_processes_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot.fabrication_wafer_lot_id — Equipment runs are executed on wafer lots. This is the core tool-to-WIP linkage.

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the equipment run started processing. Marks the beginning of the process execution cycle.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the equipment run. Indicates whether the run completed successfully, was aborted, failed due to error, is currently in progress, or was paused.

attributes.name: run_uses_recipe
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.process_recipe.process_recipe_id — Every equipment run executes a specific process recipe. Critical for recipe traceability, excursion investigation, and process control.

attributes.name: target_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Target chamber pressure in Torr as specified by the recipe. Critical control parameter for vacuum and deposition processes.

attributes.name: target_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target process temperature in degrees Celsius as specified by the recipe. Critical control parameter for thermal processes.

attributes.name: uses_recipe
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.process_recipe.process_recipe_id — Every equipment run executes a specific recipe. Required for recipe-to-outcome traceability and process capability analysis.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers processed in this equipment run. Batch size for the run.

attributes.name: wafer_slot_map
attributes.description: Mapping of wafer identifiers to slot positions within the carrier or chamber. Structured representation of wafer placement during processing.

products.name: photomask
products.description: Master record for photomasks (reticles) used in EUV and DUV lithography operations, capturing mask set ID, layer name, technology node, mask type (binary, PSM, EUV pellicle), OPC version, MEEF value, mask generation, pellicle status, inspection history summary, usage count, cleaning cycle count, and retirement threshold. SSOT for mask inventory, lithography step qualification, and reticle lifecycle management within the FAB.
products.reference: SEMI P1 / SEMI P10 Mask Standard

attributes.name: photomask_id
attributes.description: Primary key for photomask

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the IC design project for which this mask was created. Links mask to product design lineage and tapeout records.
attributes.references: SEMI P39 - Specification for Reticle Identification

attributes.name: mask_set_id
attributes.description: Business identifier for the complete mask set to which this photomask belongs. A mask set comprises all reticles required for a complete wafer fabrication process flow.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: reticle_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.reticle_set. Business justification: Photomask belongs to a reticle set; adding reticle_set_id FK groups masks for lithography and eliminates reticle_set silo.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Ensures Photomask Supplier Traceability required by mask qualification and export control audits linking each mask to its supplier record.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total cost paid to acquire this photomask including mask fabrication, OPC, inspection, and shipping. Denominated in USD. Used for asset valuation and depreciation.

attributes.name: cd_uniformity_specification
attributes.description: Maximum allowed CD variation across the mask field in nanometers (3-sigma). Tighter specifications required for advanced nodes. Typical range 1-5nm.
attributes.references: SEMI P44 - Guide for Reporting Optical Characteristics of Photomasks

attributes.name: cleaning_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of times this mask has undergone wet or dry cleaning to remove particles and contamination. Excessive cleaning can damage mask patterns.
attributes.references: SEMI P38 - Guide for Photomask Cleaning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this photomask record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: critical_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of critical (killer) defects that will print on wafer and cause yield loss. Subset of total defect count. Mask must be retired or repaired when this exceeds threshold.
attributes.references: SEMI P40 - Guide for Reporting Photomask Defects

attributes.name: critical_dimension_target_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension (minimum feature size) for this mask layer in nanometers. Used to verify mask pattern fidelity and wafer print quality.
attributes.references: SEMI P44 - Guide for Reporting Optical Characteristics of Photomasks

attributes.name: cumulative_exposure_hours
attributes.description: Total hours this mask has been exposed to lithography light source (EUV or DUV). Tracks photochemical degradation and pellicle aging.

attributes.name: cumulative_usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafer exposures performed with this mask since first use. Primary metric for mask wear tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: defect_count_last_inspection
attributes.description: Number of defects detected during the most recent mask inspection. Tracked to monitor mask degradation and determine cleaning or retirement needs.
attributes.references: SEMI P40 - Guide for Reporting Photomask Defects

attributes.name: defect_retirement_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum critical defect count allowed before mask must be retired or sent for repair. Typically 1-5 defects depending on technology node and layer criticality.
attributes.references: SEMI P40 - Guide for Reporting Photomask Defects

attributes.name: gds_file_checksum
attributes.description: MD5 or SHA-256 checksum of the GDSII file used to generate this mask. Ensures mask-to-design traceability and detects unauthorized pattern changes.
attributes.references: SEMI P39 - Specification for Reticle Identification

attributes.name: last_cleaning_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask was last cleaned. Used to schedule preventive cleaning and correlate defect growth with cleaning intervals.
attributes.references: SEMI P38 - Guide for Photomask Cleaning

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent mask inspection performed by KLA or equivalent metrology tool. Used to enforce periodic inspection schedules.
attributes.references: SEMI P40 - Guide for Reporting Photomask Defects

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this photomask record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change auditing.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Process layer designation for which this photomask is used (e.g., POLY, METAL1, VIA2, CONTACT). Corresponds to the GDS layer in the design database.
attributes.references: SEMI P39 - Specification for Reticle Identification

attributes.name: lithography_wavelength
attributes.description: Exposure wavelength for which this mask is optimized: EUV (13.5nm), DUV ArF (193nm), DUV KrF (248nm), or i-line (365nm).
attributes.references: SEMI P44 - Guide for Reporting Optical Characteristics of Photomasks

attributes.name: mask_generation
attributes.description: Generation number of this mask within the mask set. Incremented when a mask is replaced due to defects, pattern revisions, or wear-out. Generation 1 is the original mask.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: mask_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the mask shop vendor for traceability and warranty purposes. Engraved on the reticle substrate.
attributes.references: SEMI P1 - Specification for Photomask Substrates

attributes.name: mask_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the photomask: qualified (ready for production), in production (actively used), in inspection, in cleaning, in repair, quarantined (defect investigation), retired (end of life), or scrapped (disposed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qualified|in_production|in_inspection|in_cleaning|in_repair|quarantined|retired|scrapped — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: mask_type
attributes.description: Classification of photomask technology: binary (chrome on glass), attenuated phase shift mask (PSM), alternating PSM, EUV with pellicle, EUV without pellicle, or OPC-enhanced mask.
attributes.references: SEMI P40 - Guide for Reporting Photomask Defects

attributes.name: meef_value
attributes.description: Mask Error Enhancement Factor quantifying how mask pattern errors are amplified on the wafer. Higher MEEF indicates greater sensitivity to mask defects. Typical range 1.0 to 8.0.
attributes.references: SEMI P48 - Guide for Characterization of Mask Error Enhancement Factor

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory mask inspection. Calculated based on usage count, exposure hours, or calendar interval per mask management policy.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording mask-specific observations, special handling instructions, repair history, or other contextual information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: opc_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the OPC software and recipe used to generate the mask pattern. Critical for mask-to-mask consistency and reticle enhancement technology tracking.
attributes.references: SEMI P47 - Guide for Reporting Optical Proximity Correction

attributes.name: pellicle_installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the current pellicle was installed on the mask. Used to track pellicle aging and replacement cycles.
attributes.references: SEMI P36 - Specification for Pellicle Mounting

attributes.name: pellicle_status
attributes.description: Current status of the protective pellicle membrane: installed (protecting mask surface), removed (for inspection or repair), damaged (requires replacement), or not applicable (EUV masks without pellicle).
attributes.references: SEMI P36 - Specification for Pellicle Mounting

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which this mask was procured. Links mask asset to procurement and financial records.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask passed final qualification inspection and was approved for production use. Marks the start of the masks production lifecycle.
attributes.references: SEMI P39 - Specification for Reticle Identification

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask was received from the vendor and logged into the FAB inventory system. Marks the start of the masks asset lifecycle.

attributes.name: registration_error_specification_nm
attributes.description: Maximum allowed pattern placement error relative to alignment marks in nanometers. Critical for layer-to-layer overlay accuracy. Typical range 2-10nm.
attributes.references: SEMI P44 - Guide for Reporting Optical Characteristics of Photomasks

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask was retired from production due to reaching usage threshold, excessive defects, or process obsolescence. Null if mask is still active.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for mask retirement: usage limit reached, defect limit exceeded, pattern revision required, process obsolescence, physical damage, or lost/missing.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical storage location (reticle pod, SMIF pod, or automated reticle storage system slot) where the mask is currently stored when not in use.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor process technology node for which this mask was designed (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm). Defines minimum feature size and design rules.
attributes.references: ITRS Roadmap - International Technology Roadmap for Semiconductors

attributes.name: usage_retirement_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative usage count allowed before mask must be retired from production. Defined per technology node and mask type to ensure yield protection.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Reticle Storage and Handling

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor warranty for this mask expires. After this date, repair or replacement costs are borne by the FAB.

products.name: fabrication_lot_genealogy
products.description: Association entity capturing parent-child relationships between wafer lots arising from lot splits, lot merges, rework re-entry, and MPW lot separation events. Records relationship type, split/merge timestamp, wafer count transferred, and traceability linkage. Authoritative source for wafer genealogy and lot traceability across the FAB.

attributes.name: fabrication_lot_genealogy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabrication lot genealogy relationship record. Primary key for the association entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer for whom the lot genealogy event was performed. Used for customer-specific lot tracking and MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) separation.

attributes.name: child_lot_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child wafer lot created from the parent lot. References the resulting lot in split, merge, or rework operations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FAB operator who executed the genealogy event. Used for accountability and process audit trails.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FAB equipment or tool used to perform the lot split, merge, or rework operation. Enables equipment-specific traceability.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the FAB operation or process step where the genealogy event occurred. Links to the specific manufacturing operation in the process flow.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the semiconductor product or design associated with the lot genealogy event. Links to the IC (Integrated Circuit) design or ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) being fabricated.

attributes.name: primary_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent wafer lot from which the child lot originated. References the source lot in split, merge, or rework operations.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the process recipe or procedure used during the genealogy event. Captures the specific process parameters and settings applied.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing work order authorizing the genealogy event. Links the lot transformation to production planning and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the genealogy event was performed to meet regulatory or customer compliance requirements. True for ITAR, EAR, or customer-mandated lot segregation.
attributes.references: ITAR - International Traffic in Arms Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this genealogy record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: destination_fab_line
attributes.description: Identifier of the FAB production line where the child lot was routed after the genealogy event. Tracks lot movement across production lines.

attributes.name: is_reversible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the genealogy relationship can be reversed or undone. True for temporary splits or holds that can be re-merged; false for permanent transformations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this genealogy record was last updated. Audit trail for record modifications.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) that recorded the genealogy event. Enables integration with Camstar or Applied Materials SmartFactory systems.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or special instructions related to the lot genealogy event. Used for capturing context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the genealogy event. Influences scheduling and resource allocation for the resulting child lot.

attributes.name: process_stage
attributes.description: Major process stage where the genealogy event occurred. FEOL (Front End of Line) for transistor formation, MOL (Middle of Line) for contacts, or BEOL (Back End of Line) for interconnects.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the genealogy event was triggered by a quality hold or defect isolation requirement. True if the split or rework was quality-driven.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the lot genealogy event. Examples include capacity balancing, defect isolation, customer priority, or process optimization.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the lot split, merge, or rework was performed. Provides context for genealogy analysis and root cause investigation.

attributes.name: relationship_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot genealogy relationship was established. Records the exact moment of the split, merge, or rework event in the FAB.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of genealogy relationship between parent and child lots. Defines the nature of the lot transformation event.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a reversible genealogy relationship was reversed or undone. Null if the relationship has not been reversed or is not reversible.

attributes.name: source_fab_line
attributes.description: Identifier of the FAB production line where the parent lot was located before the genealogy event. Enables cross-line traceability.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Process technology node of the wafer lots involved in the genealogy event. Examples include 7nm, 5nm, 3nm FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor) or GAA (Gate All Around) technologies.

attributes.name: traceability_code
attributes.description: Unique traceability identifier linking this genealogy event to upstream and downstream lot history. Enables end-to-end wafer genealogy tracking across the entire FAB process flow.

attributes.name: wafer_count_transferred
attributes.description: Number of wafers transferred from parent lot to child lot during the genealogy event. Critical for WIP (Work in Process) tracking and yield analysis.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the wafers involved in the genealogy event, measured in millimeters. Standard values include 200mm, 300mm, or 450mm wafers.

products.name: fabrication_technology_node
products.description: Reference master for semiconductor technology nodes supported in the FAB, capturing node name (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm), node generation, transistor architecture (planar, FinFET, GAA), minimum feature size, metal layer count, PDK version reference, qualification status, and production readiness date. SSOT for node-level process and product classification.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the semiconductor technology node record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary fabrication facility where this technology node is manufactured. Links to the fab facility master data.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technology node record is currently active and available for use in manufacturing and design operations. False indicates archived or deprecated nodes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this technology node record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: design_rule_complexity
attributes.description: Complexity level of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rules required for this node. Higher complexity nodes require more sophisticated Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) and restricted design rules.
attributes.references: SEMI P39 Design for Manufacturability Standards

attributes.name: dfm_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design for Manufacturability (DFM) checks and optimizations are mandatory for designs targeting this node. True for advanced nodes requiring OPC, dummy fill, and restricted design rules.

attributes.name: dft_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design for Testability (DFT) structures (scan chains, BIST, ATPG patterns) are required for designs on this node. Ensures adequate test coverage for quality assurance.
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1 JTAG Standards, SEMI E142 Test Standards

attributes.name: ear_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) for this technology node. Determines export licensing requirements to restricted countries.
attributes.references: EAR 15 CFR 730-774, US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the technology node was officially announced for end-of-life phase-out. Triggers Product Change Notification (PCN) and Last Time Buy (LTB) processes for customers.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: iatf16949_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Automotive Task Force (IATF) 16949 Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technology node is certified under IATF 16949 Automotive Quality Management standards, required for automotive-grade semiconductor production.

attributes.name: iso9001_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing process for this technology node is certified under ISO 9001 Quality Management System standards.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technology node is subject to ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) export controls due to defense or aerospace applications. Restricts international technology transfer.
attributes.references: ITAR 22 CFR 120-130, US Department of State

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this technology node record was last updated. Tracks data currency and change history for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: lithography_technology
attributes.description: Primary lithography technology used for patterning in this node. DUV (Deep Ultraviolet) for mature nodes, EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) for advanced nodes below 7nm.

attributes.name: mask_set_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost of a full photomask set for this technology node in US dollars. Significant cost driver for advanced nodes using EUV lithography. Business-confidential pricing data.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 Photomask Standards, Internal Procurement

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers available in the Back End of Line (BEOL) stack for this technology node. Typically ranges from 6 to 15+ layers depending on node complexity.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards, Process Design Kit (PDK) Specification

attributes.name: minimum_feature_size_nm
attributes.description: The smallest feature dimension that can be reliably manufactured in this technology node, measured in nanometers. Critical dimension for lithography and patterning capability.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this technology node record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code used to uniquely identify the technology node in manufacturing execution systems and product lifecycle management systems.

attributes.name: node_generation
attributes.description: Generation classification of the node (e.g., Leading Edge, Mature, Legacy). Indicates the relative maturity and market positioning of the process technology.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm, 65nm, 90nm). Industry-standard designation for the process generation.

attributes.name: nre_cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) cost in US dollars for a typical design tapeout on this technology node. Includes mask set costs, design services, and qualification expenses. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Process Design Kit (PDK) that defines the design rules, device models, and technology files for this node. Used by EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tools.
attributes.references: EDA Tool Integration Standards, Cadence/Synopsys PDK Specifications

attributes.name: power_performance_area_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative or quantitative assessment of the node's Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) characteristics relative to prior generations. Critical metric for competitive positioning.
attributes.references: IEEE Solid-State Circuits Standards, ITRS Benchmarking

attributes.name: process_flow_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the manufacturing process flow (sequence of FEOL, MOL, BEOL steps) defined for this technology node. Tracks process recipe evolution and engineering changes.
attributes.references: MES Process Recipe Management, SEMI E120 CIM Framework

attributes.name: production_readiness_date
attributes.description: Date when the technology node was certified as production-ready and available for high-volume manufacturing (HVM). Null if still in development or qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the technology node. Development: R&D phase. Qualification: undergoing reliability and yield validation. Qualified: approved for production. Production: active manufacturing. Mature: stable high-volume. EOL (End of Life): phase-out planned.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Equipment Reliability Standards, Internal Quality Management

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemicals and materials used in this technology node comply with EU REACH Regulation for chemical safety and substance registration.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing process for this technology node complies with EU RoHS Directive restrictions on hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.).

attributes.name: supported_application_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of target application domains optimized for this node (e.g., Mobile, Automotive, AI/ML, IoT, High-Performance Computing, Networking). Guides product design-in decisions.

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of good dies per wafer for this technology node at maturity. Key performance indicator for manufacturing efficiency and cost competitiveness.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Equipment Reliability Standards, SPC (Statistical Process Control)

attributes.name: transistor_architecture
attributes.description: Type of transistor structure used in this technology node. Planar for older nodes, FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor) for 22nm-7nm, GAA (Gate All Around) for 3nm and below.
attributes.references: IEEE Electron Devices Society Standards, ITRS

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Standard wafer diameter supported by this technology node, typically 200mm (8-inch) or 300mm (12-inch). Determines fab equipment compatibility and die yield economics.

products.name: fab_yield_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing wafer-level and lot-level yield outcomes at key FAB inline checkpoints (post-FEOL, post-MOL, post-BEOL, pre-probe), recording gross die count, good die count, yield percentage, yield loss pareto by category (process, design, random defect, systematic), bin-level yield breakdown, and yield excursion flags. SSOT for FAB inline yield data distinct from final test yield (owned by test domain) and distinct from SPC/metrology analysis (owned by quality domain).

attributes.name: fab_yield_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FAB yield record. Primary key for this transactional yield capture event.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Yield loss financial impact is allocated to the cost center overseeing the wafer lot.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator or technician who performed the yield measurement. Supports traceability and training effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the FAB facility where this yield measurement was captured. Enables multi-site yield comparison and benchmarking.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inspection or metrology equipment used to capture this yield measurement (e.g., KLA ICOS system). Enables equipment-specific yield correlation.

attributes.name: fab_wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer for which yield is being recorded. Links to the wafer master record in the fabrication domain.

attributes.name: fabrication_photomask_id
attributes.description: Reference to the photomask set used for lithography on this wafer. Enables correlation of yield to mask quality and OPC effectiveness.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process route or recipe used for this wafer. Links yield outcomes to specific process flows.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.technology_node. Business justification: Yield record captures technology node; add FK to technology_node and remove redundant numeric column.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot to which this yield record belongs. Enables lot-level yield aggregation and genealogy tracking.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Enables Yield Dashboard to aggregate yields per IC catalog product.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Yield analysis reports are aggregated per design project; direct FK enables automated project‑level yield dashboards and root‑cause tracking.

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer.wafer_id — Yield records can be at wafer level for per-wafer yield tracking. Required for wafer-level yield maps and die-level analysis.

attributes.name: bin_1_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified into bin 1 (typically highest quality/performance bin). Part of bin-level yield breakdown.

attributes.name: bin_2_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified into bin 2 (typically second-tier quality/performance bin). Part of bin-level yield breakdown.

attributes.name: bin_3_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified into bin 3 (typically third-tier quality/performance bin). Part of bin-level yield breakdown.

attributes.name: checkpoint_code
attributes.description: The FAB inline checkpoint at which this yield measurement was captured. Distinguishes FEOL, MOL, BEOL, and pre-probe stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: POST_FEOL|POST_MOL|POST_BEOL|PRE_PROBE|POST_CMP|POST_LITHO|POST_ETCH|POST_IMPLANT|INLINE_INSPECTION — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes about this yield measurement, including observations, anomalies, or contextual information for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: control_limit_lower
attributes.description: Lower control limit for yield percentage at this checkpoint. Part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring.

attributes.name: control_limit_upper
attributes.description: Upper control limit for yield percentage at this checkpoint. Part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring.

attributes.name: design_loss_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die lost due to design-related issues (DFM violations, timing failures, functional failures). Part of yield loss pareto analysis.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: The disposition decision for the wafer or lot based on this yield measurement. Determines next processing step or lot hold.

attributes.name: excursion_severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the yield excursion event. Determines escalation path and response urgency.

attributes.name: good_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die that passed yield criteria at this checkpoint. Represents the actual usable die count after defect screening and binning.

attributes.name: gross_die_count
attributes.description: Total number of die on the wafer before yield screening. Represents the theoretical maximum die count based on wafer size and die layout.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code if the wafer or lot was placed on hold due to yield excursion. Links to hold reason reference data.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the yield measurement was captured at the inline checkpoint. Represents the business event time of the yield observation.

attributes.name: process_loss_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die lost due to process-related defects (CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, etch, implant issues). Part of yield loss pareto analysis.

attributes.name: random_defect_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die lost due to random defects (particles, contamination, handling damage). Part of yield loss pareto analysis.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this yield record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this yield record was last updated in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: reject_bin_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified into reject bins (failed die that do not meet minimum specifications). Part of bin-level yield breakdown.

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this wafer is eligible for rework based on yield results. Drives rework routing decisions.

attributes.name: scrap_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this wafer should be scrapped based on yield results. Triggers scrap disposition and cost accounting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The Manufacturing Execution System (MES) or inspection system that generated this yield record (e.g., Applied Materials SmartFactory, Camstar, KLA ICOS).

attributes.name: specification_limit_lower
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for yield percentage at this checkpoint. Represents minimum acceptable yield threshold.

attributes.name: systematic_defect_die_count
attributes.description: Number of die lost due to systematic defects (OPC errors, MEEF issues, lithography hotspots). Part of yield loss pareto analysis.

attributes.name: yield_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this yield record represents an excursion event (yield below control limits or specification). Triggers root cause analysis and corrective action.

attributes.name: yield_for_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot.fabrication_wafer_lot_id — Yield records are captured at lot level at key FAB checkpoints.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated yield percentage at this checkpoint (good_die_count / gross_die_count * 100). Primary yield metric for FAB inline performance tracking.

attributes.name: yield_record_for_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Yield records reference the lot measured. Required for lot-level yield tracking and excursion detection.

domains.name: design
domains.description: IC design and architecture lifecycle from RTL specification through GDS/GDSII tapeout. Manages IP cores, PDK libraries, EDA tool flows, DFM and DFT rule sets, logic synthesis, physical design, timing closure data, and MPW shuttle assignments. Integrates with Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys Design Compiler, and PrimeTime for design data provenance.

products.name: ic_design_project
products.description: Master record for an IC design project lifecycle from RTL specification through GDS/GDSII tapeout. Captures project identity, target process node, design type (ASIC, SoC, FPGA), PPA targets (power budget, clock frequency, die area), tapeout milestone dates, NRE budget, design team assignments, EDA tool suite version, hierarchical block decomposition, and PLM integration references. SSOT for all design project metadata including block-level partitioning. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and Oracle Agile PLM.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the IC design project record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Required for project accounting and billing reports linking each design project to the commissioning customer account.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Project cost accounting requires linking each design project to a cost center for monthly expense reporting and budget control.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the lead IC design engineer responsible for the project, sourced from Workday HCM. Used for design team assignment, accountability tracking, and PLM workflow approvals.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Export license required for each design project before international shipment; regulatory export‑control process mandates linking project to its license.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fab_tool. Business justification: Manufacturing planning links each design project to the fab tool that will produce it, essential for the 'Production Scheduling' report.

attributes.name: foundry_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Foundry selection contract for each design project; required for manufacturing cost tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Required for Product Lifecycle Management: design project outcome is recorded as a catalog entry for sales, production planning, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Internal orders track project‑specific capital expenditures and commitments in the ERP system.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the engineering team assigned to this IC design project in Workday HCM and Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Supports resource utilization reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: FK to design.pdk.pdk_id — Every IC design project targets a specific PDK version. This determines all design rules, standard cells, and device models available. Fundamental design constraint.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the foundry-specific Process Design Kit (PDK) used for this project (e.g., 'TSMC N5P', 'Samsung SF3E'). Links to the PDK library version in the EDA tool environment and governs all DRC/LVS rule sets.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso PDK; Synopsys Design Compiler; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: process_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_technology_node. Business justification: Technology Node Allocation planning uses this FK to tie a design project to the selected process technology node for yield and performance forecasts.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis assigns each design project to a profit center to capture revenue and cost allocation for product line P&L.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Program Management Dashboard requires linking each design project to its originating R&D program for reporting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Linking to a WBS element enables detailed work‑breakdown‑structure budgeting and progress reporting for the design project.

attributes.name: block_count
attributes.description: Number of top-level hierarchical design blocks (partitions) in the IC design. Reflects the block decomposition strategy used for parallel design team assignments and hierarchical physical design in Cadence Innovus.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IEEE Std 1076

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the IC design project record was first created in the system of record (Siemens Teamcenter PLM or Oracle Agile PLM), propagated to the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: design_phase
attributes.description: Indicates the primary fabrication phase scope of the design: Front End of Line (FEOL), Middle of Line (MOL), Back End of Line (BEOL), or full-flow. Governs which process modules and DFM rules are active.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; IEEE Std 1687; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Classification of the integrated circuit design type. Drives NRE cost structure, EDA tool selection, and tapeout process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASIC|SoC|FPGA|ASSP|MCU|GPU|DSP|RFIC|MEMS|Analog — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD21C; IEEE Std 1076 (VHDL); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: dfm_rule_set_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Set Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rule set applied to this project. Governs OPC recipe selection, MEEF corrections, and yield-enhancement layout guidelines provided by the foundry PDK.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus; SEMI Standards; IEEE Std 1687

attributes.name: dft_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design for Testability (DFT) structures (scan chains, BIST, boundary scan) are included in this design. Drives ATPG flow activation, ATE program generation, and KGD qualification planning.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1149.1 (JTAG); IEEE Std 1500; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: eda_tool_suite
attributes.description: Primary EDA tool suite vendor used for this IC design project (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus, Synopsys Design Compiler/PrimeTime, Siemens EDA). Governs tool license allocation and design flow configuration.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Design Compiler; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: eda_tool_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Tool Suite Version
attributes.description: Version string of the primary EDA tool suite certified for this project (e.g., 'Cadence Innovus 21.1', 'Synopsys DC 2022.03'). Ensures design reproducibility and supports audit trails for sign-off certification.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Design Compiler; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification of the IC design project under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Governs technology transfer restrictions, foreign national access controls, and license requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EAR99|ECCN_3E001|ECCN_3E002|ECCN_3E003|ITAR|no_restriction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR 22 CFR 120-130; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: gate_count_target_k
attributes.description: Target logic gate count in thousands of equivalent gates (Kilo-Gates) for the design. Used for complexity estimation, EDA tool capacity planning, and synthesis runtime forecasting in Synopsys Design Compiler.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler; IEEE Std 1076; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: gds_file_path
attributes.description: Storage path or URI of the final GDS/GDSII design database file submitted for tapeout. Provides traceability to the authoritative design artifact in the EDA data management system.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SEMI P10 (GDSII Standard)

attributes.name: iatf_automotive_grade
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IC design project targets automotive-grade qualification per IATF 16949 and AEC-Q100/Q101 standards. Triggers additional FMEA, reliability testing, and DPPM requirements in the quality management workflow.

attributes.name: ip_core_count
attributes.description: Total number of licensed or internally developed Intellectual Property (IP) cores integrated into this IC design project. Drives IP license cost tracking, third-party IP compliance review, and BOM management in Oracle Agile PLM.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IEEE Std 1685 (IP-XACT)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the IC design project record in the source system of record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Primary lithography technology used for critical layer patterning: Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV), Deep Ultraviolet (DUV), multi-patterning DUV, or nanoimprint. Impacts mask cost, OPC complexity, and MEEF considerations.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap; IEEE Photonics Standards

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Number of metal interconnect layers in the BEOL stack for this design. Determines routing resource availability, RC parasitics, and mask set cost. Specified in the PDK and foundry process design rules.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus; SEMI Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle slot assigned to this design for prototype fabrication. Enables cost-sharing across multiple designs on a single wafer run. Null for full-mask production tapeouts.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Foundry MPW Program Guidelines

attributes.name: nre_actual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Cumulative actual NRE expenditure incurred to date for the IC design project in US dollars, as recorded in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. Compared against nre_budget_usd for variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 730

attributes.name: nre_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total approved Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) budget for the IC design project in US dollars. Covers EDA tool licensing, mask set costs, engineering labor, and MPW shuttle fees. Managed in SAP S/4HANA CO cost center planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 730

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Target die packaging technology for this IC design project (e.g., WLCSP, BGA, CoWoS, InFO, flip-chip). Influences die size constraints, I/O pad ring design, and OSAT partner selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WLCSP|BGA|QFN|CoWoS|InFO|flip_chip|TSV|SiP|LGA — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the Process Design Kit (PDK) certified for use in this IC design project. Ensures reproducibility of design rule checks (DRC), layout versus schematic (LVS) verification, and parasitic extraction across the design lifecycle.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Design Compiler; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: plm_item_reference
attributes.description: Native item/object identifier in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or Oracle Agile PLM for this IC design project. Enables bidirectional traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and the authoritative PLM system of record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Target semiconductor fabrication process node in nanometers (e.g., '5nm', '7nm', '28nm'). Determines PDK selection, EDA tool configuration, DFM rule sets, and foundry partner assignment. Critical for PPA target-setting and yield estimation.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap; IEEE Std 1687

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric project identifier assigned at project initiation in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and Oracle Agile PLM. Used across EDA tool flows, NRE contracts, and cross-functional communications as the canonical project reference.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; JEDEC JESD21C

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the IC design project scope, target application domain (e.g., AI accelerator, automotive MCU, IoT SoC), and key design objectives. Supports search, discovery, and executive reporting.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IC design project (e.g., 'Orion SoC Rev2'). Used in PLM dashboards, design reviews, and executive reporting.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: project_start_date
attributes.description: Official start date of the IC design project, corresponding to project kick-off and initial resource allocation in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IC design project from concept through GDS/GDSII tapeout. Drives milestone tracking, resource allocation, and PLM workflow gates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|rtl_design|synthesis|physical_design|verification|tapeout|post_tapeout|cancelled — promote to reference product]
