attributes.references: PDK (Process Design Kit); SEMI Standards; Foundry PDK Release Notes

attributes.name: primetime_version
attributes.description: Version of Synopsys PrimeTime used to execute this STA run (e.g., 'PrimeTime 2023.12-SP3'). Critical for result reproducibility, audit trails, and identifying version-specific timing model differences that may affect sign-off validity.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Semiconductor process technology node in nanometers at which the design is implemented (e.g., '5nm', '7nm', '28nm'). Determines PDK library characteristics, timing model accuracy, and applicable EUV/DUV lithography constraints relevant to STA sign-off.
attributes.references: PDK (Process Design Kit); SEMI Standards; ITRS Roadmap

attributes.name: pvt_corner
attributes.description: Operating corner (Process-Voltage-Temperature) under which this STA run was performed (e.g., 'ss_0p72v_125c' for slow-slow worst-case, 'ff_1p08v_m40c' for fast-fast best-case). Defined by the PDK (Process Design Kit) and critical for sign-off coverage across all operating conditions.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; PDK Corner Definitions; JEDEC JESD79

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the STA run results were formally reviewed and approved by the responsible design engineer or timing closure lead. Null if the run has not yet been reviewed. Required for tapeout sign-off audit trail.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the senior design engineer or timing closure lead who reviewed and approved the results of this STA run. Required for signoff runs as part of the formal design review process before tapeout submission.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: run_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Static Timing Analysis run completed execution in Synopsys PrimeTime. Used to calculate run duration and assess EDA compute resource utilization. Null if the run is still in progress or was aborted.

attributes.name: run_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Wall-clock duration of this STA run in seconds, from job submission to completion. Used for EDA compute resource planning, license utilization tracking, and identifying unusually long runs that may indicate tool or design issues.

attributes.name: run_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric run identifier assigned by the EDA tool flow or MES integration (e.g., 'PT-RUN-20240315-0042'). Used for cross-referencing with Synopsys PrimeTime job logs, Cadence Innovus signoff reports, and Siemens Teamcenter PLM design records.

attributes.name: run_iteration
attributes.description: Sequential iteration number of this STA run within the current design stage and PVT corner. Enables tracking of timing closure convergence across multiple optimization-analysis cycles (e.g., iteration 1 through N until timing closure is achieved).
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; EDA Design Flow Management

attributes.name: run_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to this Static Timing Analysis run, typically encoding the design name, corner, and iteration (e.g., 'soc_top_ss_0p72v_125c_postroute_iter3'). Used for identification in Synopsys PrimeTime run logs and design review meetings.

attributes.name: run_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the design engineer describing the purpose, context, or key findings of this STA run (e.g., 'Post-ECO run after fixing 3 critical paths in clock tree', 'Baseline run for tapeout corner coverage'). Supports design review and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Execution lifecycle status of this STA run job in the EDA tool flow. 'submitted' indicates the job is queued, 'running' indicates active execution, 'completed' indicates successful completion, 'failed' indicates tool error or license failure, 'aborted' indicates user-cancelled run. Distinct from timing_closure_status which reflects the timing result.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; EDA Tool Flow Management

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Static Timing Analysis run was initiated in Synopsys PrimeTime. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this record. Used for tracking timing closure progress over time and correlating with design iteration milestones.

attributes.name: sdc_constraints_version
attributes.description: Version or identifier of the Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC) file used in this STA run. SDC files define clock definitions, input/output delays, and timing exceptions. Versioning ensures traceability of constraint changes across design iterations.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler; Synopsys PrimeTime; SDC Standard

attributes.name: setup_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of setup timing violations (negative setup slack endpoints) reported by Synopsys PrimeTime in this STA run. A value of zero indicates full setup timing closure. Tracked across iterations to measure convergence progress toward tapeout readiness.

attributes.name: spef_version
attributes.description: Version or identifier of the SPEF (Standard Parasitic Exchange Format) file used for parasitic extraction in this STA run. SPEF files contain RC parasitics from the routed layout and directly impact timing accuracy. Null for pre-route analysis stages.

attributes.name: supply_voltage_v
attributes.description: Nominal supply voltage in volts (V) applied for this STA run's PVT corner. Defined by the PDK operating conditions and UPF (Unified Power Format) power intent. Directly impacts cell delay models and timing analysis results.
attributes.references: IEEE 1801 (UPF); PDK Operating Conditions; Synopsys PrimeTime

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Operating temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) for this STA run's PVT corner. Temperature affects transistor characteristics and cell delays. Typical corners range from -40°C (automotive cold) to 125°C (worst-case hot). Defined by the PDK and target application requirements.
attributes.references: PDK Operating Conditions; JEDEC JESD79; IATF 16949 (Automotive)

attributes.name: timing_closure_status
attributes.description: Overall timing closure pass/fail status for this STA run. 'pass' indicates all setup and hold violations are resolved and the design meets timing at the specified PVT corner and clock frequency. 'waived' indicates known violations accepted with engineering sign-off. 'pending_review' indicates results awaiting design team review. Primary KPI for tapeout readiness.

attributes.name: total_hold_negative_slack_ps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Hold Negative Slack (THNS) in Picoseconds
attributes.description: Total Hold Negative Slack (THNS) in picoseconds — the sum of all negative hold slack values across all violating hold endpoints in this STA run. Complements TNS (setup) to provide a complete picture of hold timing closure status.

attributes.name: total_negative_slack_ps
attributes.description: Total Negative Slack (TNS) in picoseconds — the sum of all negative slack values across all violating timing endpoints in this STA run. Indicates the overall magnitude of timing violations in the design. Used alongside WNS to assess timing closure convergence across design iterations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this STA run record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer data product. Tracks updates such as status changes, waiver additions, or review approvals for audit trail and data lineage compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_count
attributes.description: Number of timing violations formally waived with engineering sign-off in this STA run. Waivers are granted for violations on non-critical paths, test-mode-only paths, or paths with functional justification. Tracked for tapeout risk assessment and compliance with design review processes.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: worst_hold_slack_ps
attributes.description: Worst Hold Slack (WHS) in picoseconds for hold timing analysis in this STA run. Represents the most critical hold violation — the largest shortfall in minimum path delay. Negative values indicate hold violations that must be fixed before tapeout. Applicable when analysis_mode includes hold or setup_hold.

attributes.name: worst_negative_slack_ps
attributes.description: Worst Negative Slack (WNS) in picoseconds reported by Synopsys PrimeTime for this STA run. Represents the most critical timing violation — the largest shortfall between required and actual signal arrival time. A value of 0 or positive indicates no setup/hold violation on the worst path. Key metric for timing closure tracking.

products.name: physical_layout
products.description: Physical design layout record representing the floorplan, placement, clock tree, and routing state of an IC design at a specific stage in the physical implementation flow. Captures die dimensions and core area, cell utilization percentage, routing congestion metrics by metal layer, DRC violation count and categories, LVS clean status, metal layer stack usage and fill density, power grid IR-drop analysis results, clock tree synthesis (CTS) metrics (skew, insertion delay), electromigration compliance status, antenna rule violations, and GDS/GDSII or OASIS file reference. Tracks physical design iterations from initial floorplan through final tapeout-ready layout in Cadence Innovus, Synopsys ICC2, or Siemens Aprisa. SSOT for physical design state at each iteration checkpoint.

attributes.name: physical_layout_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical design layout record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the physical_layout data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Layout engineering effort costs are allocated to a cost center for accurate product cost accounting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical design engineer responsible for this layout iteration. Enables accountability tracking, design review assignment, and workforce analytics in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fab_tool. Business justification: Physical layout files are assigned to a specific fab tool for mask generation; required by the 'Layout‑to‑Tool Assignment' process.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — Physical layouts belong to a specific IC design project. Required for design artifact management.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle run assignment for this layout, if applicable. MPW shuttles allow multiple designs to share a single wafer run to reduce NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) costs for prototype fabrication.

attributes.name: netlist_id
attributes.description: FK to design.netlist.netlist_id — Physical layout (place and route) takes a netlist as input. This is the core PnR flow linkage required for design provenance.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) version used for this physical layout. The PDK defines the technology node rules, design rule checks (DRC), and layer stack for the target fabrication process.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (PDK Standard); Foundry PDK Documentation

attributes.name: physical_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC design record for which this physical layout iteration was produced. Links the layout to its originating design project.

attributes.name: antenna_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of antenna rule violations detected in the layout. Antenna violations occur when metal segments accumulate charge during plasma etching that can damage gate oxide. Must be resolved or mitigated with antenna diodes before tapeout.
attributes.references: Foundry Antenna Rule Specification; SEMI P10

attributes.name: cell_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the core area occupied by placed standard cells, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 72.500 = 72.5%). High utilization (>85%) may indicate routing congestion risk; low utilization (<50%) may indicate oversized floorplan.

attributes.name: core_area_mm2
attributes.description: Area of the core logic region in square millimeters (mm²), excluding I/O ring, power ring, and seal ring. Used to assess logic density and available routing resources.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical layout record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Audit Trail); ISO 9001 Quality Records

attributes.name: cts_insertion_delay_ps
attributes.description: Clock insertion delay in picoseconds (ps) from the clock source to the farthest clock sink in the clock tree. Impacts setup timing margin and must be accounted for in static timing analysis (STA).
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus CTS Report; Synopsys PrimeTime STA

attributes.name: cts_skew_ps
attributes.description: Clock skew in picoseconds (ps) achieved by the Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) engine at this layout iteration. Measures the maximum difference in clock arrival times across all sink flip-flops. Lower skew improves timing closure margin.

attributes.name: dfm_score
attributes.description: Quantitative DFM (Design for Manufacturability) score assigned to this layout iteration by the DFM analysis tool (e.g., Mentor Calibre YieldAnalyzer). Higher scores indicate better manufacturability and expected yield; used to guide layout optimization before tapeout.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; Mentor Calibre DFM; IEEE 1687

attributes.name: dft_coverage_pct
attributes.description: Fault coverage percentage achieved by the DFT (Design for Testability) implementation at this layout stage, as reported by ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) tools. Typically required to exceed 95% for production test qualification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG Boundary Scan); Mentor Tessent ATPG; JEDEC

attributes.name: die_area_mm2
attributes.description: Total die area in square millimeters (mm²) computed from the floorplan boundary. A primary PPA (Power, Performance, Area) metric used for cost estimation, yield modeling, and competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: die_height_um
attributes.description: Height of the die boundary in micrometers (µm) as defined in the physical layout floorplan. Together with die width, determines die area for yield and cost analysis.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD30 (Package Outline Standards); SEMI M1

attributes.name: die_width_um
attributes.description: Width of the die boundary in micrometers (µm) as defined in the physical layout floorplan. Used for package selection, wafer yield estimation, and cost modeling.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD30 (Package Outline Standards); SEMI M1

attributes.name: drc_critical_violation_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Critical Design Rule Check (DRC) Violation Count
attributes.description: Number of DRC violations classified as critical (yield-impacting or functionality-blocking) as opposed to waivable violations. Critical DRC violations must be resolved before tapeout; waivable violations may be accepted with foundry approval.
attributes.references: Foundry DRC Runset Specification; SEMI P10

attributes.name: drc_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of Design Rule Check (DRC) violations detected in this layout iteration by the signoff DRC tool (e.g., Mentor Calibre, Synopsys IC Validator). A value of zero is required for tapeout approval.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (DRC Rules); Foundry DRC Runset Specification

attributes.name: eda_tool
attributes.description: EDA tool used to produce this physical layout iteration. Identifies the physical implementation platform (Cadence Innovus, Synopsys IC Compiler 2, Siemens Aprisa, or Cadence Virtuoso for custom layouts) for provenance and reproducibility.
attributes.references: EDA Industry Standard Tools; SEMI E10

attributes.name: eda_tool_version
attributes.description: Version string of the EDA tool used to generate this layout (e.g., 'Innovus 21.1', 'ICC2 2022.03'). Critical for design reproducibility and debugging layout-specific tool behavior.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Release Notes; Synopsys ICC2 Release Notes

attributes.name: em_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all metal interconnects in the layout comply with electromigration (EM) current density limits specified by the foundry PDK. TRUE = EM compliant; FALSE = EM violations present requiring wire widening or rerouting.
attributes.references: Foundry EM Design Rules; JEDEC JEP122 (Electromigration)

attributes.name: gds_file_checksum
attributes.description: SHA-256 cryptographic checksum of the GDSII/OASIS layout file for integrity verification. Used to confirm that the submitted tapeout file has not been corrupted or tampered with during transfer to the foundry.
attributes.references: NIST FIPS 180-4 (SHA-256); Foundry Tapeout Submission Requirements

attributes.name: gds_file_format
attributes.description: Format of the layout database file referenced in gds_file_path. GDSII is the traditional foundry submission format; OASIS (Open Artwork System Interchange Standard) is the modern compressed alternative; LEF/DEF is used for abstract/physical exchange.

attributes.name: gds_file_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Path
attributes.description: File system or object storage path to the GDSII (Graphic Data System II) or OASIS layout database file for this physical layout iteration. The GDSII file is the primary deliverable submitted to the foundry for mask generation at tapeout.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (GDSII Standard); Calma GDSII Stream Format

attributes.name: implementation_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the physical implementation flow for this layout iteration. Stages progress from initial floorplan through placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, signoff, and final tapeout submission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: floorplan|placement|cts|routing|signoff|tapeout — promote to reference product if additional stages are needed]
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Physical Implementation Flow; IEEE 1801 (UPF Power Intent)

attributes.name: ir_drop_max_mv
attributes.description: Maximum static IR drop in millivolts (mV) observed in the power grid analysis at this layout iteration. Excessive IR drop degrades circuit performance and reliability; must remain within foundry-specified limits for tapeout approval.
attributes.references: Cadence Voltus Power Integrity Analysis; IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: iteration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical layout iteration checkpoint was captured and committed to the design database. Represents the principal business event time for this layout record, enabling chronological tracking of design progress.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Design Checkpoint; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: layout_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying this physical layout iteration, typically including the design name and iteration label (e.g., 'SoC_v3_floorplan_iter2'). Used in Cadence Innovus and Synopsys ICC2 project naming conventions.

attributes.name: layout_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this physical layout record. Tracks whether the layout is actively being worked on, under design review, approved for next stage, rejected requiring rework, or archived as a historical iteration.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Lifecycle Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: layout_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this physical layout iteration following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0.0', '2.3.1'). Tracks incremental changes through the physical implementation flow from floorplan to tapeout.

attributes.name: leakage_power_uw
attributes.description: Static leakage power in microwatts (µW) estimated for this layout at the target operating conditions. Critical for battery-powered and low-power IoT/mobile applications; tracked separately from dynamic power for PPA optimization.

attributes.name: lvs_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the physical layout passes Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) verification with zero errors, confirming that the layout netlist matches the schematic netlist. TRUE = LVS clean (required for tapeout); FALSE = LVS errors present.
attributes.references: Mentor Calibre LVS; Synopsys Hercules; SEMI P10

attributes.name: metal_fill_density_pct
attributes.description: Average metal fill density percentage across all metal layers after dummy metal fill insertion. Foundry CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization) processes require metal density to remain within specified min/max bounds to ensure planar surfaces.
attributes.references: Foundry CMP Metal Fill Rules; SEMI P10

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Number of metal routing layers used in this physical layout, as defined by the PDK technology node stack (e.g., 12 for advanced FinFET nodes). Determines routing resource availability and BEOL (Back End of Line) complexity.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (PDK Layer Stack); ITRS Roadmap

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing design decisions, known issues, waiver justifications, or iteration-specific observations recorded by the physical design engineer. Supports design review documentation and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: power_consumption_mw
attributes.description: Estimated total power consumption in milliwatts (mW) from power analysis at this layout iteration, including dynamic switching power and static leakage power. A key PPA (Power, Performance, Area) metric for product specification compliance.
attributes.references: Cadence Voltus Power Analysis; Synopsys PrimePower; IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: routing_congestion_layer
attributes.description: Metal layer identifier (e.g., 'M4', 'M7') where the maximum routing congestion was observed. Used to guide targeted floorplan or placement adjustments to relieve congestion on the most constrained layer.

attributes.name: routing_congestion_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum routing congestion percentage observed across all metal layers in the layout, expressed as overflow percentage. Values above 5% typically indicate routing closure risk requiring floorplan or placement adjustment.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Routing Congestion Report; IEEE 1481

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final GDSII/OASIS layout was submitted to the foundry for mask generation (tapeout). A critical milestone in the IC design lifecycle tracked against the product TTM (Time to Market) schedule.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Milestone Tracking; SEMI

attributes.name: tns_ps
attributes.description: Total Negative Slack (TNS) in picoseconds (ps), representing the sum of all negative slack values across all timing paths. Indicates the overall magnitude of timing violations in the design; must reach zero for tapeout signoff.

attributes.name: total_cell_count
attributes.description: Total number of standard cells placed in the core area at this layout iteration. Includes combinational logic, sequential elements, buffers, and inverters. Used to assess design complexity and placement density.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical layout record was last modified in the data platform. Supports incremental data processing, change detection, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Audit Trail); ISO 9001 Quality Records

attributes.name: wns_ps
attributes.description: Worst Negative Slack (WNS) in picoseconds (ps) from static timing analysis at this layout iteration. Negative values indicate timing violations; zero or positive values indicate timing closure. A key metric for tapeout readiness.

products.name: tapeout
products.description: Tapeout event record capturing the final design submission milestone for manufacturing. Records tapeout date, GDS/GDSII file version, mask set identifier, foundry submission reference, PDK version used, final DRC/LVS clean status, OPC/RET processing status, design sign-off checklist completion, NRE cost committed, and MPW shuttle assignment if applicable. SSOT for tapeout provenance linking design to fabrication domain.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the tapeout event record. Primary key for the tapeout data product in the design domain.

attributes.name: chips_act_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.chips_act_obligation. Business justification: CHIPS Act reporting obligations are tied to each tapeout; linking supports mandatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tapeout manufacturing costs are charged to a cost center for COGS reporting and cost control.

attributes.name: customer_design_win_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_design_win. Business justification: Enables tracking of each tapeout against its originating design win for NRE cost recovery and warranty reporting.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Each tapeout shipment must be covered by an export license; linking enables audit of license usage per tapeout.

attributes.name: foundry_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Tapeout submission must specify the foundry supplier to coordinate mask set delivery and wafer fab.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA) associated with this tapeout event. Links the tapeout to the product master record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Tapeout projects are tracked via internal orders to capture capital spend and cost commitments.

attributes.name: mask_set_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the photolithography mask set generated from this tapeout. Used to track mask fabrication orders, reticle inventory, and wafer fabrication lots linked to this design submission.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) version used for this tapeout. The PDK defines the foundry-specific design rules, device models, and layer stack used during physical design.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso PDK Framework

attributes.name: physical_layout_id
attributes.description: FK to design.physical_layout.physical_layout_id — Tapeout submits a final physical layout (GDS) to the foundry. Must reference which layout version was taped out.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tapeout revenue and margin are attributed to a profit center for product line profitability analysis.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Tapeout Completion Report requires associating each tapeout with its originating research project for closure and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: tapeout_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC design record from which this tapeout was generated. Links tapeout provenance back to the design lifecycle in the design domain.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: to_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — A tapeout event is the culmination of an IC design project. This is the critical milestone linkage.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: WBS linkage ties tapeout tasks to financial work packages for schedule‑cost integration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tapeout record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IC design being taped out (e.g., product code name or internal design designation). Used for identification in design review meetings and foundry communications.

attributes.name: design_revision
attributes.description: Revision identifier of the design at the time of tapeout (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Distinguishes successive tapeout iterations of the same design, critical for mask set versioning and silicon bring-up tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IC design type being taped out. Distinguishes ASIC, SoC, FPGA, analog, mixed-signal, RF, memory, and photonic designs, which have different EDA flows, PDK requirements, and sign-off criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASIC|SoC|FPGA|analog|mixed_signal|RF|memory|photonic — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dfm_score
attributes.description: Quantitative Design for Manufacturability (DFM) score assigned to the layout at tapeout, reflecting predicted yield sensitivity to process variation. Higher scores indicate better manufacturability. Sourced from DFM analysis tools integrated with the EDA flow.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Innovus DFM; Synopsys IC Compiler

attributes.name: dft_coverage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of logic nodes covered by Design for Testability (DFT) structures (scan chains, BIST) as measured by Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG) at tapeout sign-off. Directly impacts post-silicon test quality and DPPM targets.

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Physical area of the die in square millimeters as defined in the final GDS layout at tapeout. A key Power-Performance-Area (PPA) metric used for cost modeling, yield estimation, and wafer utilization planning.

attributes.name: drc_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the final GDS layout passed all Design Rule Check (DRC) violations with zero errors at the time of tapeout submission. A TRUE value is a mandatory tapeout sign-off criterion per foundry requirements.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Innovus; Synopsys IC Validator

attributes.name: erc_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the design passed Electrical Rule Check (ERC) with no violations at tapeout. ERC validates electrical connectivity integrity including floating nodes, antenna violations, and electromigration rules.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Calibre

attributes.name: expected_yield_pct
attributes.description: Predicted die yield percentage (good dies per wafer as a percentage of total dies per wafer) at the time of tapeout, based on DFM analysis and process node historical yield data. Used for production planning and cost-per-die estimation.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; SPC Guidelines; KLA ICOS Inspection Systems

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification of the tapeout design under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Determines licensing requirements for foundry submission to foreign entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EAR99|ECCN_3E001|ECCN_3A001|ITAR_controlled|not_classified — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BIS/EAR (Export Administration Regulations); ITAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: foundry_name
attributes.description: Name of the semiconductor fabrication facility (FAB) or foundry to which the tapeout was submitted (e.g., TSMC, Samsung Foundry, GlobalFoundries, Intel Foundry Services). Used for supply chain and vendor management reporting.

attributes.name: foundry_submission_ref
attributes.description: Foundry-assigned reference number or confirmation code for the tapeout submission. Used to track the submission status with the external foundry partner and cross-reference with foundry manufacturing orders.

attributes.name: gds_file_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Path
attributes.description: Storage path or URI of the final GDS/GDSII layout file in the design data repository. Enables traceability from the tapeout record to the physical design artifact. Classified confidential as it contains proprietary IP location data.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; ITAR

attributes.name: gds_file_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the final GDS/GDSII layout file submitted for tapeout. Provides design data provenance linking the physical layout file to the tapeout event. Sourced from Cadence Virtuoso or equivalent EDA tool.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (GDSII Stream Format); Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus

attributes.name: ip_sign_off_complete
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intellectual Property (IP) Core Sign-Off Completion Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether all third-party and internal Intellectual Property (IP) cores integrated in the design have received sign-off approval for inclusion in the tapeout. Ensures IP licensing compliance and integration verification are complete.
attributes.references: IEEE 1685 (IP-XACT); ITAR; EAR; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Photolithography exposure technology used for the critical layers in this tapeout. Distinguishes Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV), Deep Ultraviolet (DUV), and legacy lithography types, which impact mask cost, yield, and process complexity.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; EUV/DUV Lithography Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap

attributes.name: lvs_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the final GDS layout passed Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) verification with zero discrepancies. Confirms that the physical layout matches the intended circuit schematic, a mandatory tapeout sign-off criterion.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Calibre

attributes.name: mask_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost of the photolithography mask set fabrication for this tapeout in US dollars. A major component of NRE cost, tracked separately for cost accounting and foundry invoice reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: mask_count
attributes.description: Total number of photolithography masks in the mask set for this tapeout. Directly drives NRE mask cost and is a key input to tapeout cost modeling. Includes FEOL, MOL, and BEOL layers.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers in the Back End of Line (BEOL) stack for this tapeout. Determines routing density, RC parasitics, and mask count, directly impacting NRE cost and manufacturing complexity.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing tapeout-specific notes, known issues, approved waivers, or special foundry instructions that do not fit structured fields. Used by design and process engineering teams for context during silicon bring-up.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: nre_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) cost committed for this tapeout in US dollars, including mask set fabrication, EDA tool licenses, and foundry engineering charges. A critical financial commitment recorded at tapeout sign-off. Classified confidential as it contains proprietary cost data.

attributes.name: opc_ret_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction / Resolution Enhancement Technology (OPC/RET) Processing Status
attributes.description: Processing status of Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) and Resolution Enhancement Technology (RET) applied to the GDS data prior to mask tape-out. OPC/RET is mandatory for sub-28nm nodes to compensate for photolithographic distortion effects.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; MEEF Guidelines; EUV/DUV Lithography Standards

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Intended die packaging technology for the taped-out design (e.g., WLCSP, CoWoS, InFO, flip-chip BGA, QFN). Informs OSAT engagement, assembly NRE planning, and downstream packaging domain linkage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WLCSP|CoWoS|InFO|flip_chip_BGA|QFN|BGA|LGA|SiP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JEDEC Standards; IPC Standards; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor manufacturing process node used for this tapeout, expressed as a technology node designation (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm). Defines the lithography generation and transistor geometry for the fabricated IC.

attributes.name: process_technology
attributes.description: Transistor architecture and process technology type used for this tapeout. Distinguishes between planar CMOS, FinFET, Gate-All-Around (GAA), and specialty process technologies relevant to device performance and yield modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMOS|FinFET|GAA|BiCMOS|SiGe|GaN|SiC|SOI — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: signoff_checklist_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all items on the design sign-off checklist have been completed and approved prior to tapeout submission. The checklist covers DRC, LVS, ERC, timing closure, power analysis, DFT, and IP sign-off milestones.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the final GDS/GDSII design data was submitted to the foundry or mask house for manufacturing. This is the definitive tapeout milestone date used in project tracking and TTM reporting.

attributes.name: tapeout_mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle assignment if this tapeout is part of a shared wafer run. Null if this is a dedicated wafer tapeout.

attributes.name: tapeout_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the tapeout event, used in communications with the foundry, mask house, and internal design teams. Follows the format TO-<DESIGN_CODE>-<YEAR>.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: tapeout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the tapeout event. Tracks progression from internal preparation through foundry acceptance or rejection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_signoff|submitted|accepted|rejected|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]

attributes.name: tapeout_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tapeout run type. Distinguishes full custom dedicated wafer tapeouts, Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle runs, engineering sample tapeouts, and production tapeouts. Drives cost allocation and foundry scheduling.

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment for which the taped-out IC is designed. Used for business reporting, revenue forecasting, and strategic portfolio analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|automotive|datacenter|IoT|industrial|consumer|aerospace_defense|networking — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_tapeout_date
attributes.description: Originally planned tapeout date as committed in the project schedule. Used to measure schedule adherence and Time to Market (TTM) variance against the actual tapeout date.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: timing_closure_status
attributes.description: Status of static timing analysis (STA) sign-off at tapeout. Indicates whether all timing paths met setup and hold constraints (clean), had approved waivers (waived), or had unresolved violations (failed). Sourced from Synopsys PrimeTime or Cadence Tempus.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tapeout record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: wafer_count_ordered
attributes.description: Number of wafers ordered from the foundry for this tapeout run. Used for production planning, yield forecasting, and supply chain management. Applicable for dedicated tapeouts; for MPW runs, this reflects the allocated wafer share.

products.name: mpw_shuttle
products.description: Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle record managing shared wafer runs where multiple IC designs are fabricated together to reduce NRE costs. Captures shuttle name, foundry, process node, scheduled tapeout date, wafer start date, participating design projects, allocated die area per project, shuttle coordinator, cost-sharing terms, and shuttle status. Bridges design domain to fabrication domain for low-volume prototype runs.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the MPW shuttle record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: foundry_supplier_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.supplier

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — MPW shuttles serve multiple design projects. Need to track which projects participate in each shuttle for cost allocation and scheduling.

attributes.name: mpw_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: primary_mpw_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Shuttle scheduling is planned within R&D programs; linking supports program‑level resource allocation tracking.

attributes.name: actual_die_release_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which fabricated dies were released by the foundry. Compared against scheduled_die_release_date to assess foundry delivery performance and downstream packaging schedule impact.

attributes.name: actual_tapeout_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the final GDS/GDSII data package was submitted to the foundry for mask generation. Compared against scheduled_tapeout_date to measure tapeout schedule adherence and TTM performance.

attributes.name: actual_wafer_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the foundry commenced wafer processing for this MPW shuttle lot. Used to measure foundry schedule adherence and to calculate actual cycle time.

attributes.name: allocated_project_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct IC design projects participating in and allocated die area within this MPW shuttle run. Tracks shuttle utilization and cost-sharing distribution.

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MPW shuttle run qualifies for US CHIPS and Science Act incentives or subsidies based on domestic fabrication requirements, technology node, and participating project criteria.

attributes.name: cost_per_mm2_usd
attributes.description: Unit cost in US Dollars per square millimeter of die area on this shuttle. Used to calculate each participating project's cost share based on their allocated die area. Derived from foundry pricing and total reticle area.
attributes.references: SOX; SAP S/4HANA CO; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: cost_sharing_model
attributes.description: Method used to allocate the total shuttle cost among participating design projects. Proportional area charges each project based on die area consumed; fixed slot assigns equal shares; tiered applies volume-based rates; negotiated uses custom terms.
attributes.references: SOX; SAP S/4HANA CO; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MPW shuttle record was first created in the system, capturing the initial planning entry. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts recorded in this shuttle record (e.g., USD, EUR, TWD). Ensures consistent financial reporting and multi-currency reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: dfm_rule_set_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Set Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rule set that all participating designs must comply with for this shuttle. Ensures layout patterns meet foundry yield enhancement guidelines.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Innovus DFM; PDK Documentation

attributes.name: dft_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating designs in this shuttle are required to implement Design for Testability (DFT) structures (e.g., scan chains, BIST) as a condition of shuttle participation. True if DFT is mandatory.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification applicable to this shuttle run based on the process technology and participating design IP. Determines licensing requirements under EAR (Export Administration Regulations) and ITAR. Critical for foundry site selection and participant eligibility.

attributes.name: foundry_account_manager
attributes.description: Name of the foundry-side account manager or technical program manager responsible for this MPW shuttle engagement. Used for escalation and commercial relationship management.

attributes.name: gds_submission_format
attributes.description: File format required for final design data submission to the foundry for this shuttle. GDSII is the legacy industry standard; OASIS is the modern compressed alternative; LEF/DEF is used for certain digital flows.

attributes.name: ip_nda_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intellectual Property (IP) Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating design projects are required to execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to protect IP confidentiality within the shared MPW shuttle environment. Relevant for multi-company shuttle participation.
attributes.references: ITAR; BIS/EAR; GDPR; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this MPW shuttle record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: lithography_technology
attributes.description: Photolithography technology used for patterning in this shuttle run. Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) is used for leading-edge nodes; Deep Ultraviolet (DUV) for mature nodes. Impacts mask cost, cycle time, and OPC complexity.

attributes.name: mask_set_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost in US Dollars for the full photomask set required for this shuttle run. Mask costs are a major NRE component, especially for EUV processes, and are shared across participating projects proportionally.
attributes.references: SOX; SAP S/4HANA CO; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: nre_cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO cost center code to which the NRE and shuttle fabrication costs are initially booked before being allocated to participating design projects. Supports financial controlling and budget tracking.

attributes.name: process_design_kit_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Process Design Kit (PDK) provided by the foundry and used for all participating designs in this shuttle. Ensures all designs comply with the same design rules, device models, and layout constraints.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso PDK Integration

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor process technology node used for fabrication, expressed as a technology generation label (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 16nm FinFET, 28nm HPC+). Determines design rules, PDK version, and lithography requirements (EUV vs DUV).

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM purchase order number issued to the foundry for this MPW shuttle run. Links the shuttle record to procurement and accounts payable processes for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the materials and processes used in this shuttle run comply with the EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment. Required for products sold in EU markets.

attributes.name: scheduled_die_release_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the foundry to complete fabrication and release diced wafers or Known Good Dies (KGD) to the customer or OSAT partner for packaging and assembly.

attributes.name: scheduled_tapeout_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which all participating design projects must submit final GDS/GDSII data for the shuttle. Tapeout is the final design submission milestone triggering mask fabrication and wafer processing.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: scheduled_wafer_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the foundry to begin wafer processing (lot start) for this MPW shuttle. Marks the transition from design domain to fabrication domain in the IC development lifecycle.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: shuttle_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by the foundry or shuttle service provider to uniquely identify this MPW run. Used for cross-referencing with foundry purchase orders, lot tracking systems, and Camstar MES wafer lot records.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Camstar MES Lot Management

attributes.name: shuttle_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the MPW shuttle run, including its primary purpose, target applications, special process options (e.g., embedded non-volatile memory, RF options, high-voltage), and any notable constraints or conditions.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: shuttle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the MPW shuttle run, typically including foundry code, process node, and run sequence (e.g., TSMC-N5-MPW-2024Q3-01). Used as the primary business identifier across design and fabrication teams.

attributes.name: shuttle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the MPW shuttle run. Tracks progression from initial planning through tapeout submission, wafer start, active fabrication, and final completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|open|tapeout_submitted|wafer_started|fabrication|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES

attributes.name: shuttle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shuttle run by its purpose and risk profile. Standard MPW is a fully shared cost run; engineering run is for process validation; risk production is a pre-production volume run; prototype is a single-project low-volume run.

attributes.name: special_process_options
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of optional process modules or specialty layers enabled for this shuttle run (e.g., eNVM, RF, HV, MIM capacitor, thick metal). Participating designs must declare which options they require.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; PDK Documentation; Foundry Design Manual

attributes.name: submission_deadline_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) by which all participating projects must submit their final GDS/GDSII data and sign-off documentation to the shuttle coordinator. Hard deadline; late submissions result in exclusion from the shuttle.

attributes.name: total_reticle_area_mm2
attributes.description: Total usable reticle (mask field) area in square millimeters available for allocation across all participating design projects in this shuttle. Constrains the sum of all individual project die area allocations.

attributes.name: total_shuttle_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) and fabrication cost in US Dollars for the entire MPW shuttle run, including mask set costs, wafer processing fees, and foundry service charges. Basis for cost-sharing allocation across participating projects.
attributes.references: SOX; SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: total_wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafers allocated to this MPW shuttle run across all participating design projects. Determines total silicon area available for die allocation and directly impacts per-project die yield.

attributes.name: wafer_diameter_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafer substrate in millimeters used in this shuttle run (e.g., 200mm, 300mm, 450mm). Determines total die area per wafer and influences cost-per-die calculations.

products.name: eda_tool
products.description: EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tool master record cataloging all licensed design automation tools used across the IC design flow. Captures tool name, vendor (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA, Ansys), tool category (synthesis, simulation, formal verification, place-and-route, STA, DRC/LVS, parasitic extraction, power analysis, signal integrity), version, license type (node-locked, floating, subscription), license count, supported process nodes, flow integration points, and license utilization metrics. SSOT for EDA tool inventory, version management, and license compliance.

attributes.name: eda_tool_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each EDA tool record in the master catalog. Primary key for the eda_tool data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — catalogues a tool asset owned/licensed by the business.
attributes.references: IEEE 1685 (IP-XACT Standard for IP Core Metadata)

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.certification. Business justification: EDA tools used in regulated designs must be certified; linking tracks tool certification status for compliance audits.

attributes.name: annual_license_cost_usd
attributes.description: Annual cost of the EDA tool license in US Dollars as contracted with the vendor. For perpetual licenses, represents the annual maintenance and support fee. Used for R&D cost allocation, NRE budgeting, and design cost-per-project analysis in SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 350

attributes.name: approved_user_groups
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of authorized engineering groups or organizational units permitted to use this EDA tool (e.g., 'IC_Design,Physical_Design,DFT_Engineering'). Used for access control enforcement, license allocation governance, and ITAR/EAR user screening compliance.
attributes.references: ITAR 22 CFR Part 120-130; ISO 27001 Access Control; Workday HCM Org Structure

attributes.name: compute_platform_type
attributes.description: Deployment model for this EDA tool: 'on_premise' = installed on internal compute farm; 'cloud' = deployed on cloud EDA platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Cadence Cloud); 'hybrid' = split between on-premise and cloud burst. Drives infrastructure cost allocation and data sovereignty compliance.
attributes.references: CHIPS Act Compliance; EAR/ITAR Export Controls; ISO 27001

attributes.name: concurrent_users_peak
attributes.description: Maximum number of concurrent users or license checkouts observed for this tool during peak design activity periods (e.g., pre-tapeout crunch). Used to assess license adequacy, identify bottlenecks, and justify license pool expansion requests.
attributes.references: EDA Consortium License Utilization Metrics; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: design_flow_stage
attributes.description: Primary IC design flow stage at which this EDA tool is deployed. Maps to the standard front-to-back design flow: rtl_design (RTL coding and simulation), logic_synthesis (RTL-to-netlist via Design Compiler), physical_design (place-and-route via Innovus), signoff (STA/DRC/LVS/PEX), verification (formal/functional), packaging (assembly design), other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rtl_design|logic_synthesis|physical_design|signoff|verification|packaging|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1685 (IP-XACT); Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus Flow Documentation; Synopsys Design Compiler Reference

attributes.name: dfm_rule_set_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Set Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the DFM rule set bundled with or validated against this EDA tool version (e.g., 'TSMC_N5_DFM_v2.1'). Ensures that physical design outputs meet foundry DFM requirements for yield optimization. Critical for tapeout sign-off packages.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; IEEE 1481; TSMC/Samsung Foundry DFM Guidelines

attributes.name: dft_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDA tool includes or supports DFT capabilities such as ATPG, scan insertion, BIST, or boundary scan (IEEE 1149.1 JTAG). True = DFT-capable; False = no DFT support. Used to determine tool eligibility for DFT-required design projects.
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG Boundary Scan); IEEE 1500 (Embedded Core Test); JEDEC

attributes.name: euv_process_support_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) Lithography Process Support Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDA tool version is validated for use with EUV lithography process nodes (typically sub-7nm). True = EUV-qualified. Relevant for OPC, mask synthesis, and DRC tools where EUV-specific rule decks are required.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification code applicable to this EDA tool under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or ITAR (e.g., ECCN '3D002', 'EAR99', 'ITAR Category XV'). Required for compliance with BIS/EAR and ITAR regulations governing the export and re-export of EDA software to foreign nationals and entities.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR 22 CFR Part 120-130; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: flow_integration_point
attributes.description: Description of how this tool integrates into the enterprise EDA design flow, including upstream and downstream tool handoffs (e.g., 'Receives synthesized netlist from Synopsys DC; outputs DEF/LEF to Cadence Innovus; interfaces with PrimeTime for timing constraints'). Used for flow documentation and tool dependency management.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus Integration Guide; Synopsys PrimeTime Reference Manual; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: formal_verification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDA tool supports formal verification methodologies (equivalence checking, model checking, property verification). True = formal verification capable. Used to classify tools for safety-critical design flows (automotive ISO 26262, IEC 61508).

attributes.name: installation_path
attributes.description: File system path or network mount point where this EDA tool version is installed on the compute infrastructure (e.g., '/tools/synopsys/dc/2023.09'). Used by design flow scripts, Makefiles, and environment setup modules to locate the correct tool binary.
attributes.references: EDA Vendor Installation Guide; Internal IT Infrastructure Standards

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDA tool is subject to ITAR controls, restricting its use, transfer, or disclosure to foreign persons without a license. True = ITAR-controlled; False = not ITAR-controlled. Mandatory for compliance with US State Department ITAR regulations.
attributes.references: ITAR 22 CFR Part 120-130; BIS/EAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which a license checkout was recorded for this EDA tool version. Used to identify dormant or underutilized tools for license reclamation, cost optimization, and EOL planning decisions.
attributes.references: EDA Consortium License Utilization Best Practices; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: license_count
attributes.description: Total number of license seats or tokens procured for this EDA tool version. For floating licenses, represents the maximum concurrent user count. For node-locked, represents the number of authorized hosts. Used for license compliance audits and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; EDA Consortium License Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current EDA tool license agreement expires. Null for perpetual licenses. Used to trigger renewal workflows in SAP S/4HANA MM and to prevent design flow disruptions due to license lapses. Critical for SOX-compliant software asset management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: license_server_host
attributes.description: Hostname or IP address of the FlexLM/RLM license server managing floating license pools for this tool. Null for node-locked or cloud-based licenses. Required for license server failover planning and network access control configuration.
attributes.references: EDA Consortium FlexLM License Management Best Practices

attributes.name: license_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current EDA tool license agreement becomes effective. Defines the start of the licensed usage period for subscription and term-based licenses. Used alongside license_expiry_date to determine the active license window for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Licensing model under which the EDA tool is procured and deployed. 'node_locked' = tied to a specific compute host; 'floating' = shared pool via FlexLM/RLM license server; 'subscription' = time-limited SaaS or annual term; 'cloud' = consumption-based cloud deployment; 'perpetual' = one-time purchase with optional maintenance. Governs compliance obligations and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; JEDEC; EDA Consortium License Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: license_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Average license utilization rate expressed as a percentage of total licensed seats consumed over the most recent reporting period (e.g., 78.50 = 78.5%). Calculated as (average concurrent checkouts / total license count) × 100. Used for license optimization, rightsizing, and vendor negotiation.
attributes.references: EDA Consortium License Utilization Best Practices; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: maintenance_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date by which the annual maintenance and support contract for this EDA tool must be renewed to maintain access to patches, updates, and vendor support. Triggers procurement renewal workflow in SAP S/4HANA MM. Distinct from license_expiry_date for perpetual licenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: pdk_compatibility_version
attributes.description: Specific PDK version string with which this EDA tool version has been validated for correct DRC, LVS, and parasitic extraction results (e.g., 'TSMC_N5_PDK_v1.3', 'Samsung_SF3_PDK_v2.0'). Ensures design rule compliance and sign-off accuracy for tapeout submissions.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 PDK Standard; IEEE 1481; Foundry PDK Release Notes

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EDA tool version was formally qualified and approved for production use in the enterprise design flow. Recorded in Oracle Agile PLM as part of the design tool change management record. Required for design audit trails and tapeout sign-off packages.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.3; Oracle Agile PLM Change Management; IATF 16949

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Formal qualification status of the EDA tool version against the enterprise design methodology and PDK. 'qualified' = passed all DRM/DFM/DFT checks and approved for production tapeouts; 'in_qualification' = undergoing validation; 'not_qualified' = failed or not yet tested; 'waived' = approved with documented exceptions. Required for ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 design control compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.3 (Design and Development); IATF 16949; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: qualified_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the CAD/EDA engineer or team responsible for qualifying this tool version. Provides accountability for the qualification sign-off and is referenced in design methodology documentation and audit packages.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.3; IATF 16949; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDA tool record was first created in the master catalog. Provides audit trail for tool onboarding and is used for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 (Documented Information); SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this EDA tool record in the master catalog. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: release_notes_url
attributes.description: URL or internal document management path to the vendor release notes for this specific tool version. Provides engineers with access to known issues, bug fixes, and new feature documentation. Stored in Siemens Teamcenter PLM document management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Document Management; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this EDA tool record was sourced or is mastered (e.g., 'oracle_agile_plm', 'siemens_teamcenter', 'sap_s4hana', 'manual'). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and master data management governance in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA; ISO 8000 (Data Quality)

attributes.name: supported_os_platforms
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operating system platforms on which this EDA tool version is certified to run (e.g., 'RHEL7,RHEL8,CentOS7,SLES15'). Required for IT infrastructure planning, compute farm provisioning, and tool qualification sign-off.
attributes.references: EDA Vendor Release Notes; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: supported_process_nodes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of semiconductor process technology nodes (in nanometers) for which this EDA tool version is qualified and PDK-validated (e.g., '3nm,5nm,7nm,12nm,28nm'). Determines tool eligibility for specific tapeout projects. Validated against PDK release notes from foundry partners.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 PDK Standard; IEEE 1481 (Interconnect Delay Calculation); ITRS Roadmap

attributes.name: tool_category
attributes.description: Functional classification of the EDA tool within the IC design flow. Drives tool selection, flow integration, and license budgeting. Valid categories: synthesis (logic synthesis), simulation (functional/timing simulation), formal_verification, place_and_route (physical implementation), sta (Static Timing Analysis), drc_lvs (Design Rule Check / Layout vs. Schematic), parasitic_extraction, power_analysis, signal_integrity, other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: synthesis|simulation|formal_verification|place_and_route|sta|drc_lvs|parasitic_extraction|power_analysis|signal_integrity|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1801 (UPF Power Intent); SEMI Standards; EDA Consortium Tool Classification

attributes.name: tool_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique business identifier for the EDA tool (e.g., 'SYNOPSYS-DC-2023', 'CADENCE-INNOVUS-22'). Used as the canonical reference code across PLM, procurement, and license management systems. Maps to the tool catalog number in Oracle Agile PLM.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Item Number Convention; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: tool_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the EDA tool's functional capabilities, primary use cases, and design flow role. Provides context for engineers selecting tools for new projects and for onboarding documentation. Sourced from vendor product documentation and internal CAD team notes.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: tool_name
attributes.description: Full commercial name of the EDA tool as published by the vendor (e.g., 'Synopsys Design Compiler', 'Cadence Innovus Implementation System', 'Siemens Calibre DRC'). Primary human-readable label used in design flow documentation and license agreements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Tool Registry; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: tool_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the EDA tool in the enterprise design environment. 'active' = qualified and in production use; 'deprecated' = superseded but still permitted for legacy projects; 'evaluation' = under qualification testing; 'retired' = no longer licensed or supported; 'pending_qualification' = awaiting PDK and flow validation sign-off.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Lifecycle Management; SEMI S2 Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: tool_version
attributes.description: Specific release version string of the EDA tool as provided by the vendor (e.g., '2023.09', 'v22.1', '21.1.0.1'). Critical for design reproducibility, PDK compatibility validation, and regression testing. Tracked in Siemens Teamcenter PLM for design provenance.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Version Management; IEEE 1685

attributes.name: vendor_contract_number
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned or internally-assigned contract reference number for the EDA tool license agreement. Links this tool record to the corresponding procurement contract in SAP S/4HANA MM for spend tracking, renewal management, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the EDA software vendor supplying the tool (e.g., 'Cadence Design Systems', 'Synopsys', 'Siemens EDA', 'Ansys', 'Mentor Graphics'). Used for vendor management, procurement, and license compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: vendor_support_tier
attributes.description: Level of vendor technical support contracted for this EDA tool (e.g., 'standard' = business-hours support; 'premium' = 24/7 with dedicated TAM; 'elite' = on-site engineering support; 'end_of_support' = vendor no longer provides patches or fixes). Impacts risk assessment for production tapeout use.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; ISO 9001

products.name: rule_set
products.description: Design rule set master record defining collections of DFM (Design for Manufacturability), DFT (Design for Testability), and custom design rules beyond the base PDK rule deck. Captures rule set type (supplemental DRC, project-specific LVS, ERC, DFM recommended rules, DFT scan insertion rules, antenna rules, density rules), rule version, foundry source or internal engineering team, applicable PDK version baseline, rule count, severity classification, waiver policy and approved waiver log, tool compatibility (Calibre, IC Validator, Pegasus), and deviation approval workflow. Enables project-specific rule customization, rule evolution tracking, and consistent enforcement across design teams beyond the foundry-standard PDK rules.

attributes.name: rule_set_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the design rule set record in the semiconductor design domain. Primary key for the design_rule_set data product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the engineering authority who formally approved this rule set version for production use. Distinct from the owner; the approver provides independent technical sign-off per the deviation approval workflow.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.certification. Business justification: Design rule sets often require formal certification for process compliance; linking enables audit of certified rule sets.

attributes.name: eda_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.eda_tool. Business justification: A rule set targets a particular EDA tool; the FK provides a concrete link and removes duplicated compatibility descriptors.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the designated rule set owner accountable for its accuracy, versioning, and approval workflow. References the workforce record in Workday HCM. The owner is the primary point of contact for rule interpretation and waiver decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: parent_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent rule set from which this rule set was derived or branched. Supports hierarchical rule set structures where project-specific rule sets inherit from a foundry-standard base deck.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SEMI P10

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.pdk. Business justification: Design rule sets are tied to a specific PDK; the FK replaces string version fields and enables direct rule‑set to PDK navigation.

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_rule_set_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Design Rule Set ID
attributes.description: Reference to the design_rule_set_id of the newer rule set version that replaces this one when status is Superseded. Enables forward navigation of the rule set version chain for design migration planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: applicable_design_phase
attributes.description: IC design lifecycle phase during which this rule set is enforced. RTL = register-transfer level; Synthesis = logic synthesis; Floorplan = physical planning; Place-and-Route = physical implementation; Signoff = pre-tapeout verification; Tapeout = final GDS/GDSII submission check.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Design Compiler; IEEE 1801

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rule set version received formal engineering approval and was cleared for production use. Distinct from effective_from_date; approval may precede the effective date to allow design teams preparation time.

attributes.name: approved_waiver_count
attributes.description: Number of currently active, formally approved waivers against rules in this rule set. Provides a quick quality signal; high waiver counts may indicate rule set misalignment with design intent or process capability.

attributes.name: authored_by_team
attributes.description: Name of the internal engineering team or external foundry group responsible for authoring and maintaining this rule set. Examples: DFM-Engineering, DFT-Architecture, Foundry-PDK-Team, Process-Integration. Used for ownership tracking and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Formal change control number assigned by Oracle Agile PLM or Siemens Teamcenter when this rule set version was created or modified through the engineering change management process. Provides full audit traceability to the change record.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this design rule set record was first created in the data platform. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the Silver layer lakehouse record.

attributes.name: deviation_approval_workflow
attributes.description: Defines the change control workflow required to approve deviations or modifications to this rule set. None = no formal workflow; Single-Approver = one designated approver; Dual-Approver = two independent approvers required; Change-Control-Board = full CCB review required per Oracle Agile PLM change management process.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this rule set version is binding and enforceable in design flows. Designs initiated on or after this date must comply with this version. Supports temporal rule set management across concurrent design projects.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date after which this rule set version is no longer valid for new design starts. Null indicates the rule set is open-ended with no planned expiry. Enables orderly transition to superseding rule set versions.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: export_control_classification
