products.name: spc_control_chart
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) control chart definition and complete measurement history for a monitored process parameter at a specific process step. Chart definition captures chart type (Xbar-R, Xbar-S, EWMA, CUSUM, IMR), monitored parameter name, control limits (UCL, LCL, UWL, LWL), target value, sample size, sampling frequency, chart owner, and current chart status. Measurement detail (header+line pattern) captures all individual data points: measured value, measurement timestamp, lot reference, wafer number, site coordinates, measurement tool ID, chart rule violations triggered (Western Electric rules, Nelson rules), and resulting process action (none, warning, OCAP triggered). Implements SEMI E10 and JEDEC SPC guidelines. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools. SSOT for all SPC monitoring definitions and measurement data in the process domain.

attributes.name: chart_activation_date

attributes.name: chart_name

attributes.name: chart_type

attributes.name: control_limit_calculation_method

attributes.name: last_limit_revision_date

attributes.name: process_capability_index_cp
attributes.description: Process capability index Cp, calculated as (USL - LSL) / (6 * sigma). Measures the potential capability of the process to meet specifications, assuming the process is centered. Values > 1.33 are typically considered acceptable.

attributes.name: process_capability_index_cpk
attributes.description: Process capability index Cpk, calculated as min[(USL - mean) / (3 * sigma), (mean - LSL) / (3 * sigma)]. Measures the actual capability of the process to meet specifications, accounting for process centering. Values > 1.33 are typically considered acceptable.

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id

attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the capability analysis was performed and this record was generated.
attributes.references: SEMI E120 Specification for the Common Equipment Model

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Method used for capability assessment: short-term (initial process qualification), long-term (ongoing production monitoring), initial (pre-production), or ongoing (continuous monitoring).
attributes.references: ISO 22514-7 Statistical Methods in Process Management - Capability and Performance - Part 7: Capability of Measurement Processes

attributes.name: capability_status
attributes.description: Overall assessment of process capability status based on Cpk threshold criteria. Typically capable (Cpk >= 1.33), marginal (1.0 <= Cpk < 1.33), incapable (Cpk < 1.0).
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Automotive Quality Management System Requirements

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context regarding the capability assessment, including any special causes identified or improvement actions planned.

attributes.name: control_chart_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Chart Type
attributes.description: Type of Statistical Process Control (SPC) control chart used for monitoring this parameter (e.g., X-bar R, X-bar S, Individuals, P-chart, C-chart, U-chart).
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Statistical Process Control Reference Manual

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether corrective action is required based on capability assessment results falling below acceptable thresholds.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: cp_index
attributes.description: Process capability index Cp measuring the potential capability of the process assuming it is centered on target. Calculated as (USL - LSL) / (6 * standard deviation).
attributes.references: ISO 22514-2 Process Capability and Performance - Part 2: Process Capability of Discrete Characteristics

attributes.name: cpk_index
attributes.description: Process capability index Cpk measuring the actual capability of the process accounting for centering. Calculated as minimum of [(USL - mean) / (3 * standard deviation), (mean - LSL) / (3 * standard deviation)].
attributes.references: ISO 22514-2 Process Capability and Performance - Part 2: Process Capability of Discrete Characteristics

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process capability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time window over which process capability was calculated.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time window over which process capability was calculated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process capability record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lower_specification_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit defining the minimum acceptable value for the parameter.
attributes.references: ISO 22514-1 Statistical Methods in Process Management - Capability and Performance

attributes.name: mean_value
attributes.description: Arithmetic mean of the parameter measurements over the evaluation period.
attributes.references: ISO 22514-1 Statistical Methods in Process Management - Capability and Performance

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Metrology technique or measurement method used to collect parameter data (e.g., optical CD, SEM, ellipsometry, XRF, electrical test).
attributes.references: SEMI E133 Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: normality_test_result
attributes.description: Result of statistical normality test (e.g., Anderson-Darling, Shapiro-Wilk) to validate that data follows normal distribution, a prerequisite for capability index calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 22514-1 Statistical Methods in Process Management - Capability and Performance

attributes.name: out_of_control_points
attributes.description: Number of data points that violated SPC control rules during the evaluation period, indicating special cause variation.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Statistical Process Control Reference Manual

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the process parameter in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
attributes.references: SEMI E120 Specification for the Common Equipment Model

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the monitored process parameter for which capability is being assessed (e.g., etch rate, film thickness, overlay error, critical dimension).
attributes.references: SEMI E133 Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: pp_index
attributes.description: Process performance index Pp measuring the overall performance of the process over time. Calculated as (USL - LSL) / (6 * overall standard deviation).
attributes.references: ISO 22514-2 Process Capability and Performance - Part 2: Process Capability of Discrete Characteristics

attributes.name: ppk_index
attributes.description: Process performance index Ppk measuring the actual performance of the process accounting for centering over time. Calculated as minimum of [(USL - mean) / (3 * overall standard deviation), (mean - LSL) / (3 * overall standard deviation)].
attributes.references: ISO 22514-2 Process Capability and Performance - Part 2: Process Capability of Discrete Characteristics

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: Major process area classification: FEOL (Front End of Line), MOL (Middle of Line), or BEOL (Back End of Line).
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: process_layer
attributes.description: Specific process layer or mask level in the fabrication flow where this capability assessment applies (e.g., poly gate, metal 1, contact).
attributes.references: SEMI P35 Guide for Reporting Wafer Nanotopography

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Product family or device type for which this capability assessment applies (e.g., logic, memory, analog, mixed-signal).
attributes.references: SEMI E120 Specification for the Common Equipment Model

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Qualification status of the process step for production release based on capability assessment results and technology node readiness criteria.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: Number of measurement samples included in the capability calculation.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Statistical Process Control Reference Manual

attributes.name: standard_deviation
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the parameter measurements, representing process variation.
attributes.references: ISO 22514-1 Statistical Methods in Process Management - Capability and Performance

attributes.name: subgroup_size
attributes.description: Number of measurements per subgroup used in the SPC control chart analysis.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Statistical Process Control Reference Manual

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Nominal or target value for the process parameter as specified in the process recipe or design requirements.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional trend of capability indices compared to previous evaluation periods, indicating process improvement or degradation.
attributes.references: SEMI E79 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Productivity

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the parameter values (e.g., nanometers, angstroms, degrees Celsius, torr, sccm).
attributes.references: SEMI E148 Specification for the Identification of Equipment States to Enable Benchmarking

attributes.name: upper_specification_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit defining the maximum acceptable value for the parameter.
attributes.references: ISO 22514-1 Statistical Methods in Process Management - Capability and Performance

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Wafer diameter in millimeters for which this capability assessment applies (e.g., 200mm, 300mm, 450mm).
attributes.references: SEMI M1 Specifications for Polished Monocrystalline Silicon Wafers

products.name: opc_rule_set
products.description: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) rule set and MEEF characterization record for a specific lithography layer and technology node. Captures OPC model version, target layer name, technology node, lithography wavelength (EUV/DUV), scanner NA, illumination mode, rule set file reference, process bias tables, assist feature rules, qualification status, and complete MEEF characterization (MEEF value per feature type, pitch, CD target, process window DOF/EL, sigma illumination, NA, wavelength, measurement methodology). MEEF parameters are integral attributes of the OPC rule set as they characterize mask-to-wafer CD transfer fidelity within the OPC model context. Managed in conjunction with Synopsys and Cadence EDA OPC flows. SSOT for all OPC, MEEF, and lithography proximity correction data used in mask data preparation and CD tolerance specification.

attributes.name: opc_rule_set_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OPC rule set record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process geometry) for which this OPC rule set is designed.

attributes.name: assist_feature_rules
attributes.description: Description or reference to the sub-resolution assist feature (SRAF) placement rules included in this OPC rule set.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OPC rule set record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: eda_tool_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific EDA tool product used for OPC processing (e.g., Proteus, Calibre nmOPC).

attributes.name: eda_tool_vendor
attributes.description: Vendor of the EDA tool used to generate and apply this OPC rule set (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor Graphics).

attributes.name: eda_tool_version
attributes.description: Version of the EDA tool used to generate this OPC rule set.

attributes.name: illumination_mode
attributes.description: Illumination configuration used in the scanner (e.g., conventional, annular, dipole, quadrupole, freeform).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this OPC rule set is currently active and available for use in production flows.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OPC rule set record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Type of lithography technology used (EUV = Extreme Ultraviolet, DUV = Deep Ultraviolet).

attributes.name: lithography_wavelength_nm
attributes.description: Wavelength of the lithography exposure light in nanometers (e.g., 193 for DUV, 13.5 for EUV).

attributes.name: meef_feature_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mask Error Enhancement Factor (MEEF) Feature Type
attributes.description: Type of feature for which the MEEF value was characterized (e.g., line, space, contact, via, dense, isolated).

attributes.name: meef_measurement_methodology
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mask Error Enhancement Factor (MEEF) Measurement Methodology
attributes.description: Methodology used to measure and characterize MEEF (e.g., wafer metrology, simulation, focus-exposure matrix).

attributes.name: meef_pitch_nm
attributes.description: Feature pitch in nanometers at which the MEEF value was measured.

attributes.name: meef_target_cd_nm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mask Error Enhancement Factor (MEEF) Target Critical Dimension (CD) (Nanometers)
attributes.description: Target critical dimension in nanometers for the MEEF characterization measurement.

attributes.name: meef_value
attributes.description: Primary MEEF value characterizing the mask-to-wafer CD error amplification for this layer and process. MEEF = (wafer CD change) / (mask CD change).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this OPC rule set.

attributes.name: opc_for_node
attributes.description: FK to process.process_technology_node.process_technology_node_id — OPC rule sets are defined per technology node and layer. Node reference is essential for OPC management.

attributes.name: opc_model_type
attributes.description: Type of OPC correction methodology employed in this rule set.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or lithography engineer responsible for this OPC rule set.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department responsible for maintaining this OPC rule set (e.g., Lithography Engineering, Process Integration).

attributes.name: process_bias_table_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the process bias lookup tables used for CD correction in this OPC rule set.

attributes.name: process_window_dof_nm
attributes.description: Depth of focus in nanometers defining the usable focus range for this OPC rule set and layer.

attributes.name: process_window_el_percent
attributes.description: Exposure latitude as a percentage defining the usable dose range for this OPC rule set and layer.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this OPC rule set was qualified and approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and approval status of this OPC rule set for production use.

attributes.name: rule_set_file_format
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set File Format
attributes.description: File format of the OPC rule set (e.g., proprietary Synopsys format, Cadence format, industry standard).

attributes.name: rule_set_file_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set File Path
attributes.description: File system path or repository location of the OPC rule set file used by EDA tools (Synopsys, Cadence).

attributes.name: rule_set_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set Name
attributes.description: Business name or identifier for this OPC rule set, typically including layer and node information.

attributes.name: rule_set_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set Version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this OPC rule set, tracking revisions and updates to the correction algorithms.

attributes.name: scanner_numerical_aperture
attributes.description: Numerical aperture of the lithography scanner lens system, defining the light-gathering capability and resolution.

attributes.name: sigma_inner
attributes.description: Inner sigma value defining the illumination pupil fill for off-axis illumination modes.

attributes.name: sigma_outer
attributes.description: Outer sigma value defining the illumination pupil fill for off-axis illumination modes.

attributes.name: target_layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the lithography layer (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact) for which this OPC rule set applies.

products.name: meef_parameter
products.description: Mask Error Enhancement Factor (MEEF) parameter record for a specific critical layer, feature type, and process condition. Captures MEEF value, pitch, CD target, process window (DOF, EL), sigma illumination, NA, wavelength, measurement methodology, and associated OPC rule set. Used to characterize mask-to-wafer CD transfer fidelity and to set mask CD tolerances for reticle procurement.
products.reference: SEMI P10 MEEF / ITRS Lithography Roadmap

attributes.name: meef_parameter_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mask Error Enhancement Factor (MEEF) Parameter ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MEEF parameter record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this MEEF parameter is defined.

attributes.name: opc_rule_set_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OPC rule set associated with this MEEF parameter, used for mask data preparation and correction.

attributes.name: photomask_id
attributes.description: Reference to the photomask (reticle) for which this MEEF parameter applies.

attributes.name: wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot used for MEEF characterization experiments.

attributes.name: application_scope
attributes.description: Description of the application scope for this MEEF parameter (e.g., specific product families, process flows, or design rules).

attributes.name: cd_target_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension in nanometers for the feature at wafer level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MEEF parameter record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depth_of_focus_nm
attributes.description: Depth of focus in nanometers representing the process window in the Z-axis (focus direction) for acceptable CD control.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this MEEF parameter becomes effective for use in production mask procurement and OPC.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this MEEF parameter expires or is superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: exposure_latitude_percent
attributes.description: Exposure latitude as a percentage representing the allowable variation in exposure dose while maintaining acceptable CD control.

attributes.name: feature_type
attributes.description: Type of lithographic feature being characterized (line, space, contact, via, trench, island).

attributes.name: illumination_mode
attributes.description: Type of illumination mode used during exposure (conventional, annular, dipole, quadrupole, quasar, freeform).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MEEF parameter record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the critical layer in the semiconductor fabrication process (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact) for which MEEF is characterized.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Type of lithography technology used (DUV - Deep Ultraviolet, EUV - Extreme Ultraviolet, i-line, KrF, ArF).

attributes.name: mask_cd_target_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension on the photomask in nanometers (at 4X or 5X magnification).

attributes.name: mask_cd_tolerance_nm
attributes.description: Allowable tolerance for mask CD in nanometers, derived from MEEF and wafer CD specifications.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date when the MEEF measurement was performed.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Method used to measure MEEF (SEM - Scanning Electron Microscopy, optical metrology, AFM - Atomic Force Microscopy, scatterometry).

attributes.name: measurement_tool
attributes.description: Specific metrology tool or equipment used to characterize the MEEF parameter.

attributes.name: meef_value
attributes.description: The MEEF value representing the ratio of wafer critical dimension (CD) error to mask CD error. Higher MEEF indicates greater sensitivity to mask errors.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or comments related to the MEEF parameter characterization and usage.

attributes.name: numerical_aperture
attributes.description: Numerical aperture of the lithography exposure tool lens system used for this MEEF characterization.

attributes.name: pitch_nm
attributes.description: The pitch (center-to-center spacing) of the feature in nanometers at which the MEEF was measured.

attributes.name: process_condition
attributes.description: Description of the specific process conditions (resist type, bake temperatures, development time) under which MEEF was characterized.

attributes.name: process_window_score
attributes.description: Composite score representing the overall process window quality, combining DOF and exposure latitude metrics.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the MEEF parameter was qualified and approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the MEEF parameter record (draft, under review, qualified, rejected, obsolete).

attributes.name: qualified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer or team who qualified this MEEF parameter.

attributes.name: resist_type
attributes.description: Type of photoresist material used during MEEF characterization.

attributes.name: sigma_inner
attributes.description: Inner sigma illumination setting (partial coherence factor) for the exposure tool, defining the inner radius of the illumination pupil.

attributes.name: sigma_outer
attributes.description: Outer sigma illumination setting (partial coherence factor) for the exposure tool, defining the outer radius of the illumination pupil.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this MEEF parameter record, supporting version control and change tracking.

attributes.name: wavelength_nm
attributes.description: Wavelength of the lithography exposure light source in nanometers (e.g., 193nm for ArF, 13.5nm for EUV).

products.name: process_qualification
products.description: Process qualification program record tracking the formal qualification of a new process flow, process step, or process change against defined acceptance criteria. Captures qualification type (new process, process change, tool qualification, node readiness), qualification plan reference, start date, target completion date, actual completion date, qualification status (in-progress, passed, failed, waived), sign-off engineer, and disposition. Sourced from Oracle Agile PLM and Siemens Teamcenter PLM qualification workflows.

attributes.name: process_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process qualification program record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Customer-specific qualification: certain process qualifications are performed for a particular customer, required for compliance reports and customer approval tracking.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: Qualification Service Invoice ties a process qualification activity to the invoice billing the customer for qualification services.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.certification. Business justification: Process qualification must be backed by a certification (e.g., ISO, ISO‑9001) to satisfy customer and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the process engineer who signed off on the qualification results.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fab_tool. Business justification: Qualification runs are executed on a specific fab tool; the FK records which tool was qualified, supporting qualification history and tool eligibility checks.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this qualification applies.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Qualification records are tied to the specific IC they qualify; needed for the Qualification Status Report.

attributes.name: primary_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_flow. Business justification: A qualification is scoped to a specific process flow; linking directly avoids cross‑domain indirection.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_flow.process_process_flow_id — Process qualifications are conducted against specific process flows or steps. The flow reference establishes what is being qualified.

attributes.name: process_qualification_for_flow
attributes.description: FK to process.process_flow.process_flow_id — Process qualifications validate a process flow or step change. This link is required for qualification status lookup during production release decisions.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Qualification reports must be associated with the originating research program for readiness assessment and stakeholder communication.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the key acceptance criteria that must be met for qualification to pass (e.g., yield > 95%, Cpk > 1.33, defect density < 0.1/cm²).
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the qualification program was completed. Populated when status transitions to passed, failed, waived, or cancelled.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: actual_cpk
attributes.description: Actual process capability index (Cpk) achieved during qualification testing. Populated upon completion of qualification runs.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: actual_yield_percent
attributes.description: Actual wafer yield percentage achieved during qualification testing. Populated upon completion of qualification runs.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions planned or taken to address issues identified during qualification. Applicable for failed qualifications or qualifications requiring follow-up.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: customer_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of customer approval for this qualification: not_required (no customer approval needed), pending (awaiting customer review), approved (customer approved), rejected (customer rejected).
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: disposition

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the qualification is being conducted. Format: 3 letters + 2 digits (e.g., FAB01, SJC02).
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: failure_mode_summary
attributes.description: Summary of failure modes observed during qualification testing, if applicable. Used for failed or waived qualifications to document issues encountered.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was last modified or updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: lot_count
attributes.description: Total number of fabrication lots planned or executed for the qualification program.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the qualification program. Free-text field for supplementary information.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name

attributes.name: owner_organization

attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: plan_reference

attributes.name: plm_system_source

attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: plm_workflow_reference
attributes.description: Workflow or change order identifier in the source PLM system that tracks the qualification approval process.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: qualification_name

attributes.name: qualification_number
