attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification results were formally signed off and approved.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: sign_off_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or technical authority who signed off on the qualification results.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification program officially started or is planned to start.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date for completion of the qualification program.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: target_cpk
attributes.description: Target process capability index (Cpk) that must be achieved for qualification to pass. Typical semiconductor requirement is Cpk >= 1.33.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target wafer yield percentage that must be achieved for qualification to pass.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafers planned or executed for the qualification program.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

products.name: change_notification
products.description: Process Change Notification (PCN) record documenting a planned or executed change to a qualified process flow, recipe, material, or equipment configuration that may affect product performance or reliability. Captures PCN number, change type (process, material, equipment, design), affected products, change description, risk assessment, customer notification requirements, implementation date, and approval status. Managed through Oracle Agile PLM and SAP QM change management workflows.
products.reference: JEDEC JESD46 PCN / SEMI PCN Standard

attributes.name: change_notification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for change_notification

attributes.name: change_process_flow_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Process Flow Internal Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_flow. Business justification: Change notifications affect a specific process flow; an internal FK provides direct reference within the process domain.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary process flow impacted by this change notification.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technology node impacted by this change, such as 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm process technology.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Change notifications affect particular IC products; essential for the Product Change Impact Assessment.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: FK to process.process_flow.process_flow_id — Process change notifications document changes to qualified process flows. This FK enables impact analysis of changes on production flows.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Change notifications are routed to the owning research program to evaluate impact on program milestones and compliance.

attributes.name: actual_implementation_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the process change was implemented in production manufacturing.

attributes.name: affected_customer_list
attributes.description: List of customer names or identifiers who have products affected by this change and require notification per contractual agreements.

attributes.name: affected_equipment_list
attributes.description: List of manufacturing equipment tools or tool sets impacted by this process change, including tool IDs or model numbers.

attributes.name: affected_material_list
attributes.description: List of raw materials, chemicals, gases, or consumables that are being changed or affected by this process modification.

attributes.name: affected_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of product families, part numbers, or device types impacted by this process change.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the process change notification received final internal approval to proceed.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval status from engineering, quality, and management stakeholders for proceeding with the process change.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who provided final approval for the process change notification.

attributes.name: attachments
attributes.description: References to supporting documentation such as technical specifications, test reports, FMEA analyses, customer communications, or qualification data associated with this PCN.

attributes.name: change_classification
attributes.description: Impact classification of the change: major (requires customer approval and qualification), minor (notification required but no requalification), or notification_only (informational, no customer action required).

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the process change including what is being changed, why the change is necessary, and the technical details of the modification.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business or technical justification for the change, such as yield improvement, cost reduction, obsolescence mitigation, reliability enhancement, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the process change notification in the approval and implementation workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|customer_notified|implemented|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the nature of the process change.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Category of change being notified: process (recipe or flow modification), material (raw material or chemical change), equipment (tool or configuration change), design (mask or layout change), facility (fab site or cleanroom change), or supplier (vendor or subcontractor change).

attributes.name: cost_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the financial impact of the process change including implementation costs, ongoing cost savings or increases, and return on investment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the process change notification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer approval is required before implementing the change, typically for major changes affecting form, fit, function, or reliability.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer notification is required per contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, or change impact assessment.

attributes.name: cycle_time_impact_hours
attributes.description: Expected change in manufacturing cycle time resulting from the process change, measured in hours (positive for increase, negative for reduction).

attributes.name: environmental_impact
attributes.description: Description of any environmental, health, or safety impacts resulting from the process change, including changes to hazardous material usage or waste generation.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility or site where the process change will be implemented.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the process change notification record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders for products manufactured using the old process before the change is implemented.

attributes.name: last_time_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date for shipping products manufactured using the old process before transitioning to the new process.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, observations, or context related to the process change notification.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when affected customers were formally notified of the pending process change.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or technical owner responsible for managing this change notification through implementation.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit responsible for the process change, such as Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, or Quality Assurance.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the process change notification, typically formatted as PCN-NNNNNN. Used for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: planned_implementation_date
attributes.description: Target date for implementing the process change in production manufacturing.

attributes.name: qualification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all qualification and validation activities for the process change were successfully completed.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Status of the qualification and validation activities required to verify that the process change does not adversely affect product quality or reliability.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the process change affects compliance with regulatory requirements such as RoHS, REACH, ITAR, EAR, or automotive quality standards (IATF 16949).
attributes.references: RoHS Directive, REACH Regulation, ITAR, EAR

attributes.name: risk_assessment
attributes.description: Evaluation of potential risks associated with the change including impact on product performance, reliability, quality, and manufacturability. May reference Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) results.
attributes.references: FMEA Failure Mode and Effects Analysis

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to this change based on potential impact to product quality, reliability, and customer operations.

attributes.name: yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Expected or measured change in manufacturing yield resulting from the process change, expressed as a percentage point change (positive for improvement, negative for degradation).

products.name: yield_loss_event
products.description: Transactional record of a yield loss event identified at a specific process step or inspection point for a wafer lot. Captures lot reference, process step, yield loss mode (parametric, systematic, random, electrical), defect density, affected die count, estimated yield impact, root cause category, corrective action reference, and resolution status. Primary input to yield optimization workflows and SPC out-of-control action plans (OCAPs).
products.reference: SEMI Yield Management / ITRS Yield Enhancement

attributes.name: yield_loss_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the yield loss event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom the affected wafer lot is being fabricated. Used for customer-specific yield reporting and quality metrics.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: Yield Loss Charge Invoice records the invoice that compensates the customer for a specific yield loss event.

attributes.name: capa_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective action or OCAP (Out of Control Action Plan) initiated in response to this yield loss event. Links to corrective action tracking system.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Yield loss events are charged to the responsible cost center to quantify financial impact in loss‑analysis reports.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication equipment or tool associated with the process step where the yield loss occurred. Used for equipment-specific yield trending and FMEA.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step at which the yield loss was identified. Links to process step master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process generation) for the affected wafer lot. Used for node-specific yield trending and benchmarking.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot in which the yield loss event was detected. Links to fabrication wafer lot master data.

attributes.name: inspection_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inspection or metrology point where the yield loss was detected. May be inline or offline inspection station.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: Needed for Customer Yield Impact report linking each yield loss event directly to the affected sales order for compensation calculations.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process recipe or run card that was active when the yield loss event occurred. Used for recipe-specific yield correlation and optimization.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Yield loss events on research wafers are reported to the responsible research project for root‑cause analysis and budget impact.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC design product or device family being fabricated on the affected wafer lot. Used for product-specific yield analysis and customer impact assessment.

attributes.name: affected_die_count
attributes.description: Number of individual die on the wafer affected by this yield loss event. Used to calculate yield impact and prioritize corrective actions.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer or team assigned to investigate and resolve the yield loss event. Used for workload management and escalation.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: cpk_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated at the time of the yield loss event. Indicates how well the process is centered and controlled relative to specification limits. Values below 1.33 typically indicate process capability issues.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this yield loss event record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Measured defect density for this yield loss event, expressed as defects per square centimeter of wafer area. Used for SPC trending and yield modeling.
attributes.references: SEMI E35 - Guide for Reporting Semiconductor Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability Data

attributes.name: defect_size_nm
attributes.description: Measured or estimated size of the defect in nanometers. Critical for determining defect criticality and kill ratio at advanced technology nodes.

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Specific defect type or signature identified during inspection or test. Examples include scratch, particle, void, short, open, bridging, residue, etc. May reference defect classification taxonomy.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method or technique used to detect the yield loss event. Indicates whether detected via inline inspection, offline inspection, electrical test, parametric test, visual inspection, or metrology measurement.

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Disposition decision for the affected wafer lot following yield loss event investigation. Continue indicates lot proceeds to next step; rework indicates reprocessing required; scrap indicates lot rejected; quarantine indicates lot held pending further analysis; use as is indicates lot accepted with deviation; return to vendor indicates supplier material issue.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: estimated_yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage point impact on wafer yield attributable to this event. Calculated from affected die count and total die per wafer. Used for yield loss Pareto analysis.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the yield loss event was detected or recorded. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the yield loss event occurred. Used for multi-site yield benchmarking and site-specific trending.

attributes.name: investigation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when root cause investigation of the yield loss event was initiated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this yield loss event record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer or mask level at which the yield loss event occurred. Examples include M1, M2, POLY, CONTACT, VIA1, etc. Aligns with GDS layer naming convention.

attributes.name: lot_hold_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lot hold was placed on the affected wafer lot as a result of this yield loss event. True if hold applied; false if no hold applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, observations, or context related to the yield loss event. May include investigation findings, lessons learned, or special handling instructions.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer, operator, or automated system that reported or logged the yield loss event. Used for accountability and follow-up.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the yield loss event resolution workflow. Open indicates newly detected; under investigation indicates active RCA; root cause identified indicates RCA complete; corrective action implemented indicates fix deployed; closed indicates event resolved; deferred indicates event accepted or postponed.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the yield loss event was resolved and closed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used to calculate mean time to resolution (MTTR) for yield events.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the yield loss event. Equipment indicates tool-related issues; material indicates incoming material defects; process indicates recipe or parameter issues; human indicates operator error; environmental indicates cleanroom or facility issues; design indicates layout or design rule issues.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified or suspected root cause of the yield loss event. Populated during root cause analysis and investigation.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business severity classification of the yield loss event based on yield impact, affected volume, and customer impact. Critical indicates immediate action required; major indicates significant yield impact; minor indicates localized impact; negligible indicates minimal business impact.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: spc_rule_violation
attributes.description: Identification of the SPC control chart rule that was violated and triggered this yield loss event. Examples include Western Electric rules, Nelson rules, or custom SPC rules. Used to link yield events to process control violations.

attributes.name: wafer_position_x_mm
attributes.description: X-coordinate position on the wafer where the yield loss event was detected, in millimeters from wafer center. Used for spatial yield analysis and wafer mapping.

attributes.name: wafer_position_y_mm
attributes.description: Y-coordinate position on the wafer where the yield loss event was detected, in millimeters from wafer center. Used for spatial yield analysis and wafer mapping.

attributes.name: yield_loss_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the yield loss mechanism. Parametric indicates out-of-spec electrical parameters; systematic indicates repeatable defect patterns; random indicates sporadic defects; electrical indicates functional failures; particle indicates contamination; pattern indicates lithography or etch issues; edge indicates wafer edge exclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parametric|systematic|random|electrical|particle|pattern|edge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

products.name: defect_inspection_result
products.description: Wafer-level defect inspection result record from in-line inspection tools (KLA brightfield/darkfield scanners, e-beam inspection) captured at process engineering inspection steps for process monitoring and excursion detection. Captures wafer lot reference, inspection step, tool ID, inspection recipe, total defect count, defect density (defects/cm²), defect map file reference, defect classification breakdown by type and size, nuisance filter applied, and disposition. SSOT boundary: process domain owns in-line defect inspection results used for process monitoring, SPC, and excursion detection during manufacturing; quality domain owns outgoing quality inspection, reliability defect analysis, and customer-reported defect records. Sourced from KLA 29xx/39xx series and Applied Materials SEMVision.
products.reference: KLA ICOS / SEMI M1 Defect Inspection

attributes.name: defect_inspection_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the defect inspection result record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator or automated system that initiated the inspection.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection equipment used (e.g., KLA 29xx/39xx series, Applied Materials SEMVision). Tool asset identifier from equipment master.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process generation) for which this inspection was performed, e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot that was inspected. Links to the fabrication wafer lot being monitored.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Defect inspection results are analyzed per IC product for the Defect Analysis per Product report.

attributes.name: inspection_recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection recipe or program used to configure the tool for this inspection run. Defines sensitivity, scan area, and detection parameters.

attributes.name: lot_process_run_id
attributes.description: FK to process.lot_process_run.lot_process_run_id — Defect inspection results are captured during or after a specific lot process run at an inspection step. This FK enables defect-to-process correlation.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Defect inspection results are tied to a specific process step; adding internal FK enables step‑level analysis.

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer within the lot that was inspected.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this defect inspection result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crystal_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as crystal originated particles (COPs) or intrinsic silicon defects.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Calculated defect density expressed as defects per square centimeter of inspected wafer area. Key metric for process monitoring and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

attributes.name: defect_map_file_format
attributes.description: Format of the defect map file: KLARF (KLA Results File), CSV, XML, or proprietary vendor format.

attributes.name: defect_map_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or URI to the defect map file (typically KLARF or proprietary format) containing spatial coordinates and attributes of all detected defects.

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_large_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the large size bin (typically > 0.5 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_medium_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the medium size bin (typically 0.1-0.5 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_small_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the small size bin (typically < 0.1 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Disposition decision based on inspection results: pass (within spec), fail (exceeds limits), review (requires engineering review), hold (lot placed on hold), or rework (requires reprocessing).

attributes.name: excursion_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a process excursion was detected based on defect density or count exceeding Statistical Process Control (SPC) limits.

attributes.name: inspected_area_cm2
attributes.description: Total wafer surface area inspected, measured in square centimeters. Used to calculate defect density.

attributes.name: inspection_at_step
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_step.process_process_step_id — Defect inspections occur at specific process steps in the flow. Step reference provides manufacturing context for defect analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_mode
attributes.description: Inspection coverage mode: full wafer scan, die sampling, edge exclusion, or hot spot targeted inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inspection run: completed (inspection finished successfully), in_progress (inspection running), failed (tool error), or aborted (inspection cancelled).

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the defect inspection was performed. Primary business event timestamp for this inspection result.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of inspection technology used: brightfield scanner, darkfield scanner, e-beam inspection, optical inspection, or macro inspection.

attributes.name: killer_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as killer defects (defects large enough or critical enough to cause die failure).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this defect inspection result record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer being inspected (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact, Via2). Identifies the fabrication layer in the stack.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the inspection results, anomalies, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: nuisance_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as nuisance (false positives or non-yield-impacting detections filtered by nuisance filter).

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a nuisance filter was applied to remove false positives or non-critical defects from the reported count.

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the nuisance filter algorithm or rule set applied during this inspection.

attributes.name: particle_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as particles (foreign material on wafer surface).

attributes.name: pattern_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as pattern defects (lithography or etch anomalies in the circuit pattern).

attributes.name: residue_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as residue (chemical or material residue remaining after processing).

attributes.name: review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether engineering review is required based on defect count, type, or pattern analysis.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering review was completed.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer who reviewed the inspection results, if review was performed.

attributes.name: scratch_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as scratches (linear surface damage).

attributes.name: spc_control_limit_lower
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Lower Control Limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit for defect density used in SPC monitoring.

attributes.name: spc_control_limit_upper
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Upper Control Limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit for defect density used in SPC monitoring. Excursions above this limit trigger alerts.

attributes.name: total_defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects detected on the wafer during this inspection, including all defect types and sizes.

products.name: process_metrology_measurement
products.description: In-line metrology measurement record capturing critical dimension (CD), overlay, film thickness, resistivity, or other physical parameter measurements taken on a wafer at a specific process step. Captures measurement type (CD-SEM, OCD, XRF, ellipsometry, overlay), tool ID, wafer lot reference, wafer number, measurement site map, per-site values, mean, 3-sigma, range, and pass/fail disposition against spec limits. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools.
products.reference: SEMI M1 / KLA Metrology / CD-SEM SEMI E89

attributes.name: process_metrology_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the metrology_measurement data product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator or automated system that initiated the measurement.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the metrology equipment that performed the measurement (e.g., CD-SEM, ellipsometer, overlay tool).

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process step at which this metrology measurement was taken.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this measurement was performed.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot on which this measurement was performed.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Metrology measurements are linked to the IC product they verify; used in Metrology Compliance reporting.

attributes.name: metrology_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the metrology measurement record.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the metrology recipe or measurement program used for this measurement.

attributes.name: site_map_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the measurement site map or sampling plan used to define measurement locations on the wafer.

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer within the lot that was measured.

attributes.name: cp_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cp) calculated from this measurement, indicating the potential capability of the process without considering centering.

attributes.name: cpk_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated from this measurement, indicating how well the process is centered and controlled within specification limits.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating the quality and reliability of the measurement data. Good indicates reliable data, Suspect indicates questionable data, Bad indicates invalid data, Uncalibrated indicates tool calibration issue.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Pass/fail disposition of the measurement against specification limits. Pass indicates within spec, Fail indicates out of spec, Marginal indicates near limits, Rework indicates corrective action required, Hold indicates pending review.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the measurement was performed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer or mask level at which this measurement was taken (e.g., M1, POLY, CONTACT).

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring. Values below this trigger investigation.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for this measurement parameter. Values below this threshold fail specification.

attributes.name: max_value
attributes.description: Maximum measured value across all sites on the wafer.

attributes.name: mean_value
attributes.description: Arithmetic mean of all site measurements for this parameter.

attributes.name: measurement_mode
attributes.description: Mode in which the measurement was performed. Inline indicates production flow measurement, Offline indicates lab measurement, Engineering indicates development measurement, Qualification indicates process qualification.

attributes.name: measurement_parameter
attributes.description: Specific physical parameter being measured (e.g., critical dimension, overlay X/Y, film thickness, resistivity, reflectivity).

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Status of the measurement execution. Completed indicates successful measurement, In Progress indicates measurement underway, Failed indicates measurement error, Aborted indicates user-terminated, Pending indicates queued.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the metrology measurement was performed.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Type of metrology measurement performed: CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscopy), OCD (Optical Critical Dimension), XRF (X-Ray Fluorescence), Ellipsometry, Overlay, or Film Thickness.

attributes.name: median_value
attributes.description: Median value of all site measurements for this parameter.

attributes.name: metrology_at_step
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_step.process_process_step_id — Metrology measurements are taken at specific process steps. Step context is essential for measurement interpretation and SPC feeding.

attributes.name: min_value
attributes.description: Minimum measured value across all sites on the wafer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the measurement, including any anomalies, special conditions, or operator observations.

attributes.name: range_value
attributes.description: Difference between maximum and minimum site measurements (max - min).

attributes.name: site_count
attributes.description: Total number of measurement sites sampled on the wafer.

attributes.name: spc_rule_violation
attributes.description: Description of any SPC rule violations detected (e.g., Western Electric rules, Nelson rules) such as trend, shift, or out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: std_deviation
attributes.description: Standard deviation (1-sigma) of the site measurements, indicating within-wafer uniformity.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target or nominal value for this measurement parameter as defined by the process specification.

attributes.name: three_sigma
attributes.description: Three times the standard deviation, representing the process variation range.

attributes.name: uniformity_percent
attributes.description: Within-wafer uniformity expressed as a percentage, calculated as (range / mean) * 100 or (3-sigma / mean) * 100 depending on convention.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measurement values (e.g., nm, angstrom, ohm-cm, percent).

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring. Values above this trigger investigation.

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit for this measurement parameter. Values above this threshold fail specification.

attributes.name: wafer_slot_number
attributes.description: Position of the wafer within the lot carrier or cassette.

products.name: implant_condition
products.description: Ion implantation process condition master record defining the implant species, energy, dose, tilt angle, twist angle, beam current, and anneal conditions for a specific doping step in a process flow. Captures implant layer name, dopant species (boron, phosphorus, arsenic, etc.), implant energy (keV), dose (ions/cm²), tilt/twist angles, beam current, implant tool class, and associated anneal recipe. Critical for transistor threshold voltage and junction depth control.

attributes.name: implant_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ion implantation process condition master record. Primary key for the implant condition entity.

attributes.name: anneal_recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the thermal anneal recipe applied after implantation to activate dopants and repair crystal damage. Critical for electrical junction formation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process engineer responsible for developing, qualifying, and maintaining this implant condition.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent process flow that contains this implant step. Links this implant condition to the overall manufacturing process sequence.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this implant condition is qualified. Critical for process design kit alignment.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Implant conditions are defined per IC product for the Implant Process Specification document.

attributes.name: photomask_id
attributes.description: Reference to the photomask layer used to pattern the photoresist that defines the implant region. Links implant to lithography process.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Implant condition is associated with a specific process step; adding internal FK creates the needed relationship.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Reference to the SPC control plan that defines monitoring parameters, sampling frequency, and control limits for this implant condition.

attributes.name: anneal_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Peak temperature of the post-implant anneal process in degrees Celsius. Typical range: 400°C to 1100°C depending on anneal type and dopant activation requirements.

attributes.name: anneal_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the anneal process at peak temperature, measured in seconds. RTA processes are typically 1-60 seconds, while furnace anneals may be minutes to hours.

attributes.name: anneal_type
attributes.description: Type of thermal anneal process used for dopant activation. RTA (Rapid Thermal Anneal), furnace anneal, spike anneal, laser anneal, or flash anneal. Each has different thermal budget characteristics.

attributes.name: baseline_cpk
attributes.description: Baseline process capability index (Cpk) measured during qualification. Indicates the process capability to meet specifications. Target Cpk typically ≥1.33 for production.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: beam_current_ma
attributes.description: Ion beam current in milliamperes (mA). Determines the implantation rate and throughput. Higher beam currents enable faster processing but may increase wafer heating.

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for this implant condition, used in manufacturing execution systems and process travelers.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this implant condition, typically describing the implant purpose (e.g., Source/Drain Boron Implant, Threshold Voltage Adjust Phosphorus).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this implant condition record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of semiconductor device this implant condition is designed for (e.g., NMOS, PMOS transistors, bipolar devices, diodes, or implanted resistors). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nmos|pmos|nfet|pfet|bipolar|diode|resistor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dopant_species
attributes.description: Chemical element or compound used for ion implantation. Common species include boron (p-type), phosphorus and arsenic (n-type), BF2 (boron difluoride for shallow junctions), and specialty dopants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: boron|phosphorus|arsenic|antimony|indium|bf2|germanium|silicon|nitrogen|carbon — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this implant condition is no longer valid for new production starts. Null indicates the condition is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this implant condition becomes valid and available for use in production process flows.

attributes.name: implant_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of this implant condition, including its purpose, special considerations, and any process integration notes.

attributes.name: implant_dose_ions_per_cm2
attributes.description: Total number of ions implanted per square centimeter of wafer surface. Expressed in scientific notation (e.g., 1.0E15 ions/cm²). Controls the dopant concentration.

attributes.name: implant_energy_kev
attributes.description: Ion implantation energy in kilo-electron volts (keV). Controls the depth of ion penetration into the silicon substrate. Typical range: 0.5 keV to 500 keV.

attributes.name: implant_layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the device layer being implanted (e.g., PWELL, NWELL, LDD, HDD, VT_ADJUST). Identifies the target region in the device structure.

attributes.name: implant_purpose
attributes.description: Functional purpose of this implant step in the device structure. Examples: well formation, threshold voltage adjustment, lightly-doped drain (LDD), heavily-doped drain (HDD), source/drain, halo/pocket implants, or isolation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: well|vt_adjust|ldd|hdd|source_drain|halo|pocket|channel_stop|field_implant — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: implant_tool_class
attributes.description: Classification of ion implanter equipment type required for this condition. Different tool classes are optimized for specific energy and dose ranges.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: implant_tool_model
attributes.description: Specific model or type of ion implanter equipment qualified for this condition (e.g., Applied Materials Quantum X, Axcelis Purion).
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the baseline or reference implant condition for this layer and technology node. True if baseline, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this implant condition record was most recently updated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional technical notes, warnings, or special instructions for manufacturing operators and process engineers regarding this implant condition.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Name of the engineering organization or department responsible for this implant condition (e.g., Ion Implant Process Engineering, FEOL Integration).

attributes.name: process_window_dose_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Allowable variation in implant dose as a percentage of target dose, defining the process window for dose control. Typical values: ±1% to ±5%.

attributes.name: process_window_energy_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Allowable variation in implant energy as a percentage of target energy, defining the process window for energy control. Typical values: ±1% to ±3%.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this implant condition successfully completed qualification testing and was approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and release status of this implant condition. Indicates whether the condition is approved for production use or still under development.

attributes.name: requires_pre_amorphization
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a pre-amorphization implant (typically germanium or silicon) is required before the main dopant implant to reduce channeling effects.

attributes.name: target_junction_depth_nm
attributes.description: Intended electrical junction depth in nanometers after implant and anneal. Critical specification for transistor performance and short-channel effect control.

attributes.name: target_sheet_resistance_ohms_per_sq
attributes.description: Target electrical sheet resistance in ohms per square after implant and anneal. Key electrical parameter for verifying dopant activation and concentration.

attributes.name: target_threshold_voltage_mv
attributes.description: Target transistor threshold voltage in millivolts that this implant condition is designed to achieve. Critical for device performance and power consumption.

attributes.name: tilt_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Angle of wafer tilt relative to the ion beam axis, measured in degrees. Used to control channeling effects and implant profile symmetry. Typical range: 0° to 7°.

attributes.name: twist_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Rotational angle of the wafer around its normal axis during implantation, measured in degrees. Used in conjunction with tilt angle to optimize implant uniformity. Typical range: 0° to 360°.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this implant condition. Incremented when process parameters are modified. Enables change tracking and configuration management.

products.name: deposition_condition
products.description: Thin film deposition process condition master record for CVD, PVD, ALD, and epitaxial deposition steps. Captures deposition method (LPCVD, PECVD, ALD, PVD, EPI), target material, target thickness, deposition temperature, pressure, precursor gases and flow rates, RF power, deposition rate, uniformity spec, and associated process step. Covers FEOL gate dielectric, BEOL metal interconnect, and barrier/liner deposition conditions.

attributes.name: deposition_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the thin film deposition process condition record.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this deposition condition is qualified.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Deposition conditions are product‑specific; required for the Deposition Process Specification.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Deposition condition records are defined for a particular process step; linking directly improves traceability.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan ID
attributes.description: Reference to the SPC control plan defining monitoring strategy, control limits, and sampling frequency for this deposition condition.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: Deposition processes use chemicals; linking to substance inventory enables REACH and hazardous‑substance tracking.

attributes.name: carrier_gas
attributes.description: Inert carrier gas used to transport precursors and maintain chamber environment (e.g., Ar, N2, He).

attributes.name: carrier_gas_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of carrier gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm).

attributes.name: chamber_configuration
attributes.description: Specific chamber setup or hardware configuration required (e.g., single-wafer, batch, showerhead type, electrode spacing).

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code used to identify this deposition condition in manufacturing execution systems and process documentation.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for this deposition condition recipe.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deposition condition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deposition_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the deposition condition, including application notes, special considerations, and process intent.

attributes.name: deposition_method
attributes.description: Thin film deposition technique used: LPCVD (Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition), PECVD (Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition), ALD (Atomic Layer Deposition), PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition), EPI (Epitaxial Growth), MOCVD (Metal Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition).

attributes.name: deposition_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Process chamber pressure in Torr during deposition. Affects film density, step coverage, and deposition rate.

attributes.name: deposition_rate_angstrom_per_minute
attributes.description: Target deposition rate in angstroms per minute. Key process control parameter affecting throughput and film quality.

attributes.name: deposition_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Process chamber temperature in degrees Celsius during deposition. Critical parameter affecting film quality, stress, and conformality.

attributes.name: deposition_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the deposition step in seconds required to achieve target thickness.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this deposition condition is retired or superseded. Null indicates currently active condition.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this deposition condition becomes effective and available for production use.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing site or fab location where this deposition condition is qualified and used.

attributes.name: film_stress_mpa
attributes.description: Intrinsic mechanical stress in the deposited film measured in megapascals (MPa). Positive values indicate tensile stress, negative values indicate compressive stress. Affects wafer bow and device reliability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deposition condition record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting this deposition condition.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for this deposition condition (e.g., Thin Films Engineering, BEOL Integration).

attributes.name: precursor_gas_1
attributes.description: Primary precursor gas or chemical reactant used in the deposition process (e.g., SiH4, TiCl4, WF6, TEOS).

attributes.name: precursor_gas_1_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of primary precursor gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm). Controls deposition rate and film stoichiometry.

attributes.name: precursor_gas_2
attributes.description: Secondary precursor gas or reactant used in the deposition process (e.g., NH3, O2, N2, H2).

attributes.name: precursor_gas_2_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of secondary precursor gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm).

attributes.name: process_capability_cpk
attributes.description: Statistical process capability index (Cpk) for this deposition condition, measuring process centering and variation relative to specification limits. Target is typically ≥1.33 for production.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Manufacturing stage where deposition occurs: FEOL (Front End of Line) for gate dielectrics and transistor formation, MOL (Middle of Line) for contacts, BEOL (Back End of Line) for metal interconnects.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this deposition condition was formally qualified and approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and release status of this deposition condition for production use.

attributes.name: refractive_index
attributes.description: Optical refractive index of the deposited film at specified wavelength. Used for film characterization and thickness measurement via ellipsometry.

attributes.name: rf_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Radio frequency in megahertz used for plasma generation (e.g., 13.56 MHz, 27.12 MHz).

attributes.name: rf_power_watts
attributes.description: Radio frequency power applied in watts for plasma-enhanced deposition methods (PECVD). Controls plasma density and ion bombardment energy.

attributes.name: step_coverage_percent
attributes.description: Ratio of film thickness on vertical sidewalls to horizontal surfaces, expressed as percentage. Critical for via and trench filling in advanced nodes.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: target_layer
attributes.description: Functional layer name in the device stack where material is deposited (e.g., gate oxide, barrier layer, metal1, via2, passivation).
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: Chemical composition or material being deposited (e.g., SiO2, Si3N4, TiN, W, Cu, HfO2, Al2O3, Ta, TaN, Co).

attributes.name: target_thickness_angstrom
attributes.description: Specified target thickness of the deposited film in angstroms (Å). Critical for device electrical performance and process control.

attributes.name: thickness_tolerance_angstrom
attributes.description: Allowable deviation from target thickness in angstroms, defining the acceptable process window.

attributes.name: tool_class
attributes.description: Equipment type or platform family qualified for this deposition condition (e.g., Applied Materials Centura, Lam Vector, Tokyo Electron Telius).

attributes.name: uniformity_specification_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable thickness non-uniformity across the wafer surface, expressed as percentage (e.g., ±2% 1-sigma). Critical for yield and device performance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this deposition condition, tracking revisions and updates over time.

products.name: etch_condition
products.description: Etch process condition master record for dry etch (RIE, ICP, CCP) and wet etch steps. Captures etch type (dry/wet), etchant chemistry, gas flows, chamber pressure, RF power (source and bias), etch rate, selectivity targets, critical dimension bias, endpoint detection method, and associated process step. Covers FEOL gate patterning, contact/via etch, and BEOL metal etch conditions.

attributes.name: etch_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the etch process condition master record. Primary key for the etch condition entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this etch condition is qualified. Links to the technology node master record.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Etch conditions are tied to each IC product to ensure consistent etch performance; used in Etch Process Specification.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Etch condition records belong to a specific process step; internal FK provides direct association.

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: Etch steps involve etchant chemicals; compliance requires associating each etch condition with the regulated substance record.

attributes.name: application_scope
attributes.description: Description of the intended application scope or use case for this etch condition (e.g., high aspect ratio contact etch, metal gate patterning, shallow trench isolation).

attributes.name: chamber_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Operating pressure inside the etch chamber measured in Torr. Critical parameter for plasma density and etch uniformity control.

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the etch condition for system tracking and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) integration.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for the etch condition recipe. Used for operational reference and communication among process engineers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this etch condition record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: critical_dimension_bias_nm
attributes.description: Expected change in critical dimension (CD) due to the etch process in nanometers. Positive value indicates CD growth, negative indicates CD shrinkage. Used for Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this etch condition is retired or superseded. Null if still active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this etch condition becomes effective and available for production use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: endpoint_detection_method
attributes.description: Method used to detect the completion of the etch process. Options include time-based, Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES), laser interferometry, mass spectrometry, or none for over-etch strategies.

attributes.name: etch_method
attributes.description: Specific etch method or technology used. For dry etch: Reactive Ion Etch (RIE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP). For wet etch: immersion or spray.

attributes.name: etch_rate_angstrom_per_minute
attributes.description: Target etch rate for the primary material in angstroms per minute. Key process parameter for throughput and uniformity control.

attributes.name: etch_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the etch process in seconds. May be time-based or endpoint-detection-based depending on the process control strategy.

attributes.name: etch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the etch process as either dry etch (plasma-based: RIE, ICP, CCP) or wet etch (chemical immersion).

attributes.name: etchant_chemistry
attributes.description: The chemical composition of the etchant used. For dry etch: gas mixture (e.g., CF4/O2, SF6/O2, Cl2/BCl3). For wet etch: liquid chemistry (e.g., HF, BOE, H3PO4).

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where this etch condition is qualified and used. Supports multi-site manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the baseline or reference etch condition for the process step. True if this is the standard condition, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this etch condition record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the etch condition. Used for operational guidance and knowledge capture.

attributes.name: over_etch_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of additional etch time beyond endpoint detection to ensure complete material removal. Expressed as a percentage of the main etch time.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit or department responsible for this etch condition (e.g., FEOL Process Engineering, BEOL Integration).

attributes.name: primary_gas_flow_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of the primary etch gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM). Applicable to dry etch processes.

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Classification of the etch step within the fabrication flow: Front End of Line (FEOL) for gate patterning, Middle of Line (MOL) for contact/via etch, or Back End of Line (BEOL) for metal etch.

attributes.name: profile_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Target sidewall angle of the etched feature in degrees from vertical. 90 degrees indicates perfectly vertical (anisotropic) etch. Critical for device performance and yield.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the etch condition was formally qualified and approved for production use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and approval status of the etch condition. Indicates whether the condition is ready for production use or still under development.

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the etch recipe. Used for change control and traceability when recipe parameters are updated.

attributes.name: rf_bias_power_watts
attributes.description: RF power applied to the substrate electrode (bias power) in watts. Controls ion energy and directionality for anisotropic etching.

attributes.name: rf_source_power_watts
attributes.description: RF power applied to the plasma source coil or electrode in watts. Controls plasma density and etch rate in ICP and CCP systems.

attributes.name: secondary_gas_flow_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of the secondary or carrier gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM). Used for process tuning and selectivity control.

attributes.name: selectivity_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of etch rate of the target material to the etch rate of the underlying or masking material. Critical for process control and preventing over-etch damage.

attributes.name: substrate_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature of the wafer substrate during the etch process in degrees Celsius. Affects etch rate, selectivity, and profile control.

attributes.name: target_cd_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension after etch in nanometers. Defines the intended feature size for the etched structure.

attributes.name: target_layer
attributes.description: The specific layer or material being etched (e.g., polysilicon, oxide, nitride, metal1, metal2, via1, contact). Identifies the layer in the device stack.

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: The material composition of the target layer being etched (e.g., silicon, silicon dioxide, silicon nitride, tungsten, copper, aluminum, titanium nitride).

attributes.name: tool_class
attributes.description: Classification or family of etch equipment for which this condition is designed (e.g., Applied Materials Centura, Lam Research Kiyo, Tokyo Electron Tactras).

attributes.name: uniformity_target_percent
attributes.description: Target uniformity of etch depth or CD across the wafer, expressed as a percentage (1-sigma or 3-sigma). Lower values indicate better uniformity.

products.name: cmp_condition
products.description: Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) process condition master record defining slurry chemistry, pad type, platen pressure, carrier speed, table speed, endpoint detection method, target removal amount, post-CMP clean recipe, and within-wafer uniformity spec. Covers STI CMP, ILD CMP, W-plug CMP, Cu damascene CMP, and barrier CMP steps across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL.

attributes.name: cmp_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CMP process condition master record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process geometry) for which this CMP condition is qualified, such as 7nm, 5nm, 3nm FinFET or GAA nodes.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: CMP conditions are maintained per IC product for the CMP Process Specification and quality control.

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: CMP slurry chemicals are regulated; linking condition to substance inventory supports substance reporting and safety.

attributes.name: carrier_speed_rpm
attributes.description: Rotational speed of the wafer carrier head during CMP processing, measured in revolutions per minute. Affects relative velocity and material removal uniformity.

attributes.name: cmp_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of this CMP process condition, including special considerations, application scope, and any unique characteristics or constraints.

attributes.name: cmp_step_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CMP process step based on the material and layer being planarized. STI (Shallow Trench Isolation) for FEOL, ILD (Inter-Layer Dielectric) for MOL/BEOL, W-plug for tungsten contact fill, Cu damascene for copper interconnect, barrier for barrier metal removal.
