attributes.references: JEDEC J-STD-020 Moisture Sensitivity Classification; JEDEC J-STD-033

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity requested on the customer order line for this product. Enables calculation of fulfillment rate and identification of short-ships or over-ships.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Order Quantity

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type for the shipped product (e.g., BGA, QFN, WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, TSOP, DIP, SOP). Determines handling, inspection, and customer board assembly requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BGA|QFN|WLCSP|InFO|CoWoS|TSOP|DIP|SOP|LGA|CSP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD30 - Package Type Designations; IPC Standards

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Physical packaging configuration used for the shipped semiconductor units. Determines handling requirements, moisture sensitivity level (MSL), and customer SMT assembly compatibility.
attributes.references: EIA-481 Tape and Reel Standards; JEDEC J-STD-033 Moisture Sensitivity; IPC Standards

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer part number (MPN) for the shipped semiconductor product as listed in the product catalog and on the shipping documentation. Used for customer identification and BOM matching.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Item Master; JEDEC JESD31; IPC-2578

attributes.name: partial_shipment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents a partial shipment against the order line quantity. When true, additional shipment lines are expected to fulfill the remaining ordered quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Partial Delivery; Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Committed delivery date for this shipment line as agreed with the customer at order entry. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement and customer SLA tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Confirmed Delivery Date; JEDEC Supply Chain

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped product complies with EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction. Required for EU market access and supply chain transparency.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; IPC-1752A Material Declaration

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Hardware or mask revision level of the shipped IC (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Critical for customer compatibility verification, PCN (Product Change Notification) compliance, and field failure analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Product Revision; JEDEC JESD46 PCN; IPC-2578

attributes.name: rma_reference_number
attributes.description: RMA number associated with this shipment line if it is a replacement shipment for a previously returned or disputed lot. Enables linkage between original shipment, quality dispute, and replacement fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Returns Processing; Oracle Agile PLM - Quality Dispute; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped product complies with EU RoHS Directive restrictions on hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.). Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.

attributes.name: serial_number_range_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number of the serialized unit range included in this shipment line. Used with serial_number_range_start to define the complete set of serialized units shipped.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Serial Number Management; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: serial_number_range_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number of the serialized unit range included in this shipment line. Applicable for high-value or security-sensitive ICs requiring individual unit traceability (e.g., automotive, military-grade).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Serial Number Management; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers, etc.) physically shipped on this line. LINE_QUANTITY per TRANSACTION_LINE role. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial shipments or allocation constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Actual Quantity Delivered; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Operating temperature range grade of the shipped IC (commercial: 0–70°C, industrial: -40–85°C, automotive: -40–125°C, military: -55–125°C). Critical for customer application qualification and IATF 16949 automotive compliance.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; IATF 16949; AEC-Q100 Automotive IC Qualification

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipped quantity. Common semiconductor UoMs include EA (each/die), WFR (wafer), LOT (production lot), REEL (tape-and-reel packaging), TRAY (IC tray), BOX (carton). Aligned with SAP base UoM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Unit of Measure; JEDEC JESD31; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: unit_selling_price
attributes.description: Agreed selling price per unit for this shipment line as invoiced to the customer. LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT per TRANSACTION_LINE role. Sensitive commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Price; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this shipment line record. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit compliance, and Silver Layer delta processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Change Document; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number
attributes.description: Wafer Start Authorization number that triggered the production lot associated with this shipment line. Links shipment fulfillment back to the original fab capacity commitment in the order-to-cash lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Order; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: yield_grade
attributes.description: Quality or speed grade assigned to the shipped product based on wafer test (probe) results and final test binning. Indicates performance tier (e.g., commercial, industrial, automotive, military grade) for the shipped units.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 - Stress-Test-Driven Qualification; IATF 16949; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

products.name: backlog_position
products.description: Point-in-time snapshot of open order backlog for a specific order line, capturing unshipped committed quantity, backlog value, original promise date, current commit date, and backlog aging in days. Used for backlog management, revenue forecasting, customer escalation prioritization, and quarterly book-to-bill ratio reporting. Tracks push-outs, pull-ins, and cancellations affecting committed backlog. Critical for semiconductor revenue recognition, quarterly close processes, and investor guidance on backlog coverage.

attributes.name: backlog_position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each backlog position snapshot record in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Primary key for the backlog_position data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this backlog position. Used for customer-level backlog aggregation, escalation prioritization, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: backlog_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item (schedule line) within the parent sales order that this backlog position tracks. Enables line-level backlog granularity.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header to which this backlog position belongs. Links the backlog snapshot to the originating customer order.

attributes.name: primary_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Backlog positions track unshipped quantities for specific order lines. Without this FK, backlog cannot be reconciled to orders.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, or discrete device) associated with this backlog position. Enables product-level backlog analysis and demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity from available inventory or in-process production lots that has been formally allocated to fulfill this backlog position. May be less than committed_quantity in constrained supply scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; Camstar MES

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the degree to which available inventory or production capacity has been allocated to fulfill this backlog position. Critical for backlog management and supply-demand balancing in constrained semiconductor supply environments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: backlog_aging_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this order line has been in open backlog as of the snapshot date, calculated from order_entry_date. Used for customer escalation prioritization and aged backlog reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: backlog_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of this backlog position. 'open' = unshipped committed order; 'committed' = confirmed with delivery date; 'at_risk' = delivery commitment in jeopardy; 'pushed_out' = delivery date deferred; 'cancelled' = order line cancelled; 'fulfilled' = shipped and closed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: backlog_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the unshipped committed backlog quantity, calculated as committed_quantity multiplied by the net selling price. Used for revenue forecasting, quarterly guidance, and book-to-bill ratio reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Module; SOX Financial Reporting; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: cancelled_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity cancelled from the original order line. Tracks cancellation impact on backlog coverage and book-to-bill ratio reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: committed_quantity
attributes.description: The unshipped quantity (in units) that remains committed in backlog for this order line as of the snapshot date. Core metric for backlog management and production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this backlog position record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the backlog value and selling price are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, TWD). Required for multi-currency backlog reporting and FX exposure analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: current_commit_date
attributes.description: The most recent confirmed delivery date committed to the customer, reflecting any push-outs or pull-ins from the original promise date. Used for revenue forecasting and quarterly close planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own part number or reference code for the ordered product. Required for customer-facing order confirmations and cross-referencing customer purchase orders with internal part numbers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The customer's purchase order number referencing this backlog position. Required for customer reconciliation, invoice matching, and accounts receivable processing.

attributes.name: design_win_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog position is associated with a strategic design-win account tracked in Salesforce CRM. Design-win orders receive elevated fulfillment priority to protect long-term revenue relationships.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; JEDEC Customer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: end_market_segment
attributes.description: The end-market application segment for which the ordered semiconductor product is destined. Used for segment-level backlog analysis, demand forecasting, and investor guidance on market exposure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: computing|mobile|automotive|industrial|iot|communications|consumer|ai_datacenter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Market Segmentation

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is subject to export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). When true, shipment requires validated export license or license exception before fulfillment.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: export_license_number
attributes.description: The export license number issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) or State Department authorizing shipment of controlled semiconductor products. Required when export_control_flag is true.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: hold_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason this backlog position is on hold and cannot be shipped. Examples include credit hold, export license pending, quality hold, or customer-requested hold. Null when no hold is active. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_hold|export_hold|quality_hold|customer_hold|compliance_hold|capacity_hold — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between seller and buyer for this order line. Impacts revenue recognition timing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this backlog position record was most recently modified, reflecting the latest change to any field such as commit date revision, quantity adjustment, or status change.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: net_selling_price
attributes.description: The agreed net unit selling price for this order line after all applicable discounts and price adjustments. Used to compute backlog value and support revenue recognition under ASC 606.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: order_entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer order was originally entered into the order management system. Used to calculate backlog aging and time-in-backlog metrics.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order type driving this backlog position. Distinguishes standard production orders from Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) orders, die bank orders, wafer start authorizations, sample orders, Return Material Authorizations (RMA), and consignment orders. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|mpw|die_bank|wafer_start|sample|rma|consignment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: original_order_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity originally ordered by the customer on this order line. Used to calculate fulfillment percentage and track cancellation or reduction impacts on backlog.

attributes.name: original_promise_date
attributes.description: The initial delivery date committed to the customer at the time of order entry. Baseline for measuring push-outs and delivery performance against original commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's part number (MPN) of the semiconductor product ordered. Used for product identification, cross-referencing with PLM and ERP systems, and customer-facing order documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Agile PLM; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned to this backlog position for allocation and fulfillment sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used during supply-constrained periods to prioritize strategic customers and design-win accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: push_out_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the current_commit_date has been deferred beyond the original_promise_date. Positive value indicates a push-out (delay); negative value indicates a pull-in (acceleration). Key metric for delivery performance and customer satisfaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: push_out_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the delivery commitment was pushed out or pulled in. Examples include wafer yield issue, capacity constraint, material shortage, customer request, or logistics delay. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: yield_issue|capacity_constraint|material_shortage|customer_request|logistics_delay|design_change|export_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date originally requested by the customer on the purchase order. May differ from the original promise date if the committed date was negotiated.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog position meets the criteria for revenue recognition upon shipment under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. False indicates revenue deferral conditions apply (e.g., consignment, bill-and-hold arrangements).
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region associated with this backlog position (e.g., Americas, EMEA, Japan, Greater China, Rest of APAC). Used for regional backlog reporting and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for shipment. Used for export control screening, logistics routing, and regional revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity already shipped against this order line as of the snapshot date. Together with committed_quantity, reconciles to the original order quantity.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this point-in-time backlog position snapshot was captured. Enables time-series backlog trending, quarterly close reporting, and book-to-bill ratio calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which quantities are expressed for this backlog position. EA = each (individual units), KU = thousands of units, WAFER = full wafer, DIE = individual die, REEL = tape-and-reel packaging unit, TRAY = tray packaging unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: wafer_lot_number
attributes.description: The fabrication lot number of the wafer batch assigned to fulfill this backlog position. Links the backlog to the specific Work in Process (WIP) lot in the fab for production tracking and yield impact analysis.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; SEMI Standards

products.name: allocation_record
products.description: Inventory, capacity, and lot allocation record that reserves specific wafer lots, die bank inventory, finished goods, or fab capacity against a customer order line. Captures allocated quantity, allocation type (hard/soft), allocated lot or inventory batch, lot number, lot type (wafer lot, die lot, packaged goods lot), assignment status (tentative, confirmed, shipped), assignment date, lot-specific quality disposition notes, allocation expiry date, and priority rank. SSOT for all allocation and lot-to-order assignment decisions in the order fulfillment process. Manages constrained supply allocation across competing customer orders during supply shortages. Supports automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace lot-level traceability requirements from order through shipment.

attributes.name: allocation_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a single inventory, capacity, or lot allocation record within the order fulfillment process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module; JEDEC JESD22

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom inventory or capacity is being allocated. Used for constrained supply allocation prioritization across competing customers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/CRM Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: allocation_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer order line item against which this allocation is made. Links the allocation to the parent sales order line in the order-to-cash lifecycle.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the supply chain planner or system process that created this allocation record. Supports audit trail and accountability for allocation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer run associated with this allocation, applicable when the lot type is 'mpw_lot'. Supports MPW order and production lot assignment management.

attributes.name: primary_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Allocations reserve inventory against specific order lines. This is the core link for constrained supply management.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header under which this allocation record is created. Supports backlog management and order-to-cash reporting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, packaged die, or wafer) being allocated to the customer order line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the allocated goods were shipped to the customer. Used for on-time delivery measurement and order fulfillment confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units (dies, wafers, or packaged devices) reserved against the customer order line. Expressed in the unit of measure applicable to the lot type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module; JEDEC JESD22

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the allocation was created and the inventory or capacity was reserved against the order line. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this allocation record. Used in customer communications, ERP transactions, and supply chain coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SEMI E10

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: Identifies the inventory or capacity pool from which this allocation is drawn: 'finished_goods' (packaged inventory), 'die_bank' (singulated die inventory), 'wafer_lot' (in-process wafer inventory), 'fab_capacity' (reserved fab production capacity), 'mpw_pool' (Multi-Project Wafer shared pool).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the allocation: 'hard' (firm reservation of physical inventory), 'soft' (provisional hold pending confirmation), 'tentative' (preliminary planning hold), 'capacity' (fab capacity reservation), 'die_bank' (allocation from die bank inventory), 'mpw' (Multi-Project Wafer run allocation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hard|soft|tentative|capacity|die_bank|mpw — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; SEMI E10

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation assignment: 'tentative' (preliminary hold), 'confirmed' (firm allocation committed to order), 'shipped' (goods dispatched against this allocation), 'cancelled' (allocation voided), 'expired' (allocation lapsed past expiry date), 'on_hold' (allocation suspended pending resolution). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tentative|confirmed|shipped|cancelled|expired|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: backlog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation record is part of the open order backlog (i.e., not yet shipped). Used for backlog management reporting and supply-demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SEMI E10

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why this allocation was cancelled. Populated when assignment_status transitions to 'cancelled'. Supports root cause analysis and supply planning.

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is associated with production eligible for US CHIPS and Science Act incentives or reporting requirements. Supports CHIPS Act compliance tracking.
attributes.references: US CHIPS and Science Act; BIS/EAR

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the allocation was formally confirmed, transitioning from tentative or soft to confirmed status. Triggers downstream shipment scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.2.3

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity formally confirmed for shipment after quality disposition and availability verification. May differ from allocated_quantity due to yield loss, quality holds, or partial confirmations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.2.3

attributes.name: constrained_supply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation was made under constrained supply conditions, where demand exceeded available inventory or fab capacity. Triggers priority-based allocation logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/PP Module; SEMI E10

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this allocation record was first created in the order fulfillment system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: end_market_segment
attributes.description: Target end-market segment for the allocated product: 'automotive', 'mobile', 'computing', 'iot', 'aerospace', 'industrial', 'consumer'. Drives allocation priority rules and regulatory traceability requirements (e.g., IATF 16949 for automotive). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|mobile|computing|iot|aerospace|industrial|consumer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this allocation record is no longer valid and reserved inventory or capacity is released back to available supply. Critical for managing soft allocations and tentative holds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module; SEMI E10

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) applicable to the allocated product lot. Required for export compliance screening and license determination.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR; ITAR; SAP S/4HANA GTS Module

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility (FAB) where the allocated wafer lot or die lot was manufactured. Supports supply chain traceability and export control compliance.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why this allocation is placed on hold. Populated when assignment_status is 'on_hold'. May relate to quality holds, export control review, or customer credit issues.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: inventory_batch_code
attributes.description: SAP batch management identifier for the specific inventory batch being allocated. Enables batch-level traceability and quality disposition linkage within SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated lot is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) controls. When true, additional export licensing and handling restrictions apply.
attributes.references: ITAR; BIS/EAR; SAP S/4HANA GTS Module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to this allocation record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot number of the wafer lot, die lot, or packaged goods lot being allocated. Critical for automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace lot-level traceability from order through shipment. Sourced from Camstar MES lot tracking.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2; JEDEC JESD671

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of manufacturing lot being allocated: 'wafer_lot' (silicon wafer lot at fab), 'die_lot' (singulated die inventory), 'packaged_goods_lot' (finished packaged semiconductor units), 'mpw_lot' (Multi-Project Wafer shared lot).
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SEMI E40; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: osat_site_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Site Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) facility responsible for packaging and testing the allocated lot. Relevant for packaged goods lot allocations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; SEMI E10; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank assigned to this allocation record for constrained supply allocation decisions. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used during supply shortages to sequence allocation across competing customer orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor manufacturing process node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm) of the allocated lot. Used for product traceability, yield analysis, and supply planning by technology generation.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SEMI M1; JEDEC JESD47

attributes.name: quality_disposition
attributes.description: Quality disposition status of the allocated lot or inventory batch: 'accepted' (meets all quality specifications), 'rejected' (fails quality criteria), 'conditionally_accepted' (accepted with documented deviations), 'under_review' (quality evaluation in progress), 'scrapped' (lot destroyed). Supports IATF 16949 lot-level quality traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: quality_disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting lot-specific quality disposition findings, deviations, or conditions associated with this allocation. Supports automotive and aerospace traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the allocated quantity: 'EA' (each, for packaged units), 'WFR' (wafers), 'DIE' (individual die), 'KPC' (thousand pieces). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SEMI M1

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated lot complies with EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical safety. Required for EU market shipments and supply chain due diligence.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested shipment date for the allocated quantity. Used for delivery schedule management and on-time delivery performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.2.2

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated lot meets EU RoHS Directive requirements for restriction of hazardous substances. Required for EU market shipments and customer compliance documentation.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Internally confirmed shipment date scheduled by supply chain planning for this allocation. May differ from requested_ship_date due to capacity or inventory constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped against this allocation record. Populated upon delivery confirmation. Used for order fulfillment reconciliation and backlog management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this allocation record originated: 'SAP_S4HANA' (ERP-driven allocation), 'CAMSTAR_MES' (lot-level MES allocation), 'SMARTFACTORY_MES' (fab capacity allocation), 'MANUAL' (manually entered allocation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number
attributes.description: Wafer Start Authorization number associated with this allocation, linking the allocation to the authorized fab production run. Relevant for capacity allocations and wafer lot allocations in the order-to-cash lifecycle.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

products.name: amendment
products.description: Record of all changes made to a sales order after initial entry, capturing the amendment type (quantity change, date push-out, pull-in, cancellation, price revision, product substitution), original value, revised value, amendment date, requester, approver, and business justification. Supports change order management workflows and provides a complete audit trail of order modifications for revenue recognition and customer dispute resolution.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for amendment

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with the parent sales order. Included on the amendment for direct customer-level reporting, dispute resolution, and revenue recognition without requiring a join to the order header.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: amendment_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Amendments modify existing orders. Each amendment must reference the order it modifies for audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: amendment_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to the original order header in the order-to-cash lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Header

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run affected by this amendment, if applicable. Populated when the amended order is associated with an MPW shuttle run, where quantity or cancellation changes affect shared wafer slot allocations.
attributes.references: Camstar MES MPW Lot Management; SAP S/4HANA PP-PI; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: allocation_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment triggers a reallocation of constrained wafer or die inventory across customer orders. True when the quantity or delivery date change affects the allocation pool managed in SAP SD or the MES.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Allocation Management; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: amended_field_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific order field that was changed (e.g., 'requested_delivery_date', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'product_code'). Together with original_value and revised_value, provides a complete field-level audit trail for each amendment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Document Log; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the amendment was formally raised and submitted by the requester. Used as the effective date for revenue recognition adjustments and backlog recalculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable change order reference number assigned by SAP SD at the time the amendment is raised. Used in customer-facing communications and dispute resolution. Format: AMD-{YYYY}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Order; Oracle Agile PLM Change Order Numbering

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment record within the change order management workflow. Transitions from draft through approval to applied or rejected. Drives revenue recognition timing and backlog reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Workflow Status; SOX Section 404 Change Control

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the change applied to the sales order. Drives downstream workflow routing, revenue recognition treatment, and audit reporting. Allowed values: quantity_change, date_push_out, date_pull_in, cancellation, price_revision, product_substitution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Order Types; JEDEC JESD46 Customer Notification Standard

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approved amendment was actually applied to the sales order in the system of record (SAP SD). Marks the point at which the order reflects the revised terms for fulfillment and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The authorization tier required and applied for this amendment based on the revenue impact and amendment type. Higher-value or cancellation amendments require escalated approval levels per the delegation of authority matrix.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Approval Workflow; SOX Section 404 Delegation of Authority

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the amendment was approved or rejected by the authorized approver. Distinct from amendment_date (submission) and applied_timestamp (system application). Critical for SLA measurement and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Workflow; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the authorized approver who accepted or rejected the amendment. Required for SOX-compliant change order audit trails and revenue recognition documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Approval Workflow; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the requester describing the business reason for the amendment (e.g., customer demand change, fab capacity constraint, end-market shift, design-win revision). Required for SOX audit trail and customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Order; SOX Section 404; Oracle Agile PLM Change Reason

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for order cancellations, populated only when amendment_type is 'cancellation'. Examples include: CUST_REQUEST, CAPACITY_CONSTRAINT, EOL_PRODUCT, DESIGN_WIN_LOST, DUPLICATE_ORDER. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUST_REQUEST|CAPACITY_CONSTRAINT|EOL_PRODUCT|DESIGN_WIN_LOST|DUPLICATE_ORDER|PRICE_DISPUTE|EXPORT_HOLD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Cancellation Reason; JEDEC JESD46; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: chips_act_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parent sales order is associated with a CHIPS Act-eligible program. Amendments to CHIPS Act orders may require additional compliance review and reporting under US CHIPS and Science Act requirements.
attributes.references: US CHIPS and Science Act; SAP S/4HANA GTS; BIS/EAR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the amendment record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to price fields on this amendment (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, TWD). Required for multi-currency revenue recognition and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; ASC 606

attributes.name: customer_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amendment was initiated by the customer (True) or internally by the semiconductor company (False). Distinguishes customer-driven changes from internal supply chain or capacity-driven adjustments for analytics and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM Order Management

attributes.name: delivery_date_original
attributes.description: The confirmed delivery date on the sales order line before the amendment. Populated for date_push_out and date_pull_in amendment types. Used to measure schedule change impact and customer on-time delivery performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Schedule; JEDEC JESD46

attributes.name: delivery_date_revised
attributes.description: The new confirmed delivery date after the amendment is applied. Populated for date_push_out and date_pull_in amendment types. Drives updated production scheduling, wafer start authorization, and customer delivery commitments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Schedule; JEDEC JESD46

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of any associated customer dispute or claim raised in Salesforce CRM that prompted or resulted from this amendment. Links the amendment to the customer dispute resolution workflow for escalation tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Dispute Management

attributes.name: export_control_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amendment (particularly product substitution or destination change) requires re-review under export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). Ensures compliance with BIS/EAR and ITAR before the revised order is fulfilled.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR; SAP S/4HANA GTS (Global Trade Services)

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The value of the amended field before the change was applied. Stored as STRING to accommodate heterogeneous amendment types (quantity, date, price, product code). Paired with revised_value and amended_field_name to form a complete before/after audit record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Document; Oracle Agile PLM Change Order; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: pcn_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Product Change Notification (PCN) that triggered this amendment, if applicable. Links the order amendment to a formal PCN issued under JEDEC JESD46 for product or process changes affecting customer orders.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification; Oracle Agile PLM PCN Management

attributes.name: quantity_original
attributes.description: The ordered quantity on the sales order line before the amendment was applied. Populated specifically for quantity_change amendment types. Enables direct numeric comparison and delta calculation for backlog management and wafer start authorization adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; JEDEC JESD46 Order Management

attributes.name: quantity_revised
attributes.description: The ordered quantity on the sales order line after the amendment is applied. Populated for quantity_change amendment types. Used for backlog recalculation, wafer start authorization updates, and allocation management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; JEDEC JESD46 Order Management

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity fields on this amendment. Common semiconductor units include EA (each), KU (thousands of units), WAFER, DIE, and REEL for tape-and-reel packaged devices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; JEDEC JESD46

attributes.name: requested_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual (internal sales representative, customer service agent, or customer contact) who initiated the amendment request. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Order; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: revenue_impact_amount
attributes.description: The net change in order value resulting from this amendment, expressed in the order currency. Positive for upward revisions (pull-in, price increase), negative for reductions (push-out, cancellation, price decrease). Used directly in revenue recognition and backlog reporting.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM) in which the revenue impact of this amendment is recognized under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. Assigned by the finance team during amendment approval and used for period-close revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: revised_value
attributes.description: The new value of the amended field after the change is applied. Stored as STRING to accommodate heterogeneous amendment types. Paired with original_value and amended_field_name to form a complete before/after audit record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Document; Oracle Agile PLM Change Order; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: so_line_item_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number within the parent sales order that this amendment affects. An amendment may target a single line (e.g., quantity change on one SKU) or the entire order header (e.g., cancellation). Null if the amendment applies to the full order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order Line Item

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this amendment record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking across SAP SD, Oracle Agile PLM, Salesforce CRM, and manual entry channels.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle Agile PLM; Salesforce CRM; Databricks Data Lineage

attributes.name: substitute_product_code
attributes.description: The product part number or material code of the replacement product, populated only when amendment_type is 'product_substitution'. Captures the new IC, SoC, or packaged device being substituted in place of the original ordered product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Oracle Agile PLM Product Substitution; JEDEC JESD46 PCN

attributes.name: to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Amendments modify a specific sales order. Required for change management audit trail.

attributes.name: unit_price_original
attributes.description: The unit selling price on the sales order line before the price revision amendment. Populated for price_revision amendment types. Supports revenue recognition delta calculation and customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: unit_price_revised
attributes.description: The new unit selling price after the price revision amendment is applied. Populated for price_revision amendment types. Used for revenue recognition recalculation and updated order value reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this amendment record in the data platform. Supports incremental load detection and change data capture in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version counter for amendments on the same sales order line, starting at 1. Enables tracking of iterative changes (e.g., multiple date push-outs on the same line) and supports optimistic concurrency control in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Document; Oracle Agile PLM Version Control

attributes.name: wafer_start_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires a corresponding update to the Wafer Start Authorization (WSA) in the fab. True when quantity changes or cancellations affect in-flight WIP lots in the fabrication facility.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES Lot Management; SAP S/4HANA PP-PI

products.name: nre_order
products.description: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) order record capturing one-time engineering charges associated with custom IC design, mask set fabrication, or process qualification for a specific customer. Captures NRE type (mask NRE, design NRE, qualification NRE), total NRE amount, deliverable list, acceptance criteria, and linkage to the associated production order or design project. Includes milestone records defining specific engineering deliverables and payment triggers: milestone name, description, planned completion date, actual completion date, milestone amount, billing status, customer acceptance date, and acceptance signoff reference. Supports milestone-based revenue recognition for NRE contracts and tracks engineering project progress against contractual commitments. Distinct from recurring product orders due to milestone-based billing and engineering deliverable tracking.

attributes.name: nre_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NRE order record. Primary key for the NRE order entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who contracted this NRE engagement. The party responsible for NRE payment and acceptance.

attributes.name: fabrication_photomask_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the photomask set fabricated as part of this NRE engagement. Links NRE to specific mask tooling costs.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC design project that this NRE order funds. Links NRE charges to specific design engineering work.

attributes.name: nre_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated production sales order that this NRE order supports. Links NRE charges to the recurring product order.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — NRE orders are linked to associated production orders for the same customer engagement.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal engineering team assigned to execute this NRE project. Used for resource allocation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: primary_nre_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project manager responsible for NRE execution and customer communication. Primary point of contact for project status.

attributes.name: sales_nre_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_nre_agreement. Business justification: NRE orders are executed under an NRE agreement; linking is required for compliance and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Contractually defined criteria that must be met for customer acceptance of NRE deliverables. Used for milestone signoff and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when all NRE deliverables were completed and accepted. Triggers final milestone billing and project closure.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when engineering work began. Used to track schedule adherence and project performance.

attributes.name: cancellation_clause
attributes.description: Contractual terms governing NRE order cancellation, including notice periods, cancellation fees, and work-in-progress settlement.

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Creating Helpful Incentives to Produce Semiconductors (CHIPS) Act Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NRE project qualifies for CHIPS Act funding or incentives. Used for government reporting and subsidy tracking.

attributes.name: completed_milestone_count
attributes.description: Number of milestones that have been completed and accepted by the customer. Used to calculate project completion percentage.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Classification of confidentiality requirements for NRE deliverables and design information. Determines access controls and disclosure restrictions.

attributes.name: contract_date
attributes.description: Date when the NRE contract was signed and became legally binding. Establishes the start of contractual obligations.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Commercial structure of the NRE contract. Determines billing method and risk allocation between customer and supplier.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NRE order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for NRE amounts. Defines the monetary unit for all financial values in this order.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: Customer's purchase order number authorizing the NRE engagement. Used for invoice reconciliation and payment tracking.

attributes.name: deliverable_list
attributes.description: Comprehensive list of engineering deliverables committed in the NRE contract. Includes design files, documentation, test reports, and IP cores.

attributes.name: design_complexity_score
attributes.description: Quantitative measure of IC design complexity based on gate count, IP blocks, and verification requirements. Used for NRE pricing and resource estimation.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations classification for NRE deliverables. Determines export licensing requirements and destination restrictions.

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount invoiced to date across all completed milestones. Used to track billing progress and outstanding receivables.

attributes.name: ip_core_list
attributes.description: List of third-party or internal IP cores integrated as part of this NRE engagement. Tracks IP licensing and royalty obligations.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NRE engagement involves ITAR-controlled defense articles or technical data. Triggers strict export and access controls.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this NRE order record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: milestone_count
attributes.description: Total number of engineering milestones defined in this NRE contract. Used for progress tracking and billing schedule management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the NRE engagement. Used for knowledge capture and handoff.

attributes.name: nre_order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the NRE order. Externally communicated reference number used in contracts and invoices.

attributes.name: nre_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NRE order. Tracks progression from contract approval through engineering completion and invoicing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|in_progress|milestone_review|completed|invoiced|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: nre_to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — NRE orders are associated with a customer engagement that typically has a parent sales order or contract reference.

attributes.name: nre_type
attributes.description: Classification of the NRE engagement by engineering deliverable category. Determines the type of one-time engineering work being performed.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount received from customer to date. Used to track payment status and outstanding balances.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining milestone payment schedule and due dates. References master payment terms configuration.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the Process Design Kit used for this NRE design work. Ensures design-manufacturing compatibility.

attributes.name: penalty_clause
attributes.description: Contractual penalties for late delivery or non-conformance to acceptance criteria. Defines financial consequences of schedule or quality failures.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractually committed date for completion of all NRE deliverables. Used for customer expectation management and penalty clauses.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for engineering work to commence. Used for resource planning and project scheduling.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to recognize NRE revenue. Determines timing of revenue booking based on contract structure and completion criteria.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor process technology node for this NRE engagement (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm). Determines design rules and manufacturing process.

attributes.name: total_nre_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted value of the NRE engagement across all milestones. Represents the full one-time engineering charge.

products.name: order_nre_milestone
products.description: Individual milestone record within an NRE order, defining specific engineering deliverables and associated payment triggers. Captures milestone name, description, planned completion date, actual completion date, milestone amount, billing status, customer acceptance date, and acceptance signoff reference. Supports milestone-based revenue recognition for NRE contracts and tracks engineering project progress against contractual commitments.

attributes.name: order_nre_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NRE milestone record. Primary key for the order_nre_milestone product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project manager or technical lead responsible for coordinating and delivering this milestone.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent NRE order under which this milestone is defined. Links milestone to the contractual order.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering team or organizational unit responsible for delivering this milestone.

attributes.name: acceptance_signoff_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the customer representative who provided formal acceptance signoff for the milestone.

attributes.name: acceptance_signoff_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the formal customer acceptance document, email, or system record confirming milestone approval.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the milestone deliverable was completed and submitted for customer review.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when engineering work on this milestone commenced.

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current billing and payment status of the milestone, tracking progression from acceptance through payment receipt.

attributes.name: contract_modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone has been modified from the original contract terms through a formal change order or amendment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the milestone amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer formally accepted the milestone deliverable, triggering payment and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: deliverable_location
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or repository location where the milestone deliverable artifacts are stored.

attributes.name: dependency_milestones
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of prerequisite milestone numbers or identifiers that must be completed before this milestone can begin.

attributes.name: effort_hours_actual
attributes.description: Actual engineering effort in hours expended to complete this milestone, tracked for cost accounting and future estimation.

attributes.name: effort_hours_planned
attributes.description: Estimated engineering effort in hours required to complete this milestone, used for resource planning and cost estimation.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice for this milestone was issued to the customer.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice document generated for this milestone billing.

attributes.name: milestone_amount
attributes.description: Contractual payment amount associated with this milestone in the order currency. Represents the revenue to be recognized upon milestone acceptance.

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the engineering deliverable, acceptance criteria, and scope of work associated with this milestone.

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the milestone deliverable (e.g., RTL Design Completion, Tapeout Readiness, First Silicon Validation).

attributes.name: milestone_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the milestone within the NRE contract. Typically sequential or hierarchical (e.g., M1, M2.1, MS-001).

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the milestone indicating progress and acceptance state. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|completed|accepted|rejected|on_hold|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the milestone by engineering phase or deliverable category.

attributes.name: modification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the contract change order or amendment document that modified this milestone terms, scope, or payment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, clarifications, or context regarding milestone execution, issues, or customer interactions.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment for this milestone is contractually due from the customer.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date when payment for this milestone was received from the customer.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractually committed or planned date by which the milestone deliverable is expected to be completed.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when engineering work on this milestone is planned to begin.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the customer if the milestone deliverable was rejected, including specific deficiencies or gaps.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount of revenue recognized for this milestone, which may differ from milestone_amount due to contract modifications or adjustments.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue for this milestone was recognized in the financial system, typically aligned with customer acceptance date per ASC 606.

attributes.name: rework_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether engineering rework is required to address customer feedback or rejection reasons.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of technical or schedule risk associated with achieving this milestone on time and meeting acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this milestone within the NRE order, defining the execution sequence and dependencies.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: rma
products.description: RMA (Return Material Authorization) record managing customer returns of semiconductor products for quality issues, shipping damage, or end-of-life returns. Captures RMA number, return reason code, defect description, returned product and quantity, original order reference, disposition instruction (scrap, rework, credit, replacement), credit memo reference, and failure analysis request flag. SSOT for customer return workflows and DPPM tracking inputs.

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rma

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer initiating the return. Links RMA to the customer master record.

attributes.name: failure_analysis_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the failure analysis record if FA was performed. Links RMA to detailed root cause investigation and corrective action.

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality inspector or technician who performed the incoming inspection of the returned material.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing lot from which the returned units originated. Critical for traceability and yield impact analysis.

attributes.name: rma_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — RMAs reference the original sales order for the returned product. rma.sales_order_id → order.sales_order_id.

attributes.name: rma_replacement_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the replacement sales order created to ship substitute product to the customer. Nullable if disposition is not replacement.

attributes.name: rma_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original sales order from which the returned product was shipped. Links RMA to the originating order transaction.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product master record for the returned semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, or packaged die).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the RMA was approved by the quality or customer service team. Nullable if RMA is rejected or still pending.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the RMA was fully closed after disposition action completed (credit issued, replacement shipped, or material scrapped).

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal corrective action (CAPA) is required based on the RMA findings. True triggers CAPA workflow per ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RMA record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the credit issued to the customer in the transaction currency. Nullable if no credit is issued.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit memo issued to the customer for the returned material. Nullable if no credit is issued (e.g., customer error returns).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, CNY).

attributes.name: customer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the customer contact for RMA correspondence, status updates, and resolution communication.

attributes.name: customer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer representative who initiated or is managing the RMA on the customer side. Used for communication and escalation.

attributes.name: customer_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the customer contact for urgent RMA inquiries or escalation.

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the defect or issue reported by the customer. Captures detailed failure symptoms, visual observations, or functional anomalies.

attributes.name: disposition_instruction
attributes.description: Action to be taken with the returned material. Determines downstream workflow (credit memo, replacement order, FA request, or scrap authorization).

attributes.name: dppm_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Defective Parts Per Million (DPPM) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RMA should be counted in DPPM calculations. True if the defect is attributable to manufacturing or design (excludes customer-induced damage).

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the returned product is subject to export control regulations (ITAR, EAR). True requires special handling and documentation.

attributes.name: failure_analysis_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal failure analysis (FA) has been requested for the returned units. True triggers FA workflow and lab assignment.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the incoming inspection. Determines whether the return claim is valid and informs disposition and credit decisions.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments for cross-functional coordination (quality, engineering, customer service). Not shared with customer.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RMA record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the returned product is REACH compliant. Affects material handling, disposal, and rework procedures.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the returned material was physically received at the receiving facility or OSAT partner. Nullable until material arrives.

attributes.name: receiving_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the facility (FAB, OSAT, warehouse, or service center) where the returned material is received and inspected.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer initiated the RMA request. Principal business event timestamp for the RMA lifecycle.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for the return. Used for root cause analysis, DPPM tracking, and warranty claim classification.

attributes.name: return_shipping_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier used to ship the returned material (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL, regional freight forwarder).

attributes.name: return_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number for the return shipment. Used for shipment visibility and proof of receipt.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units (dies, packaged chips, or wafers) returned under this RMA. Used for DPPM calculation and inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: rma_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the RMA. Used in customer communications, shipping labels, and cross-system tracking.

attributes.name: rma_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RMA. Tracks progression from customer request through receipt, inspection, and final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|approved|rejected|in_transit|received|inspected|closed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the returned product is RoHS compliant. Affects disposition options (scrap vs. rework) and environmental handling requirements.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during inspection or FA. Used for DPPM trending and corrective action prioritization.

attributes.name: to_original_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — RMAs reference the original sales order for the returned product. Required for credit processing and quality traceability.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the returned quantity. EA=each (individual die/chip), WFR=wafer, LOT=production lot, KIT=assembly kit.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RMA is being processed as a warranty claim. True if the return is within warranty period and defect is covered.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the warranty coverage for the returned product expires. Used to validate warranty claim eligibility.

products.name: blanket_order
products.description: Long-term blanket purchase agreement with a customer defining total committed quantity, pricing tiers, and delivery cadence over a contract period (typically 12-24 months). Captures blanket order value, product mix, agreed unit prices, minimum order quantities, call-off frequency, remaining open quantity, and NCNR (non-cancellable non-returnable) terms. Supports high-volume OEM, automotive Tier-1, and distributor relationships where customers commit to annual volumes with periodic release orders against the blanket.
products.reference: SAP SD Outline Agreement / Blanket Order

attributes.name: blanket_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the blanket purchase agreement record in the Databricks Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (OEM, automotive Tier-1, or distributor) who has entered into this blanket purchase agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_design_win_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design win record in Salesforce CRM that originated this blanket order. Links the long-term supply commitment back to the customer design-in event and program qualification milestone.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account manager or field sales representative who owns the customer relationship and negotiated this blanket agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP sales organization responsible for managing and fulfilling this blanket order agreement.

attributes.name: agreed_unit_price
attributes.description: The contractually agreed price per unit for the product under this blanket order. May be a single fixed price or the base tier price when pricing tiers are defined. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the blanket order agreement type.
