attributes.name: test_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the test facility (internal or Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test partner) where KGD certification testing was performed.
attributes.references: SEMI E120 - Specification for Wafer and Die Traceability

attributes.name: test_program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) test program used for electrical and functional testing during KGD certification.
attributes.references: SEMI E30 - Generic Model for Communications and Control of Manufacturing Equipment (GEM)

products.name: inventory_lot_genealogy
products.description: Association record capturing parent-child relationships between wafer lots, die banks, and finished goods to enable full forward and backward traceability across split, merge, rework, retest, and packaging transformations. Tracks genealogy record ID, parent entity type and ID, child entity type and ID, relationship type (split/merge/rework/retest/package), transformation date, quantity in, quantity out, yield at transformation, process step at split/merge, and operator reference. Supports IATF 16949 traceability, automotive PPAP documentation, customer complaint root cause analysis, and field return investigation.
products.reference: SEMI E90 Substrate Tracking / Lot Genealogy

attributes.name: inventory_lot_genealogy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot genealogy association record. Primary key for traceability relationships between wafer lots, die banks, and finished goods across manufacturing transformations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator who executed or supervised the transformation operation. Used for training effectiveness analysis and quality investigation.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing equipment that performed the transformation. Links to equipment master data for tool-specific traceability and FMEA analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_wafer_lot. Business justification: inventory_lot_genealogy already captures parent/child IDs generically; adding a direct FK to the wafer lot simplifies lineage queries without removing existing generic columns.

attributes.name: automotive_ppap_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automotive Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transformation requires PPAP documentation for automotive customers. True for new products, process changes, or supplier changes affecting automotive-qualified parts.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.3.4.4 Production Part Approval Process

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Bin classification assigned to the child entity after transformation. Identifies pass/fail status and performance grade for Known Good Die (KGD) tracking.

attributes.name: child_entity_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the child entity. References the specific wafer lot, die bank, or finished good that resulted from the transformation process.

attributes.name: child_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of the child entity in the genealogy relationship. Identifies whether the output material is a wafer lot, die bank, or finished good after transformation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes about the transformation operation. Captures operator observations, special handling instructions, or investigation findings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the genealogy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer notification is required for this transformation. True for significant process changes, rework operations, or quality excursions that trigger PCN or customer alert requirements.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility or OSAT partner site where the transformation occurred. Critical for multi-site traceability and supply chain visibility.

attributes.name: genealogy_status
attributes.description: Current status of the genealogy record. Active indicates ongoing transformation, completed indicates finished operation, voided indicates cancelled or reversed transaction, under_investigation indicates quality review in progress.

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Known Good Die status of the child entity. Indicates whether the output material has passed all quality gates and is approved for customer shipment or further assembly.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the genealogy record was last updated. Tracks changes to transformation data for compliance and investigation purposes.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_code
attributes.description: Composite traceability code combining parent and child lot identifiers. Used for rapid lookup during customer complaint investigations and field return analysis.

attributes.name: parent_entity_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the parent entity. References the specific wafer lot, die bank, or finished good that served as input to the transformation process.

attributes.name: parent_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of the parent entity in the genealogy relationship. Identifies whether the source material is a wafer lot, die bank, finished good, or raw material before transformation.

attributes.name: pcn_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Product Change Notification associated with this transformation. Links genealogy to formal customer communication for process or material changes.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Guidelines

attributes.name: process_step_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing process step code where the transformation occurred. References the specific operation in the process flow (e.g., wafer probe, die saw, wire bond, final test).

attributes.name: process_step_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the manufacturing process step. Provides business context for the transformation operation.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child entity is under quality hold. True if material is blocked from further processing or shipment pending investigation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason for quality hold if quality_hold_flag is true. Documents the specific quality issue requiring investigation or containment action.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: quantity_in
attributes.description: Quantity of parent entity material consumed in the transformation. Measured in units appropriate to parent entity type (wafers, dies, or packaged units).

attributes.name: quantity_out
attributes.description: Quantity of child entity material produced by the transformation. Measured in units appropriate to child entity type (wafers, dies, or packaged units).

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of transformation relationship between parent and child entities. Defines the manufacturing operation that created the genealogy link: split (one-to-many), merge (many-to-one), rework, retest, package, assembly, die attach, wire bond, molding, or singulation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: split|merge|rework|retest|package|assembly|die_attach|wire_bond|molding|singulation — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rework_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of rework cycles applied to the material. Tracks cumulative rework history for quality risk assessment and customer notification requirements.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material scrapped during the transformation operation. Used for yield loss analysis and cost accounting.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for material scrap. Links to defect classification taxonomy for root cause analysis and FMEA.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created the genealogy record. Identifies whether data originated from MES, ERP, or OSAT partner systems for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: test_program_version
attributes.description: Version of the test program used during transformation (for retest operations). Critical for correlating test results across genealogy and validating test program changes.

attributes.name: transformation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transformation operation occurred. Critical for forward and backward traceability in automotive PPAP documentation and field return investigations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantity tracking. Specifies whether quantities are counted in wafers, dies, packaged units, kilograms, or liters depending on material type.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing work order number authorizing the transformation operation. Links genealogy to production planning and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: yield_at_transformation_pct
attributes.description: Yield percentage achieved during the transformation operation. Calculated as (quantity_out / quantity_in) * 100. Critical for process capability analysis and SPC monitoring.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

products.name: reservation
products.description: Transactional record for inventory allocation and reservation events that earmark specific quantities of WIP lots, die bank dies, raw materials, or finished goods for a designated demand source (customer order, production order, packaging run, engineering sample request). Captures reservation ID, material/lot reference, reserved quantity, UoM, demand source type and ID, reservation date, requested delivery date, priority, reservation status (active/consumed/cancelled/expired), consuming goods_movement reference, and reserving user. Enables ATP (available-to-promise) calculations, prevents double-allocation of scarce KGD inventory, and supports OSAT packaging run scheduling.

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the inventory reservation record.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer associated with the reservation, if applicable.

attributes.name: consuming_goods_movement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods movement that will consume the reservation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who performed the reservation.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the raw material or finished‑good SKU associated with the reservation.

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the wafer or material lot that is being reserved.

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory bin (e.g., A, B, C) used for yield or quality segregation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reservation record was first captured in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: demand_source_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating demand record (e.g., sales order, production order).

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation automatically expires if not consumed.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the reserved inventory (e.g., available, on_hold).

attributes.name: is_kgd
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation is for KGD‑qualified inventory.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority used for allocation sequencing.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Free‑text explanation for why the reservation was created.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer‑or‑production requested date for the reserved inventory to be delivered.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business-visible reservation code used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reservation.

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation was created in the source system.

attributes.name: reservation_type
attributes.description: Category of demand source that triggered the reservation.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Amount of inventory units earmarked by the reservation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating ERP/MES system that generated the reservation record.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code of the storage location where the reserved inventory resides.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Measurement unit for the reserved quantity (e.g., pcs, wafers, kg).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the reservation record.

attributes.name: split_from_reservation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on reservation (split_from_reservation_id)

domains.name: packaging
domains.description: Die packaging and assembly operations covering all package types including WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, TSV-based 3D-IC, flip-chip, wire bonding, and traditional leadframe/BGA formats. Manages OSAT partnerships, assembly process flows, substrate BOMs, package qualification, and assembly yield data.

products.name: assembly_order
products.description: Primary transactional record for die packaging and assembly work orders issued to OSAT partners or internal assembly lines. Captures assembly order number, package type (WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, flip-chip, wire bond, BGA, leadframe), die lot reference, substrate lot, quantity ordered, target ship date, assembly site, process flow revision, and order status lifecycle (released, in-process, completed, on-hold). SSOT for all assembly execution events in the packaging domain. Shipment logistics and delivery tracking are owned by the order domain; cost accounting is owned by the finance domain.
products.reference: OSAT Work Order / MES Assembly Order

attributes.name: assembly_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for assembly_order

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer who requested the assembly order.

attributes.name: assembly_osat_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the outsourced assembly partner responsible for execution.

attributes.name: assembly_package_type_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.package_type.package_type_id — Every assembly order specifies a package type. This FK is essential for filtering orders by package format, capacity planning, and routing to qualified OSAT sites.

attributes.name: assembly_packaging_package_type_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.package_type

attributes.name: assembly_process_flow_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.assembly_process_flow.assembly_process_flow_id — Each assembly order references a specific process flow revision that governs how the lot will be assembled. Critical for traceability and process control.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assembly Order Cost Tracking report requires associating each order with the responsible cost center for budgeting and expense allocation.

attributes.name: customer_design_win_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_design_win. Business justification: Required for linking each assembly order to the specific customer design win that authorizes production, used in the Order Fulfillment process.

attributes.name: die_bank_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.die_bank. Business justification: Needed for Assembly Order Cost Allocation and Regulatory Traceability linking the order to the die bank supplying the dies.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: ECCN classification determines export control category for each order; needed for compliance reporting and customs filings.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Required for Export License Verification Report; each assembly order must be linked to the export license governing its shipment.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary equipment used for the assembly.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Needed for Production Planning to associate each assembly order with the exact IC design.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Assembly Order is created for a specific IC design project; linking enables traceability, cost allocation, and schedule alignment in the packaging execution process.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Needed for Order Planning report that uses inspection lot results to set expected yield and schedule packaging of wafers.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.mpw_shuttle. Business justification: MPW shuttle schedule drives packaging lead times; linking the order to the shuttle provides coordinated planning across design and packaging.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Custom packaging projects are driven by sales opportunities; linking ties assembly orders to the originating opportunity for forecasting.

attributes.name: order_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Sales order assignment to a sales rep is used in order‑to‑cash reporting and commission calculations.

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.osat_vendor.osat_vendor_id — Assembly orders are issued to a specific OSAT vendor or internal site. Critical for vendor performance tracking and capacity allocation.

attributes.name: package_type_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.package_type.package_type_id — Every assembly order specifies a package type — this is the primary classification that determines process flow, substrate, and equipment. Critical for filtering orders by package family.

attributes.name: packaging_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific packaging line used.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.price_agreement. Business justification: Ensures the assembly order uses the correct pricing terms defined in the customer's price agreement, critical for billing and contract compliance.

attributes.name: primary_assembly_process_flow_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.assembly_process_flow.assembly_process_flow_id — Each assembly order executes against a specific process flow revision. Required for traceability and change control.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_flow. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order must reference the exact fab process flow used to produce dies for traceability and handoff reports.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Assembly order fulfillment depends on a purchase order; linking supports order‑PO status reconciliation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Assembly orders are created from approved sales quotes; linking provides traceability from quote to manufacturing.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: Required for Assembly Order creation based on a Sales Order; the assembly planning report must trace each assembly order back to its originating sales order.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for Assembly Order Management report linking each order to the specific SKU being produced.

attributes.name: substrate_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the substrate lot used in the packaging process.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.tapeout. Business justification: Packaging must reference the tapeout record to ensure the correct mask set and timing closure status are used for assembly.

attributes.name: test_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to test.test_program. Business justification: Required for Assembly Order Planning: each order must specify the test program that will validate the dies before packaging, used in the Assembly Order Execution Report.

attributes.name: actual_yield_percent
attributes.description: Yield percentage achieved after assembly completion.

attributes.name: assembly_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the assembly order.

attributes.name: assembly_osat_vendor_fk
attributes.description: FK to packaging.osat_vendor.osat_vendor_id — Assembly orders are issued to a specific OSAT vendor or internal site. This FK is essential for OSAT capacity planning, scorecard reporting, and order routing.

attributes.name: assembly_site
attributes.description: Code of the facility where the assembly is performed.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the assembly work was completed.

attributes.name: cost_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any cost adjustments (e.g., discounts, fees) applied to the gross amount.

attributes.name: cost_gross_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total cost before any adjustments.

attributes.name: cost_net_amount
attributes.description: Final cost after adjustments, representing the amount to be billed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assembly order record was created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for the cost amounts.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects recorded during assembly.

attributes.name: expected_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target yield percentage expected for the assembly run.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order is currently on hold.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Result of the final inspection for the assembled package.

attributes.name: last_status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent status transition.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or remarks related to the order.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business-visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to the assembly order.

attributes.name: order_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assembly order was initially placed.

attributes.name: order_source
attributes.description: Origin of the order request.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the assembly order.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of die units requested for assembly.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when the order was released for execution.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any additional instructions required for the assembly (e.g., cleanroom level, moisture sensitivity).

attributes.name: target_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date for shipment of the completed assembly.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the assembly order record.

products.name: package_type
products.description: Reference master for all semiconductor package formats supported by Semiconductors, including WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, TSV-based 3D-IC, flip-chip BGA, wire-bond QFN, leadframe DIP/QFP, and advanced heterogeneous integration formats. Stores package family, body dimensions, pin/ball count range, thermal resistance specs, moisture sensitivity level (MSL), JEDEC outline code, and qualification status. SSOT for package format classification used across assembly, product catalog, and qualification domains.

attributes.name: package_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for package_type

attributes.name: process_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_technology_node. Business justification: REQUIRED: Package qualification and compliance depend on the technology node; the link drives qualification reports.

attributes.name: ball_count_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of solder balls for BGA‑type packages.

attributes.name: ball_count_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of solder balls for BGA‑type packages.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the package type record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date on which the package type becomes valid for use.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which the package type is no longer valid (null if indefinite).

attributes.name: is_3d_ic
attributes.description: True if the package incorporates through‑silicon vias or other 3‑D stacking.

attributes.name: is_advanced_package
attributes.description: True for cutting‑edge or specialty package formats.

attributes.name: is_ball_grid_array
attributes.description: True if the package is a ball‑grid array type.

attributes.name: is_flip_chip
attributes.description: True if the package utilizes flip‑chip interconnect technology.

attributes.name: is_heterogeneous_integration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the package supports heterogeneous integration (e.g., chip‑on‑wafer).

attributes.name: is_itar_controlled
attributes.description: True if the package is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

attributes.name: is_leadframe
attributes.description: True if the package uses a traditional leadframe.

attributes.name: is_osat_supported
attributes.description: True if the package type is commonly offered by outsourced assembly providers.

attributes.name: is_reach_compliant
attributes.description: True if the package complies with REACH chemical safety regulations.

attributes.name: is_rohs_compliant
attributes.description: True if the package meets RoHS restriction requirements.

attributes.name: is_wire_bond
attributes.description: True if the package uses wire‑bond interconnects.

attributes.name: jedec_outline_code
attributes.description: Official JEDEC outline identifier for the package (e.g., 5x5‑1mm).

attributes.name: max_current_a
attributes.description: Maximum continuous current rating for the package.

attributes.name: max_die_pitch_um
attributes.description: Maximum center‑to‑center spacing between dies for multi‑die packages.

attributes.name: max_operating_temperature_c
attributes.description: Highest temperature at which the package can reliably operate.

attributes.name: max_power_dissipation_w
attributes.description: Maximum power the package can dissipate safely.

attributes.name: max_voltage_v
attributes.description: Maximum voltage rating the package can withstand.

attributes.name: min_die_pitch_um
attributes.description: Minimum center‑to‑center spacing between dies for multi‑die packages.

attributes.name: min_operating_temperature_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which the package can reliably operate.

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC‑defined moisture sensitivity classification.

attributes.name: package_category
attributes.description: Primary category of the package format; limited to six most common values.

attributes.name: package_dimensions_height_um
attributes.description: External height (thickness) dimension of the package.

attributes.name: package_dimensions_length_um
attributes.description: External length dimension of the package.

attributes.name: package_dimensions_width_um
attributes.description: External width dimension of the package.

attributes.name: package_family
attributes.description: Higher‑level family grouping (e.g., Wafer‑Level, Flip‑Chip, 3D‑IC).

attributes.name: package_material
attributes.description: Primary material used for the package substrate.

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the package format (e.g., WLCSP, CoWoS).

attributes.name: package_type_description
attributes.description: Free‑form description of the package’s mechanical and electrical characteristics.

attributes.name: package_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the package type.

attributes.name: pin_count_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of electrical pins/balls the package can support.

attributes.name: pin_count_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of electrical pins/balls the package can support.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification state of the package format.

attributes.name: reference_document
attributes.description: Identifier or URL of the primary specification document for the package type.

attributes.name: thermal_resistance_c_per_w
attributes.description: Thermal resistance from die to ambient, expressed in degrees Celsius per Watt.

attributes.name: typical_thickness_um
attributes.description: Nominal vertical thickness of the finished package.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the package type record.

products.name: osat_vendor
products.description: Master record for Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) partners and internal assembly sites used by Semiconductors. Captures vendor legal name, site locations, approved package type capabilities, quality certifications (IATF 16949, ISO 9001, AEC-Q100), historical DPPM performance, capacity tiers, standard lead times, NDA/IP protection status, export control classification (EAR/ITAR), and approved/preferred/probation status. SSOT for OSAT partner identity and qualification status within the packaging domain.

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for OSAT vendor record.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: REQUIRED: OSAT vendor is a supplier; linking enables unified supplier performance, audit, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: aec_q100_certified
attributes.description: Indicates if the vendor holds AEC-Q100 qualification.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Score from the latest audit (0-100).

attributes.name: capacity_tier
attributes.description: Capacity tier classification for the vendor's assembly lines.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was first created.

products.name: assembly_lot
products.description: Master tracking entity for an assembly lot progressing through OSAT or internal packaging operations. Captures lot number, parent wafer lot reference, die count, package type, assembly site (OSAT vendor), current process step, WIP status (queued, in-process, hold, complete), start/target/actual completion dates, cumulative yield, and hold flags. Central WIP identity that all step records, yield results, inspections, and defects reference. SSOT for assembly lot identity and real-time WIP status within the packaging domain. Equipment asset records are owned by the equipment domain; SPC charting is owned by the quality domain.

products.name: assembly_yield
products.description: Transactional record capturing assembly yield data at each major process step and at final assembly completion for each lot. Stores lot ID, process step, units in, units out, units scrapped, scrap reason codes, yield percentage, cumulative assembly yield, and DPPM. Also serves as the authoritative record for scrap quantities and loss reasons within the packaging domain. Feeds assembly yield trending, OSAT scorecard, cost of poor quality (COPQ) analysis, and product cost calculations. Distinct from wafer probe yield (owned by test domain).

products.name: material_certification
products.description: Supplier-originated material compliance documents including quality certifications and product change notifications. Captures Certificate of Conformance (CoC), Certificate of Analysis (CoA), RoHS compliance declarations, REACH SVHC declarations, TSCA certifications, and Product Change Notifications (PCNs). For certifications: certification type, issuing supplier, material lot number, test results, compliance standard, issue date, expiry date, and document reference. domains.name: research
domains.description: R&D for next-generation process nodes, novel device architectures (FinFET, GAA, CFET), advanced packaging technologies, materials research, and new IP core development. Manages technology roadmaps, proof-of-concept projects, experimental wafer lots, IP filing records, and collaboration with research institutions.

products.name: research_program
products.description: Master record for R&D programs representing major multi-year technology development initiatives such as next-generation process node development (e.g., 2nm GAA, 1.4nm CFET), advanced packaging platforms, or novel device architecture programs. Captures program charter, technology generation target, strategic objectives, budget envelope, timeline with detailed milestone tracking (milestone name, type, planned/actual dates, completion criteria, gate review outcomes, action items, approving authority), milestone types (technical gates, management reviews, customer demos, tapeout milestones, silicon return, qualification gates), sponsoring business unit, program director, technology readiness level (TRL), and program lifecycle status. SSOT for all R&D program identity, governance, milestone, and gate review data. Supports technology roadmap execution tracking and CHIPS Act program reporting.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Primary key for program

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Program‑level budgeting consolidates expenses under a cost center, required for finance's program cost roll‑up reports.

attributes.name: director_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the program director, linking to HR systems for organizational reporting.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_family. Business justification: PROGRAM TARGETING: Technology program focuses on a product family; needed for budgeting, KPI tracking, and strategic alignment.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Program budgeting reports tie each program to the sponsoring org unit for financial governance.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Program financial performance is tracked via a profit center to allocate licensing and product revenue.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the program was completed or terminated. Null if program is still active.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the program commenced execution. Null if program has not yet started.

attributes.name: budget_envelope_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocation for the program across all fiscal years, in USD. Includes NRE, capital equipment, materials, and labor costs.

products.name: process_integration_run
products.description: Records of process integration experiments including experimental process flow definition, execution, and results. Captures the complete experiment lifecycle: process flow sequence definition (FEOL/MOL/BEOL steps with per-step parameters and tool types), split conditions for DOE (Design of Experiments) designs, flow versioning and approval, key process parameters, equipment set used, integration engineer, run date, electrical test results, yield outcome, pass/fail determination, and TCAD simulation inputs/correlation data. Includes full experimental flow management: flow version control, step-by-step parameter specification, target device structures, and flow authorship tracking. Supports systematic process development learning cycles, feeds PDK development, and enables correlation between process conditions and device performance.

products.name: device_architecture

Captures architecture name, type (device/packaging), structural description, key dimensional/performance parameters, target technology node or application, integration approach (2.5D, 3D, fan-out, chiplet), fabrication complexity rating, thermal performance targets, interconnect density targets, key technical challenges, target application domains (HPC, AI accelerator, mobile, automotive), associated experimental lots, IP ownership, development maturity stage, and architecture maturity level (concept, simulated, fabricated, characterized, qualified). SSOT for all research architecture definitions including both device-level and package-level innovation.

products.name: patent_filing
products.description: IP protection lifecycle records tracking inventions from initial disclosure through patent grant or disposition. Captures the full pipeline: invention disclosure submission (inventor names, technical description, novelty assessment, prior art search results, business value assessment, recommended protection strategy, submission date, assigned IP counsel, disposition decision), IP protection strategy decision, patent application filing, prosecution across jurisdictions (US, EU, CN, JP, KR, TW), and grant/abandonment outcome. Tracks disclosure ID, patent application number, filing date, jurisdiction, patent type (utility, design, provisional), invention title, inventors, technology domain classification, filing status, prosecution timeline, assigned patent counsel, strategic IP value classification, and final disposition. SSOT for all invention-to-patent lifecycle data. Supports IP portfolio management, competitive intelligence, trade secret decisions, and CHIPS Act IP reporting.

products.name: characterization_result
products.description: Electrical and physical characterization measurement results from research test structures, PCVs, and experimental devices, including comprehensive yield learning and defect analysis records. Captures measurement data (IV/CV curves, SIMS, TEM, XRD, AFM, sheet resistance, threshold voltage, leakage current), measurement equipment, measurement conditions, pass/fail status, defect analysis (particle, pattern, electrical defect types, defect density), yield measurements (die yield, functional yield, parametric yield), yield limiting mechanisms, dominant yield detractors, root cause analysis findings, corrective process actions proposed, yield improvement deltas achieved, learning engineer, and learning cycle tracking. SSOT for all R&D characterization and yield learning data. Feeds process integration learning, device model development, PDK calibration, and production yield ramp planning.

attributes.name: characterization_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the characterization result record. Primary key for R&D electrical and physical characterization measurement results from research test structures, Process Control Vehicles (PCVs), and experimental devices.

attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process generation) under development. Examples include 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, or advanced nodes with FinFET, Gate-All-Around (GAA), or Complementary FET (CFET) architectures.

attributes.name: process_split_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific process split or experimental condition being evaluated. Used in Design of Experiments (DOE) to track variations in materials, recipes, or process sequences.

attributes.name: test_structure_id

attributes.name: analysis_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the software tool used for data analysis and parameter extraction. Examples include MATLAB, Python scripts, proprietary EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tools, or equipment vendor analysis packages.
attributes.references: SEMI E148 - Specification for Semiconductor Equipment Test Data Format

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, anomalies, or contextual information about the characterization result. Used by engineers to document unusual behavior, equipment issues, or interpretation notes.

attributes.name: corrective_action_proposed
attributes.description: Proposed corrective actions to address identified yield limiters or parametric issues. May include process recipe changes, equipment maintenance, design rule modifications, or material substitutions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or object storage location of the raw measurement data file. For curve measurements (IV, CV) or imaging data (TEM, AFM), points to the detailed data set for further analysis.
attributes.references: SEMI E148 - Specification for Semiconductor Equipment Test Data Format

attributes.name: defect_density
attributes.description: Measured defect density expressed as defects per unit area (typically defects per square centimeter). Critical metric for yield prediction and process quality assessment.
attributes.references: SEMI M33 - Specification for Reporting Wafer Nanotopography

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Classification of defect observed during characterization. Includes particle defects, pattern defects (lithography-related), electrical defects (opens, shorts, leakage), and physical defects (voids, hillocks, contamination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: particle|pattern|electrical|crystallographic|contamination|void|hillock|scratch|residue|bridging|open_circuit|short_circuit — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI M58 - Terminology for Silicon Technology

attributes.name: device_architecture
attributes.description: Type of transistor or device architecture being characterized. Includes planar CMOS, FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor), GAA (Gate-All-Around), CFET (Complementary FET), nanowire, nanosheet, and other advanced device structures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planar|finfet|gaa|cfet|nanowire|nanosheet|vertical_fet|tunnel_fet — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE Electron Device Letters - Device Architecture Standards

attributes.name: die_yield_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of functional dies on the wafer that pass all characterization tests. Represents the ratio of Known Good Die (KGD) to total dies tested.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Standard for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: dominant_yield_detractor
attributes.description: Primary defect type or failure mode contributing most significantly to yield loss. Identified through Pareto analysis of defect types and failure modes.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: functional_yield_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of dies that pass functional testing, demonstrating correct logical operation. Subset of die yield focusing on functional correctness rather than parametric performance.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Standard for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: learning_cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the learning cycle or iteration in which this characterization was performed. Tracks progression through Design of Experiments (DOE) and process optimization cycles.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: measurement_condition
attributes.description: Environmental and operational conditions under which the measurement was performed. Includes temperature, voltage bias, frequency, ambient conditions, and test mode settings that affect measurement results.

attributes.name: measurement_equipment_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) or characterization tool used to perform the measurement. Includes parametric testers, probe stations, analytical microscopes, and metrology systems.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Standard for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Pass/fail status of the measurement against specification limits or expected behavior. Indicates whether the measured parameter meets design targets and process control limits.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Standard for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the characterization measurement was performed. Critical for tracking measurement sequence, equipment drift, and temporal correlation with process conditions.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Type of electrical or physical characterization measurement performed. Includes IV (Current-Voltage) curves, CV (Capacitance-Voltage) curves, SIMS (Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry), TEM (Transmission Electron Microscopy), XRD (X-Ray Diffraction), AFM (Atomic Force Microscopy), and key electrical parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iv_curve|cv_curve|sims|tem|xrd|afm|sheet_resistance|threshold_voltage|leakage_current|breakdown_voltage|capacitance|mobility|contact_resistance|gate_oxide_integrity|stress_migration|electromigration — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI E148 - Specification for Semiconductor Equipment Test Data Format

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measurement value. Examples include volts (V), amperes (A), ohms (Ω), farads (F), ohms per square (Ω/sq), atoms per cubic centimeter (atoms/cm³), nanometers (nm).

attributes.name: measurement_value
attributes.description: Primary numerical result of the characterization measurement. For scalar measurements (threshold voltage, sheet resistance, leakage current), this is the measured value. For curve measurements (IV, CV), this may represent a key extracted parameter.
attributes.references: SEMI E148 - Specification for Semiconductor Equipment Test Data Format

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this characterization result record was last modified. Tracks updates to analysis findings, corrective actions, or data corrections.

attributes.name: parametric_yield_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of dies that meet all parametric specifications (timing, power, voltage, current). Subset of die yield focusing on performance parameters within specification limits.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: pdk_calibration_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this characterization result is used for Process Design Kit (PDK) model calibration. PDK calibration data feeds SPICE models and design rules for IC design tools.
attributes.references: SEMI P39 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: reliability_stress_type
attributes.description: Type of reliability stress testing applied before or during characterization. Includes HTOL (High Temperature Operating Life), LTOL (Low Temperature Operating Life), HAST (Highly Accelerated Stress Test), THB (Temperature Humidity Bias), TC (Temperature Cycling), HCI (Hot Carrier Injection), NBTI (Negative Bias Temperature Instability), PBTI (Positive Bias Temperature Instability), TDDB (Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown), EM (Electromigration), SM (Stress Migration). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|htol|ltol|hast|thb|tc|hci|nbti|pbti|tddb|em|sm — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22 - Reliability Test Methods for Packaged Devices

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Detailed findings from root cause analysis investigation. Documents the systematic investigation using techniques such as Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), fishbone diagrams, and 5-Why analysis to identify underlying causes of yield loss or parametric deviation.

attributes.name: specification_lower_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit or specification limit for the measured parameter. Used to determine pass/fail status and process capability. Part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) framework.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: specification_upper_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit or specification limit for the measured parameter. Used to determine pass/fail status and process capability. Part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) framework.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: yield_improvement_delta
attributes.description: Measured improvement in yield percentage achieved after implementing corrective actions. Quantifies the effectiveness of yield learning and process optimization efforts.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

attributes.name: yield_limiting_mechanism
attributes.description: Identified root cause or mechanism that is limiting yield performance. Examples include random defects, systematic pattern issues, parametric drift, edge exclusion, or specific process step failures.
attributes.references: SEMI E116 - Specification for Equipment Performance Tracking

products.name: program_partner_collaboration
products.description: Represents the operational agreement between a sales channel partner and an R&D program. Each record links one channel_partner to one rd_program and stores attributes that belong exclusively to the partnership.. Existence Justification: Channel partners (distributors, VARs, system integrators) actively collaborate with multiple R&D programs, and each R&D program can involve multiple channel partners. The business records a collaboration agreement per partner‑program pair, capturing the partner's role and a unique agreement identifier, which is managed and updated by stakeholders.

products.name: compliance_assessment
products.description: Represents the assessment of a specific regulatory or standards obligation for a given research project. Each record links one project to one obligation and stores data that belongs to the assessment itself.. The compliance team records an assessment for every project‑obligation pair, capturing the assessment date, status, and remediation plan. products.name: ar_invoice
products.description: Authoritative accounts receivable invoice record for all customer billing transactions in the semiconductor business. Captures the full invoice lifecycle from draft through posted, sent, disputed, and paid states. Covers commercial product shipment invoices, NRE milestone billing, IP royalty invoices, service invoices, and pro-forma documents for customs/LC/advance payment purposes. products.name: nre_billing_milestone
products.description: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) billing milestone and planned billing schedule records for semiconductor IC design, tapeout, IP licensing, and long-term supply agreement projects. Each record represents a contractually defined billing event — either milestone-based (RTL freeze, GDS tapeout, first silicon, qualification sign-off) or schedule-based (calendar-periodic, shipment-triggered, subscription). products.name: adjustment_memo
products.description: Adjustment memo records (credit, debit, and correction) issued to customers to modify outstanding invoice balances. Credit memos reduce balances for price adjustments, RMA returns, overbilling corrections, yield-related concessions, and quality claim settlements. Debit memos increase balances for underbilling corrections, retroactive price adjustments, and expedite fees. Corrections cover formal invoice amendments requiring accounting reversal and reissuance. Captures original invoice reference, adjustment direction (credit/debit/correction), reason code, approved amount, corrected line items, net financial impact, issuing authority, approval workflow status, replacement invoice linkage, and application status against open receivables. SSOT for all post-invoice billing adjustments — subsumes all debit_memo and invoice_correction concepts.

products.name: payment_receipt
products.description: Records of customer payments received, their line-level allocation against outstanding invoices, and cash application status. Captures payment header (date, method — wire/ACH/check/LC, amount, currency, bank reference, remittance advice) and line-level allocation details (allocated amount per invoice, allocation date, clearing document reference, partial payment flag, discount taken, residual open amount). products.name: dunning_notice

products.name: tax_determination

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core SAP FI general ledger journal entry capturing all financial postings across the semiconductor enterprise including consolidation adjustments. Document types include vendor invoice, customer payment, asset depreciation, accrual, intercompany, and consolidation entries (intercompany elimination, minority interest adjustment, currency translation adjustment, goodwill amortization). Captures posting date, fiscal period, company code, currency, exchange rate, consolidation unit/group (for group entries), consolidation method, and SOX-relevant reversal indicator. Covers fab cost postings, NRE revenue recognition, R&D capitalization entries, period-end accruals, and group-level consolidation adjustments for SOX-compliant financial reporting under US GAAP or IFRS. Primary transactional record and audit trail for all financial activity.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: SAP FI-AA fixed asset master and full depreciation lifecycle for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and infrastructure. Covers EUV/DUV lithography scanners, deposition systems (CVD/PVD/ALD), etch tools, CMP equipment, ATE platforms, cleanroom infrastructure, and IT assets. Master attributes include asset class, acquisition cost, capitalization date, useful life, depreciation key, location (fab building/bay), technology node assignment, and CHIPS Act grant tracking. Depreciation records capture each periodic posting: run date, fiscal period, depreciation area (book/tax/IFRS), depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and remaining useful life. products.name: budget_plan
products.description: Annual and multi-year financial budget plan with granular line-item detail for the semiconductor enterprise. Header captures planning version, fiscal year, budget type (operating expense, capital expenditure, R&D investment, headcount), organizational unit (cost center, profit center, company code), planning method, and approval status. products.name: standard_cost
products.description: Standard cost master for semiconductor products defining the pre-determined cost build-up for wafers, dies, and packaged chips at each technology node and process flow. Encompasses full wafer cost modeling: process node, wafer diameter, die size, target yield, mask set cost amortization, direct materials (silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks), direct labor rate, machine cost (equipment depreciation per wafer pass, maintenance allocation), fab overhead rate (utilities, cleanroom, indirect labor), and fully-loaded cost per wafer out. Calculates yield-adjusted cost per good die and packaging cost for finished product costing. Used as the basis for inventory valuation (ASC 330), COGS determination, manufacturing variance analysis (price/usage/efficiency/yield), product pricing decisions, NRE recovery planning, and fab utilization-based cost allocation. Updated each fiscal year during standard cost roll with quarterly variance reviews. Sourced from SAP CO-PC product costing.

Manages compliance audits, certifications, product substance declarations, export license records, and regulatory filings.

products.name: export_license
products.description: Master record for all export authorizations, registrations, and supporting end-use documentation under EAR (BIS) and ITAR (DDTC) governing semiconductor ICs, SoCs, ASICs, IP cores, and controlled technology. Captures authorization type (individual validated license, distribution license, deemed export license, ITAR registration, license exception, TAA), issuing authority, license/registration number, authorized scope (commodities, destinations, end-users, USML categories), validity period, value ceiling, conditions, and renewal status. For ITAR registrations: registration category (manufacturer, exporter, broker), USML categories covered, empowered official, and compliance agreements. For end-use documentation: certificate type (end-user statement, import certificate, delivery verification certificate), customer/end-user details, authorized/prohibited end-use descriptions, and verification status. SSOT for all export control authorizations, ITAR registrations, and supporting end-use certificates.

products.description: Export control compliance screening record for semiconductor workforce personnel tracking ITAR and EAR authorization status. products.name: safety_event
products.description: Occupational health and safety incident record for semiconductor workforce capturing workplace injuries, near-misses, chemical exposures, and EHS events in fab and design center environments. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `semiconductors_ecm`.`_metrics`.`test_parametric_measurement`

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Parametric measurement quality metrics, focusing on value stability and spec compliance."
  source: "`semiconductors_ecm`.`test`.`parametric_measurement`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "test_program_id"
      expr: test_program_id
      comment: "Associated test program"
    - name: "measurement_type"
      expr: measurement_type
      comment: "Type of parametric measurement"
    - name: "measurement_tool_version"
      expr: measurement_tool_version
      comment: "Version of the measurement tool used"
    - name: "measurement_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', measurement_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of the measurement"
  measures:
    - name: "total_measurements"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of parametric measurement records"
    - name: "avg_measured_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(measured_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average measured value across records"
    - name: "avg_measurement_std_dev"
      expr: AVG(CAST(measurement_std_dev AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "out_of_spec_count"

      comment: "Count of measurements outside spec limits"
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `semiconductors_ecm`.`_metrics`.`workforce_cleanroom_access`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Key cleanroom access utilization and temporary access metrics for operational safety and capacity planning"
  source: "`semiconductors_ecm`.`workforce`.`cleanroom_access`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "fab_site_id"
      expr: fab_site_id
      comment: "Fabrication site identifier"

      expr: zone
      comment: "Cleanroom zone"

      expr: cleanroom_access_status
      comment: "Current status of the access (e.g., Active, Revoked)"
    - name: "access_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Date the access record was created"
  measures:
    - name: "total_accesses"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of cleanroom access records"

      comment: "Count of temporary cleanroom accesses"
    - name: "avg_access_duration_days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(expiry_timestamp, grant_timestamp))

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `semiconductors_ecm`.`_metrics`.`workforce_compensation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Compensation cost and distribution metrics to monitor labor expense and incentive effectiveness"
  source: "`semiconductors_ecm`.`workforce`.`compensation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "department_code"
      expr: department_code
      comment: "Department code associated with the employee"
    - name: "cost_center_code"
      expr: cost_center_code
      comment: "Cost center code for accounting"
    - name: "compensation_type"
      expr: compensation_type
      comment: "Type of compensation (e.g., Salary, Equity)"

      comment: "Year the compensation became effective"

      expr: employee_id
      comment: "Employee identifier"
  measures:
    - name: "total_base_amount"

      comment: "Average total compensation per record"
    - name: "current_compensation_count"
